tei:div.tei:p: gso rig lag len spyi don sgron ma/ rto ci myu r+sha zhe9 rmya sh+tsa d+nghari sngo lho lhasnotshilho‘lhirjod+ku r+haX d+ngha ge snye mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang /

gso rig lag len spyi don sgron ma/gartso sgrig pa/ rgya ye blo bzang nyi ma/ gnubs don grub tshe ring /sgrig mkhan/ gnubs don grub tshe ring / rdo rje dbang rgyal/sangs rgyas skyid/ 'bum kho/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

'go brjod/deb chung 'di 'bri skabs shin tu rgyas pa rnams bsdus/ shin tu bsdus pa rnams cung zad bkrol te 'os 'tshams kyis grong gseb bod sman pa rnams la ched du dmigs nas bris shing / de yang mi lo hril bo bod kyi sman bcos las don du bcol ba'i snga rabs sman pa nyams myong can gyi zin tig dang nyams yig khag la blta bsdur khungs gtugs byas te legs pa'i cha rnams blangs shing / mi shes mi rung ba'i gnad ka rnams khol phyung du zhib mor bkod yod par ma zad/ skabs 'phral de'i lag len rim pa je gsal du 'gro ched gzhan pa'i lag len kha shas zur rgyan du bkod de bris yod/ gso rig gi tha snyad rgyugs mi che ba skor zhig phal skad du glod de bris la/ gso bcos kyi skabs da snga bkol bzhin med pa'i sman sbyor bzang po mi nyung ba zhig kyang nad so so'i bar skabs su bris yod/deb 'di'i rtsom sgrig thad blos thub grogs po gro tshang phyag na rdo rje dang / 'ba' dbang grags bsod nams/ grogs rnam dpyod can skal 1

bzang rdo rje dang mkha' 'gro skyabs sogs kyis rogs ram dang bsam blo'i rgyags phye gang mang bstsal pa la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / khyad par du a ri'i kun phan thebs rtsa tshogs pas par skrun rogs dngul sbyar pa la snying khong nas bka' drin che zhu ba yin/sgrig mkhan gyis/2 006lo'i zla5pa'i tshes30nyin/

dkar chagaskabs dang po/ nad rigs gso brtsos kyi lag glen/rlung gi nad/ (1)mkhris pa'i nad/ (2)bad kan gyi nad/ (3)khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad/ (5)grang mkhris kyi nad/ (6)bad kan smug po'i nad/ (7)mkhris pa'i rdo skran gyi nad/ (9)mchin pa'i khrag span gyi nad/ (10)sgang pa'i rdo skran gyi nad/ (12)glo ba skya rbab kyi nad/ (13)maci'id pa skya rbab kyi nad/ (14)grang 'or gyi nad/ (15)mchin pa'i zags chu'i nad/ (17)gcong chen zad byed kyi nad/ (19)ma smin tsha ba'i nad/ (20)rgyas tshad kyi nad/ (22)1

stongs tshad kyi nad/ ( 24)gab tshad kyi nad/ (26)rnyings tshad kyi nad / ( 28)rnyogs tshad kyi nad/ (29)'grams tshad kyi nad/ (31)'khrugs tshad kyi nad/ (33)rims tshad kyi nad/ (35)sib kyi nad/ (37)klad gzer gyi nad/ (39)cham pa'i nad/ (40)gag pa'i nad/ (spyo)gnyan gzer thung gi nad/ (slo)pho ba'i gnyan glang gi nad/ (45)gnyan rgyu gzer gyi nad/ (46)gnyan me dbal gyi nad/ (47)gnyan rmen bu'i nad/ (49)lhog pa'i nad/ (50)gnyan 'bras kyi nad/ (51)gnyan 'dzum bu ltag dgye'i nad/ (53)gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsar rgyug gi nad/ (54)

gnyan khong lhog nag po srog rtsar babs pa'i nad/ (57)gnyan rna rtsa phus 'debs kyi nad/ (59)rgyu gzer gyi nad/ (60)mgo rlung gi nad/ (61)sna khrag 'dzag pa'i nad/ (62)sna rnag ya ma'i nad/ (63)kha yi nad/ (64)so srin gyi nad/ (65)g.yan pa'i nad/ (66)glang shu'i nad/ (67)rtsa 'bras kyi nad/ (67)pho 'bras kyi nad/ (68)gzhang 'brum gyi nad/ (69)glo ba'i sur ya'i nad/ (71)mkhal ma'i rlung tshabs kyi nad/ (71)mngal skran gyi nad/ (72)pho rlung gi nad/ (73)pho tshad kyi nad/ (74)rgyu rgan gyi nad/ (75)snying rlung gi nad/ (76)

mkhal tshad kyi nad/ (77)mkhal 'grams kyi nad/ (78)dreg gi nad/ (79)zur sdo///'i nad/ (80)gcig nad sman sprod pa'i nyams yigazhe dge bla sman chos grags rgya mtshos brtsams/ (82)zur bkod/gnyis/ nad sman sprod pa'i nyams yig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/stag bla nor bus brtsams (103)skabs gnyis pa/ sngo sman 'thu sgrub / kalag men/kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ (124)kyi lce dkar po/ (125)klu bdud rdo rje/ (126)skyer ba'i bar shun/ kha (127)khu byug pa/ (128)khur mong / (129)4 mkhan dkar/ (130)

ba/gang ga chung / (131)gur tig (132〉go snyod/ (134)gro ma/ ( 135)grog shing / (136)gla sgang rgod pa/ (137〉gla sgang g.yung ba/ (138)rgya drus/ (139)rgun 'brum/ ( 140)sga tig nga (141)dngul tig (142)sngon bu/ ca (1spyo)lca ba/ (143)lcags tig (144)lcam pa/ (145)smyum rtsa/ cha (147)

chu zug lhan ci (148)chu rtsa/ (149)chu rug pa/ ja (150)'jib rtsi chen po/ nya (150)nye shing / ( 151)gnyan 'dul ba/ (152)snya lo/ (153)snyi ba/ ta (154)til/ (155)rta wags/ (156)rta rmig (157)stag ma'i me tog (158〉stag sha (159)star bu/ (160)stong ri zil ba tha ( 161)tha ram ( 162)

thang phrom dkar po/ (163)thang phrom nag po/ ( 165〉thal ka rdo rje/ da (166)da li/ (167)dar ya kan/ (1ཿ)dug mo nyung / (169)sdum nag dom mkhris/ (170〉sdum bu re ral/ na (171)sne'u/ (172)nga pa yag pa/ ( 173)par ba ta/ (174)puṣ+kar mū la/ ( 175)pri yang ku/ (176)spang rgyan dkar po/ (177)spang rgyan nag po/ ( 178)spang rtsi do bo/ (178)spyang tsher/ (179)7

spru nag pha (181)phur mong / (182)'phang 'bras ba (183〉bong dkar/ (1khu)bya rgod sug pa/ (1gra)bya pho gi (186)byu rug (187)byi'u la phug (188)brag skya ha bo/ (189)bre ga (190)dbang po lag pa/ (191)'bri ta sa 'dzin/ ma (192)ma nu pa tra/ tsa (193)rtsa mkhris/ tsha (194)tshar bong (195)tsher sngon/ (196)8

mtshe sdum/ (197)dzamadzo mo shing / za ( 198〉zwa 'brum/ ( 199)zin tig (200)gze ma/ (201)'a'u su/ (202)'om bu/ (203)'ol mo se ya (2ni4)yu mo mde'u 'byin/ (205)gapa 'a kyi ma/ (206)g.yar mo thang ra (207)ra mnye/ (208)ram bu/ (209)ru rta/ (211)re skon/ (212)

lug ru smug po/ ṭ+wāṃ (213)shing mngar/ sa (214〉sum cu tig (215)se ba'i me tog (216〉so ma ra dza (217)sran ma'i me tog (218)sro lo dkar po/ (218)sro lo dmar po/ ha (pho0)hong len/ ya (221)a krong / (222)a byag (223)sngo/ga chos/ (224)zur sdir+sha/// (225)gcig sman gyi tshab bstan pa/ (227)10

skabs gsum pa/ sman smyor gyi nus ngas dang sgosasnyekyi lag len/te/ ༷rmi bdun pa / (252)ko la bcu gcig (252)klu bdud bco brgyad/ (252)dkar po drug sbyor/ (252)skyu ru nyer lnga/ (253)skyer shun brgyad pa/ kha (253)khyung lnga/ ci (253)khyung sngon dgu ba/ (254)khrag gcod gur gum brgyad pa/ (254)mkhris phye bdun pa/ ga (254)gar nag bcu ba/ (254)gi wang dgu ba/ (254)gur gum bcu gsum/ (255)gur gum mchog bdun/ (255)grang sbyor/ (255)grub thob ril dkar/ (256)11

glo sman tsan dan bco brgyad/ (256)rgun 'brum bdun pa/ (256)rgya ru bcu bzhi/ (256)rgyam tshwa drug pa/ (257)rgyam tshwa bzhi thang / nga (257)dngul chu bco brgyad/ ca (257)cu gang nyer lnga/ (257)cong zhi drug pa/ (258)cong zhi nyer gcig (258)gcin snyi a ru bco brgyad/ cha (258)'chi med srin sel/ ta (258〉tig ta brgyad pa/ (259)tig ta nyer lnga/ (259)rta zi dmar po/ tha (259)thang chen nyer lnga/ da (259)12

da li bcu drug (259)da li bco brgyad/ (260)dwags po sman nag (260)bdud rtsi lnga sbyor/ (260)bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ (261)bde byed stoms ldan/ na (261)nor bu bdun thang / pa (261〉spang rgyan bco lnga/ (262)spang rtsi bcu gnyis/ (262)spos dkar bcu ba/ pha (262)phag mo grub pa/ (262)phan pa kun ldan/ ba (263)gi ma la/ (263)bong khrag nyer lnga/ (264)bya khyung bcu gsum/ (264)byi tang bdun pa/ (264)

byur dmar nyer lnga/ (264)brag khyung / (264)brag zhun dgu ba/ (265)blon po sum sbyor/ (265)dbang ril nyer lnga/ (265)'bras bu sum thang / ma (265)ma nu bzhi thang / (266)mang sbyor/ (266)man ngag bsil sbyor/ (266)mu tig bdun cu/ (266)mu tig nyer lnga/ tsa (267)tsan dan brgyad pa/ (268)gtso bo brgyad pa/ (268)btso zla/ (268)rtsa thag bcu drug nga (268)dzā ti bcu bzhi/ zha (269)14

zhi byed bcu gcig (269)zhi byed drug pa/ (269)zhi byed nyer dgu/ za (269)zangs thal nyer lnga/ (270)zla shel chen mo/ (270)zla shel bdud rtsi ma/ 'a (270)'ol se nyer lnga/ ya (271)g.yu rnying nyer lnga/ (271)g.yu dril bcu gsum/ ra (271)ru rta drug pa/ la (272)li shi drug pa/ (272)lug mur bdun pa/ sha (272)shing kun nyer lnga/ (272)shing mngar drug pa/ sa (273)15

sug smel bcu ba/ (273)se 'bru brgyad pa/ (273)se 'khu1 lnga ba/ (273)se 'bru nyer lnga/ (274)se 'bru dwangs gnas/ (274)se 'bru pad ma 'dab brgyad/ (274)se 'bru bzhi ba/ (274)seng ldeng nyer lnga/ (274)sro lo bzhi thang / (275)srog 'dzin bcu gcig (275)sle tres bdun thang / (275〉sle tres sum thang / (tsho5)gser mdog lnga ba/ (275)gser mdog bcu gcig (276)gso byed nyi dkyil/ (276〉bsam 'phel nor bu/ (276)bse ru nyer lnga/ ya (277)a gar brgyad pa/ (tshi7)a gar bco lnga/ (277)16

a gar nyi shu/ (277)a gar so lnga/ (278)a ru bcu ba/ (278)a ru bco brgyad/ (278)zur rdzuṭ+wāṃb/ dun pa/ (278)gcig sman sbyor las sgos kyi sman rdzas 'dul sbyong gi la/ 2byi~X/zur r+sha/kā// rin chen ril bu'i rigs gtong tshul mgyogs bsduX/skabs bzhi pa/ span dzis kyi par ris/ /༵༵ṭ+wāṃrdo

skabs dang po/ nad rigs gso bcos kyi lag len/rlung gi nad/rlung gi nad ces pa ni lus la rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rlung mtshan nyid drug ldan de phyi nang gi rkyen ci rigs kyi dbang gis nad kyi ngo bor rnam par gyur te lus la gnod par byed pa'i phyir de la rlung gi nad ces bya'o//nad kyi 'byung rkyen/slong rkyen mya ngan sems las mi snyan gtam/ /mtshan gnyid med dang 'jigs pa'i bya spyod sogs/ /yid la 'khrugs pa ster ba'i phyogs kun dang / /khyad par 'byung gdon spyi dang rgyal po yis/ /rgyab bsten byas nas mngon tshul sna tshogs ston/ /nad kyi rtags/'phar rtsa'i rgyu ba stong zhing khar rkyal ba dang / chu sngo la dwangs pa/lce skam zhing dmar la rtsub pa/ gnas gcig nas sdod mi tshugs par 'gro 'dod pa/ shus 'debs dbugs ring gtong ba/ shes pa yang zhing 'phyo ba/ mgo yu 'khor zhing rna ba 'ur ba/ gzer nges med du 'pho ba/ lus grang zhing brtse ba/ yan lag rengs shing 'khums pa/ rus /nga

chag snyam byed pa/ spu brtse la phrum ser khyer ba/ mtshan mo gnyid mi yong ba/ g.yal 'dar dang bya rmyang yang yang byed pa/ tshig pa za ba/dpyi rked dang rus tshigs na ba/ ltag pa dang mur 'gram gzer ba/rlung gsang gi gnas rnams mnan na na ba/ stong skyug byed cing tho rengs wu sob lu ba/ khong ba sbo 'khrog byed pa bcas yin/gso thabs dngos/rus bcud gsum gyi khu ba'am rus pa sna tshogs gdus pa'i khu bar spod sga dang shing kun kha ru tsha sgog skya btab ste btang bas rlung la mchog tu phan pa dang / gzhan yang dza ti bcu bzhi dang / shing kun nyer lnga/ a gar so lnga sogs gtong dgos la/dpyad du spyi gtsug dang / an stong tshigs pa dang po/ drug pa/bdun pa/ dkar nag mtshams rnams su me btsa' gdab dgos/mkhris pa'i nad/mkhris pa'i nad ces pa ni lus kyi me drod kyi khams snum bcas rno zhing tsha ba dang / dri mnam 'khru gsher gyi mtshan nyid zur bdun ldan de rnam par gyur pa nad kyi ngo bor gnas pa ni mkhris pa'i nad yin no//nad kyi 'byung rkyen/don snod kyi gnas su mtshon phog ste lus zungs 'grams pa dang /zas skom tsha skyur dang chang sogs thal drags pa/ rgyud la zhe sdang drag 2

po skyes pa/ nad kyi dug phog pa/ 'khrugs las ches drags pa sogs kyis mkhris nad slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/rtsa'i rgyu ba phra zhing ngo bo grims par 'phar ba/ dri chu'i mdog ser la rnyog pa/ mig sprin dang lag mthil/ mur gong lce 'og rnams ser shas che ba/ mkhris pa 'khru skyug dang za 'phrug byed/ skom dad che zhing rngul chu 'byung / kha la ro kha ba bro/ nub gnyid chung zhing bshang ba'i mdog ser/ nyi 'od dang sha chang mar rnying sogs gnod pa ni mkhris nad kyi rtags yin/gso thabs dngos/mkhris las rnam rgyal/ bong dkar bcu gsum/ gser tig kha tshar can/ tig ta lnga thang sogs bsten dgos la/ sgos su mkhris pa snod babs la bshal gyi lag len mchog tu bsngags pa yin/bad kan gyi nad/bad kan gyi nad ces pa ni ngo bo lci rtul bsil ba sogs mtshan nyid bdun ldan tha mal du gnas pa de rnam par gyur te lus la gnod par byed pa la bad kan gyi nad ces zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/slong rkyen kha mngar lci bsil sdum bsten drags/ /'grangs hūm̐s

dal bar bsdad dang nyin gnyid log /rlan steng nyal dang chur zhugs gos srab 'khyags/ /gro sran gser thog bser can sungs pa dang / /ra skom sha rid tshil bu 'bru mar dang / /rtsi mar rul ba lo shur la phug ras/ /ri sgog la sogs rjen zas mtha' dag dang / /ma tshos pa dang tshig po khengs po'i zas/ /ba ra'i 'o ma zho dar chu grang ja/ /bza' btung ches te tshad las 'das pa'am/ /snga ma ma zhu phyi ma zos pa yi/ /rkyen de rnams kyis bad kan grang nad slong / /nad kyi rtags/rtsa bying la 'phar stobs chung ba/ dri chu'i mdog dkar la dri rlangs chung ba/ lce rnyil skya la ro mi gsal ba/ mig sprin dkar zhing skrangs pa/snabs lud mang zhing mgo bo 'thom pa/ lus sems lci la dang ga mi bde ba/ zas skom 'ju stobs chung la lus drod med pa/ mkhal rked mi bde la lus kyi bye brag 'ga' zhig tu wa ba skye ba/ rtsam pa dang bad kan skyug cing 'khru ba/ dran pa mi gsal zhing gnyid che la sgyid pa skyur ba/nam zhod che dus dang / srod dang snga dro'i dus/ zos thog de nyid du nad ldang ba/ zas lci bsil dang / spyod lam rlan steng nyal ba/ lus po 'khyags pa'i rigs kyis khyad par du na ba yin na bad kan gyi nad yine+e par nges so/ /

gso thabs dngos/rgyam tshwa bzhi thang / se 'bru lnga ba/ se 'bru dwangs gnas/ phyi rgyud rgod ma kha/ zas sman bcu ba sogs bsten rgyu dang /gzhan yang dpyad du lan tshwa dang / bong nga / g.yi spyang sogs kyi pags pa'i spu me la bsros pa'i dugs bsten pa dang nad shin tu rgyas na tshigs pa gsum pa dang / bcu gnyis/ mdun gyi lten dang me mnyam gsang rnams su spra mes bcos par bya'o/ /khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad/khyab rgyu rlung dang khrag gnyis bsdongs shing 'khrugs te stod du 'tshangs pa la khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi nad zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/lus sems 'khrugs pa'i bya ba byas pa'am/ yang na chang mang du 'thung ba/ drag po'i las byas pa sogs kyis khrag ngan gyi kha bslangs te rlung khrag mnyam du 'khrugs par byed/nad kyi rtags/〈long sprul zin tig〉phros/ rtsa chu sogs rlung gzhir bzhag gi thog dbugs 'tshangs/ ro stod mdun rgyab sbrags pa'am rgyab ngos gzer che/ skabs rer bde zhing skabs rer thu ba res mos byed pa nad rtags yin/ zhes gsungs/

mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈kong sprul zin tig〉phros/ deng sang dus dbang gis 'di na mkhan mang zhing gdon rgyab che bas na lugs dang nad rtags sna tshogs 'byung zhing ngos zin par dka' bas/ gzer mig steng rtsam pa byug na cung zhi ba snyam byed na nges pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang〈〈man ngag lhan thabs〉phros/ bye brag khrag shas che na gzer che zhing / /rlung shas che na stod du 'tshangs phul che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar brtag pa'ang gal che bar sems/gso thabs dngos/ko byi bcu gsum/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ ar brgyad kha tshar can/ a gar so lnga/ srog 'dzin nor bu sogs zab par mthong ngo / /grang mkhris kyi nad/mkhris pa snod du babs pa la grang mkhris kyi nad zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/snod kyi mkhris pa 'grams pa'am/ zas skom tsha skyur sogs mi 'phrod pa'i zas dang ma zhu ba/ lhag par zhe sdang skyes pa sogs kyis slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtasas/6 bsil drod kyi phan gnod mi tshor/ pho ba gzer zhing 'khrog kha kha/

zhe ldog kha zas ci zos kyang mi zhu ba yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈man ngag lhan thabs〉phros/ me drod 'ju stobs chung la chu ni dkar/ /mig sprin lce 'og rna rgyab ser por 'gro/ /khyad par bshang ba dkar po mi 'gyur rtags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/dwangs gnas/ gser zhi kha sprod/ brag khyung / gser mdog lnga ba sogs 'phrod/bad kan srug po'i nad/bad kan dang khrag mkhris rlung dang bzhi ga lhan gcig tu 'dus pa'i nad cig la 'dus nad smug po'am bad kan smug po'i nad ces zer ba yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/〈〈man ngag lhan thabs〉phros/ tsha rkyen 'grams khrag lhag dang mtshon khrag lus/ /tsha skyur zas kyis khrag mkhris 'phel las byung / /grang rkyen me mnyam 'ju byed mthu nyams pas/ /ma zhu rgyu byas bad kan grang shas shād/ /ṭātrī ///ngas so/ / pho mchin dang ro rgyab gzer/ skabs su mgo bo sogs nges med 7du

na/ brang tsha la chu skyur skyug pa/ khrag rul dud khu 'khru skyug byedacipa/ dri ma smug la skam pa sha yi ril ma 'dra bar ma zad/ 'grangs ltogs dang grang dros gang gi skabs su'ang na ba bcas yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/rgyud las rnam 'gyur bcu gsum du gsungs na'ang mdor bsdus nas smros na/ dang po 'jug dus chu tshan chu skyur skyug pa dang / bar du smin nas ser po rgya bshal skyug pa/ tha mar rgyas nas khrag rul dud khu skyug pa bcas yin/gso thabs dngos/ dang po chu tshan tshu skyur skyug pa'i skabs smug po tsha ba yin pas sman la thang chen nyer lnga/ smug po g.yul rgyal/ bdud rtsi lnga sbyor/ ma nu bzhi thang sogs bzang /bar du rgya bshal skyug pa'i skabs tsha grang 'thab pa'i dus yin pas sman snga ma rnams dang / khyad par g.yu dril bcu gsum dang / ru rta drug pa/ zla shel chen mo/ zla bdud/ ka ru kha sbyor sogs zab/tha ma khrag rul dud khu skyug pa'i skabs yongs su 'dus pa yin pas thog mar khrag lam chod ma chod phyed pa gnad che zhing / zungs zad rgas pa khrag lam ma chod na glang chen bcu gsum la kha che dang dom mkhris kha tshar byed cing / gzhan yang thang chen nyer lnga la kha che gur 8

gum 'dab log bsnan pas gcod dgos/ khrag chod na'ang rlung gis khrid nas skya rbab dang chu gzhir 'gyur nyen che bas da li bcu drug dang /lcags phye bco lnga/ se 'bru dwangs gnas/ zla shel chen mo sogs nad bab dang bstun nas gtong dgos/ mi 'phrod pa'i zas spyod rgyun ring gzab pa gnad che ba yin/mkhris pa'i rdo skran gyi nad/stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis/ rgyu ni ma zhu ba las byung / /lus kyi phyi nang gang rung du/ /sra mkhregs gong 'bur 'dril ba la/ /skran nad ces su bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gtso bo dwangs ma ma zhu ba mchin par gnas pa'i khrag gi snyigs ma de snod mkhris su lhungs sam babs pas ma zhu ba'i stobs kyis mkhris khu shin tu sdi bar gyur pa dang / rtsi ltar chags te 'dril ba ni snod kyi mkhris skran na/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu ma zhu bad kan khrag mkhris bcas la rkyen ni sngon gyi las ngan sad pa dang / gdon gyis 'tshe ba/ 'grams 'khrugs dang brlan gsher sogs yin/nad kyi rtags/spyir sha mdog sngo la cung skam pa tsam las rtags gzhan cher mi 9

mngon pa dang / zas la dang ga yod kyang zhag can rigs shas che ba dang / zas 'grangs drags pa'i rjes cung na zug ldang bar ma zad lus shed kyang zhan pa yin/ rdo hril bo gcig yin na na zug cher mi ldang la/rdo phran bu mang po 'dus pa yin na skabs 'phral du na zug chen po yod pa ma zad lus yongs za 'phrug byed/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈man ngag lhan thabs〉lkes/ snod kyi mkhris skran sha mdog sngo la skam/ /zas len gyur kyang shed bral mig chu ser/ /smin nas lus kun za 'phrug byed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/se 'bru dwangs gnas/ gar nag bcu ba/ skran 'joms/ mkhris rtsi chen mo/ zhi byed nyer dgu sogs bsten dgos/mtshin pa'i khrag skyan gyi nad/dwangs ma ma zhu bar mchin par khrag ngan rgyas pas mchin pa'i gsham du khrag gi zil ba chags pa de stobs cher rgyas pa'i mchin pa khrag skran du 'dril ba la zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas ma zhu ba dang / 'grams 'khrugs/ tsha skyur sogs yun ring du bsten pa las 'byung ba yin/10

nad kyi rtags/'phel ba myur zhing g.yas logs nas rim par chags pa/ mig cung zad ser la chu mdog dmar zhing rtsa mgyogs par 'phar ba lus ha cang grang ba dang dros pa'i tshe na ro rgyab dang mchin dri sbrags te na ba/ sha mdangs sngo zhing skam la chu nal bo skyug pa/ skran de rgyas nas mkhris yul phrogs te mig dang chu mdog sngar bas ser por 'gro ba yin/mi dzhar ba'i rtags/〈〈phan bde bsil zer spro ba'i zla zer〉phros/ lar phyi skran dngos su mthong zhing / bar span lto stong la lag pas myong bas rig pa dang /glo mchin mcher skran gsang sar gzer ba'o/ /zhes dang / tsha skran chu ni dmar la me 'od chags/ /steng na dwangs ma chags dang tshigs ma med/ /mi nor rtags su khrag rul ra gzhob bro/ /tsha skran phyi yul nyams chung drod rtags tshang / /nad 'di phal cher mchin pa'i rtags su babs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/man ngag cong zhi bsil sbyor/ man rgyud gur gum bcu ba dang se 'bru brgyad pa ltag pa sprad pa dang / gur gum bcu gsum/ brag zhun bdun pa/ g.yu rnying cur nis sogs rigs pas 'phrul shes par bya/rjes su ru thung dang snod ka mang du gtar zhing khrag tshad nyung ngu byu/1

bar bya dgos/lgang pa'i rdo skyan gyi nad/dwangs ma ma zhu bar sgang pa'i rtsa mig tu 'grims pa chus drod kyis btsos pa rlung gis bsgril te de'ur gyur pa la sgang pa'i rdo skran zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas ma zhu ba dang / 'grams 'khrugs/ rlan dang grang ba sogs kyis bskyed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/dri chu 'gags la zug gzer che ba yin/ skabs su dri chu'i mdog dmar po 'byung yang srid/ kan rkyal du nyal nas gcin btang na gtong thub pa'ang yod pa yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈yan lag brgyad pa'i gzhung las bsdus pa nor bu'i 'phreng ba〉〉las/ sgang pa'i skran ni chu bsgag gzer/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dri chu 'gags la zug gzer che ba'o /gso thabs dngos/se 'bru lnga ba/ ze tshwa bdun pa/ skran 'joms sogs shis la/gzhan yang rdo skran chung ngu yin na chu 'thung ste drag shul gyi las maṭ+wāṃngs rgyugs sogs byas na gcin lam nas thon pa'ang yod/

glo ba skya zab kyi nad/gong sman pa'i〈〈pod dmar〉phros/ lus kyi stobs dang drod nyams pas/ /pags mdog skya bor gyur pa dang / /mkhar brgyad rbab rbab skrangs pa'i phyir/ /chu nad skya rbab ces su bshad/ /ces skya rbab glo bar babs te glo mang ba la glo ba skya rbab kyi nad zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/ji skad du/ zas dang spyod lam mi 'phrod pas/ /ma zhu mkhris 'khrugs rlung gis gtor/ /lus kun khyab pas bad kan dang / /chu ser skyes nas skrangs pa yin/ /zhes so/ /nad kyi rtags/nad 'di dang por mngon dus kha dang gdong ba mig lcibs dang /rkang pa'i bol dang ngar gdong sogs rbob par g.yo zhing spangs pa dang /'gul tshe rngam pa 'degs pa dang / snying sprug pa/ lce dang mchu rnyil sogs kyi bkrag mdangs 'chor ba/ lus stobs je zhan du 'gro zhing shin tu ngal ba/ glo mang zhing lud pa'i nang khrag cung zad 'dres la sob pa bcas so /mi nor ba'i rtags/sman bsdus〈kusle〉〉pas/ skya rbab ni kha gdong mig lcibs rkang bol ngar gdong g.yo/ /'gul na rngam 'degs snying sprug dang ga 'gag 13/skya

rbab la glo mang na glo skya rbab/ /ces gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/se 'bru lnga ba da lis kha tshar can/ rgun 'brum bcu ba/ glo tshad kun sel/ da li bcu drug a gar so lnga sogs 'phrod pa dang /dpyad du rgyud las/ rjes la dang po bcu gsum bco brgyad bsreg /ces dang / phyag rdor mgon pos/ dpyad ni tshigs pa bcu gnyis dang //lte ba'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su bsreg /gong 'og tshon re'i sar yang bsreg /ces so/ /mchin pa skya rbab kyi nad/gtso bo lus kyi stobs dang drod nyams pas chu yi mkhar brgyad g.yo zhing skrangs pa zhes chu nad skya rbab nyid mchin pa dang bsdongs pa la mchin pa skya rbab kyi nad ces zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/ji skad du/ zas dang spyod lam mi 'phrod pas/ /ma zhu mkhris 'khrugs rlung gis gtor/ /lus kun khyab pas bad kan nad/ /chu ser skyes nas skrangs pa yin/ /zhes so/ /nad kyi rtags/nad 'di dang por mngon dus kha dang gdong ba mig lcibs dang /rkaṭ+wāṃ4 ba'i bol dang ngar gdong sogs rbob par g.yo zhing skrangs pa dang /

'gul tshe rngam pa 'degs pa dang / snying sprug pa/ lce dang mchu rnyil sogs kyi bkrag mdangs 'chor ba/ lus stobs je zhan du 'gro zhing shispya tu ngal ba/ mig sprin dang sha mdangs/ dri chu rnams ser por 'ong ba ṭ+wāṃ /nor ba'i rtags/sman bsdus〈pos〉〉pas/ skya rbab ni kha gdong mig lcibs rkang bol ngar gdong g.yo/ /'gul na rngam 'degs snying sprug dang ga 'gag /mig chu ser na mchin pa skya rbab/ /ces gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/se 'bru dwangs gnas/ lcags phye bco lnga/ da li bcu drug gur gum lnga ba sogs bsten dgos/dpyad du rtse chung dang ru thung gtar ba dang rjes la tshigs pa bcu gsum pa dang dgu ba me yis bsreg dgos/grang 'or gyi nad/de'u dmar bas/ ma zhu dwangs snyigs 'dres pa de/ /zungs su ma smin mchin lam shor/ /sha pags bar khyab chu nad la/ /'or nad ces bshad phyi chu yin/ /de nyid ma ldog don snod du/ /shor na nang chu'am dmu chu yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /15

nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu bad kan skabs bshad pa ltar dang / rkyen la rnam pa gsum ste/1 zas kyis bskyed pa ni/ kha zas ma zhu dwangs snyigs 'dres pa mchin gnas zungs su ma smin par khrag ngan 'phel zhing rgyas pa de nyid sha pags la byer bas chu ser de 'or du lhung ste g.yo bar gyur pa/2 dus kyis bskyed pa ni/ skya rbab ma bcos par dus las 'das te rnying par gyur pa las byung ba/3 rkyen gyis bskyed pa ni/ nad kun bcos nyes pa las bskyed pa'am yang na nad 'khrugs par gyur pa las byung ba/nad kyi rtags/lus dang yan lag ngal zhing sgyid lug pa dang me drod chung zhing kha zas mi 'ju ba/ dang ga 'gag pa/ lus kun g.yo skrangs byed pa/ khyad par gdong dang / rkang bol/ brang gsus/ chu so rnams skrangs shing sha dang pags pa'i bar rnams chu ser gyis khengs nas 'og tu gang bcug pa de phyogs yon por skrangs pa dang / lus po grang zhing grang tshe mi bde ba/ skrangs pa de'ang nyin par che la mtshan mor chung ba yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈gso rig dgos pa kun 'byung〉phros/ bad kan lus grang 'grangs na mi bde la/ /skrangs pa nyin che mtshan mo chung ba yin/ /zhes 16

gsungs pa'i steng spyi rtags tshang bar yod pa yin/gso babs dngos/se 'bru bzhi ba/ gur gum bdun pa/ se 'bru lnga ba/ dwangs ma chu 'dren sogs bsten dgos pa yin/gzhan byugs bcos te/ 〈'gos pa kun 'byung〉phros/ dur byid thar nu shu dag stag sha dang / /sman chen chu rtsa bul tog khyi lce dang / /brag zhun re lcag dud pa cha gcig la/ /rgya zhun sga tig gang rnyed zhib btags la/ /rjen che'i gtso bo gsang sman khu ba sbyar/ /legs byugs nyi mas bsregs pas skya rbab dang / /'or nad dmu chu dreg grum chu ser dang / /rtsa dkar gza' nad rengs 'khums ma lus 'joms/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mamin pa'i zags chu'i nad/dwangs ma ma zhu bar 'grams khrag mchin par lhung nas mchin pa khrag gis cher rgyas pas drod shor zhing rul ba mchin pa'i zags chu'i nad yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas sogs ma zhu ba dang / bshal rjes zas spyod log pa/ tsha rjes gtar ma 'phrod pa/ bsil spyong thal ches pa/ ngal dub rjes la chu mang btung ba/ rlan steng nyal ba la sogs pa me drod nyams pa'i rkyen sogs 17

kyis bskyed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/dang po 'jug dus dang bar du chu ru smin pa/ tha ma rgyas pa'i rtags rnams spyi ltar la/ de las gzhan gzhogs g.yas na 'phel ba dang rtsa grims la chu mdog dmar zhing khyad par chu de phug na rgya bshal lta bu 'byung / gsus pa che la rtsa gsal ba dang yan lag rnams kyang skam pa'i rtags 'byung /mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po〉phros/ mchin pa chu shor rgyu mar lhung //gdong ba dang ni yan lag skrangs/ /gsus pa che zhing rngul ba 'ong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gso thabs dngos/se 'bru dwangs gnas/ da li bcu drug bde byed chu bsgyur/ lcags phye bco lnga/ bde byed snyoms ldan sogs nad bab dang bstun nas gtong shes dgos/ gzhan yang tsha chu'i rigs yin na/ snying bo bsdus pa las/ tsha chu grang chur ma bsgyur na/ /dbyug skam bkug na chag pa bzhin/ /glo bur nad pa 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes nges par du grang chur bsgyur nas gso bcos bya dgos/ de rjes dang po pho ba'i me drod gso ba/ gnyis pa lam nas sbyong ba/ gsum pa skem gyi sbyor ba/ bzhi ba phyi 18

rjes gcad dgos pa yin/gcong chen zad byed kyi nad/bu ga'i rgyu lam 'khrugs nas dwangs ma ma smin par dri mar gyur ṭ+wāṃs sbyas kyi ṭ+wāṃg zungs bdun zad de skam pa la spyir gcong nad zad d+nghad shādro trī rte/byu/nga rkyen/yan lag brgyad pa las/ drag shul bsten dang shugs bkag dang //khu chu dwangs ma snum zad dang / /kha skom cho ga dang bral bsten/ /bzhi bo de dag de yi rgyu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nad kyi rtags/cham pas 'debs shing sbrid pa mang ba/ zas kyi ro mi tshor ba/ lus kyi nyams stobs zhan pa/ pho ba'i me drod chung zhing snying 'phar ba/ rkang ba'i bol gong dang ngar gdong skrangs pa/ mig mdangs dkar zhing bud med dang sha chang la sred pa/ mgo dang rkang bar nyi ma phog na mi bzod pa/ zas skom gang bsten dus lus la rngul 'du ba/ skra sen ring bor skye zhing mtshan mo rmi lam mang ba/ lud pa mang zhing dbugs mi bde ba/phrag pa dang mgo bo na ba/ skad 'gags yi ga 'chus pa/ rtsib log gzer zug gtong ba/ zas 'khru skyug dang stug pa skam pa bcas so/ /19

mi nor ba'i rtags/(zla zed+kulas/ de'i rnam grangs ni cham pa dang / lud pa dang /dbugs mi bde ba dang / phrag pa na ba dang / spyi bo na ba dang / skad 'gag dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / bshang ba sla ba dang / rtug skam dang rlon pa dang / rtsib logs zug pa dang / rims te bcu gcig po de dag ni zad byed kyi nad yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dajas/gso rig rgyud bzhi las gsungs pa ltar sdum 'chos dang rus snying /bdud rtsi lngas dugs byas la po so cha dang 'o ma sbyar bas skyug tu gzhug cing / dur byid dang dong gas sbyangs pa byas rjes me drod bskyed pa'i sman sbyor gang 'os dang bcud len gyi rigs gang zab bsten dgos par ma zad/ mdor na gcong chen me drod nyams pa yi/ /'khru ba lus zungs 'joms phyir bsrung ba gces/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gso dgos so/ /ma smin tsha ba'i nad/de yang thog mar bad rlung dang bsdongs zlar gyur nas rlung gis tsha ba de lus zungs yongs la gtor ba dang / bad kan gyis tsha ba'i mgo mnan nas tsha ba bsdongs zla phye ma thub pa dper na/ shing rlon pa la 'phral du me sbar mi nus par me'i sngon du ba 'byung ba ltar/ tsha ba rang 20

nyid skye zhing smin pa'i shugs ma rdzogs pa'i skabs der tsha ba ma smin pa zhes zer/nadasnyekyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu ni bad kan dang rlung yin la de bskyed par byed pa'i rkyen gsum ste/ rang bzhin gyis ma smin pa/ nad khams kyis ma smin pa/rkyen gyi sgo nas ma smin pa'o/ /zhib rgyas gzhung gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /nad kyi rtags/rtsa rgyud phra zhing g.yo la mgyogs pa/ chu mdog dmar ser bska la rnyogs ma can 'byung ba dang / lce mdog skya la steng du rlung 'brum dmar chung 'byung ba/ lus drod mi snyoms pa dang srod dus sha drod che ba/ g.yal mang zhing sgyid pa skyur ba/ bya rmyang byed cing kha kha/ mgo na ba/ byin pa'i lha dang tshigs gzhi rnams na/ lus grang shum byed cing me nyi la dga' snang skyes/ rmi lam du za zi mang la sems las che ba sogs 'byukā /nor ba'i rtags/sman bsdus〈〈e〉〉pas/ ma smin tsha ba zhes/ tshigs gzhi na/ grang shum byed/ srod la na che zhing sha drod che/ g.yal dang bya rmyang thes byed pa de bad rlung dang ldan pa'i rtags zhes gsungs so/ /21

gso jibs dngos/nor bu bdun thang / ma nu bzhi thang / a gar bco lnga/ a gar so lnga sogs skabs bstun byas te gtong dgos/ dpyad du pho bar dugs bya mthil bzhi byug dgos/gzhan yang gso rig dgos pa kun 'byung las/ smin rtags lce steng dkar ser rlung 'brum med/ /rtsa stong rgyug cing rtsa smad dma' la grims/ /chu mdog dmar ser ku ya ling gis 'dril/ /bsil 'dod lus la dri 'byung dbang bo g.yung / /khyad par grang shum chad na smin pa ste/ /'bud byed me shing zad pa'i me dang 'dra/ /gso ba'i dus yin de las thal mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sgrim dgos la/ thal ba'am bcos nyes su gyur na/ gab pa/ rnyings pa/ rgyas pa/ stongs pa/ rnyogs sdur gyur pa sogs 'byung nges pas na gzab par byed pa gal che ba — na/ rgyas tshad kyi nad/tsha ba rang gi ngo bo la bdarlung gi grogs dang bral bas nad smin zhing tsha ba'i rang stobs kyi shugs rdzogs nas bsdongs zla med pa rkyang ba'i tsha ba me rgyas pa lta bu des lus zungs sreg par byed pa la rgyas pa'i tsha ba zhes zer/

nad kyi 'byung rkyen/nad gzhi'i mkhris pa mtshan nyid bdun ldan rnam par ma gyur pa tha mal du gnas pa de rgyas par byed pa'i rkyen ni gsum yod de/ rang bzhin du rgyas pa/ dus kyis rgyas pa/ rkyen gyis rgyas pa'o/ /zhib rgyas gso rig gi gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /nad kyi rtags/rtsa rgyud sbom la drag pa/ 'bur la 'dril ba/ mkhrang la grims pa/myur la mgyogs par 'phar zhing / chu mdog dmar ser la dri mnam pa/rlangs pa che ba/ lud pa dmar ser dang dud khu mang du lu ba/ dbugs thung ba dang gzer drag la kha skam zhing so dreg chags pa/ lus byings lci ba/ dang ga mi bde zhing skom dad che ba/ snying 'gags la bsil 'dod pa/ lus la rngul dri mnam pa/ khyad par rims rgyas pa yin na mgo na la za zi mang ba 'byung ngo / /mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ rtsa ni mkhrang drag mgyogs pa ste/ /chu dmar dri mnam rlangs pa che/ /lud pa dmar ser dud khur lu/ /kha skam so la dreg nag chags/ /dbugs thung gzer drag skom dad che/ /dang ga mi bde lus po lci/ /snying la grang 'dod bsil la dga'/ /grang shum chad nas gzer ba de/ /rgyas pa'i tsha bar the tshom med/ /ces 23

gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gso thabs dngos/ji skad du/ rgyas tshad dus las 'da' mi rung / /ma 'das pa la bsad pa gces/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gtso bo'i sman la gtso brgyad g.yu ral ma/ sprin bral zla zer/ thang chen nyer lnga kha tshar can/ gi wang dgu ba/ a gar so lnga sogs bsten shes par bya dgos/dpyad du〈〈gso rig dgos pa kun 'byung〉phros/ skyugs na bsrung zhing ligs na lcag gis bskul/ /nad dngos 'don byed gso dpyad gtso bo yin/ /'grams 'khrugs khrag ngan rtsa dang don la lhag /de'i phyir gso dpyad gtso bo gtar ba yin/ /gang rgyas rtsa dang gang babs rtsa la gtar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lag len du thebs par bya'o/ /stongs tshad kyi nad/tsha ba bri zhing slar rlung gis sbar ba la ngo bo'i cha nas stongs pa dang / rtags kyi cha nas tsha bar ston pas na stongs pa'i tshad pa zhes bya'o/ /nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu rlung yin la rkyen rang bzhin rkyen dang gnas kyis stongs pa'i tshul mang yang ngo bo ni gtso cher bsil gtar rngul dbyung zas skom yen la gtad pa sogs kyis tshad pa'i gnya' chag nas slar rlung skyes te tshad 24

pa'i gzhug 'bud par byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/dri chu'i mdog dmar zhing dwangs la wu ba che ba dang / rtsa rgyud stong la rgyugs pa/ dbugs sna thung zhing rngam pa rgod pa/ lus kyi phyi la tsha ba che zhing mig sprin dmar la rna ba 'ur/ lce dmar zhing skam la rtsub pa/gzer 'pho zhing skom dad che la mig rtsa grung / sna bug har la nyin mtshan gang la yang gnyid chung zhing skabs rer dngangs pa/ lus kyi ba spu langs shing rlung gsang rnams mnan na na la gtam 'chal dang g.yal stong mang / shes pa 'phyo zhing mig dpangs mtho ba sogs kyi rtags yod/mi 'byur ba'i rtags/sman bsdus〈〈e〉phros/ stongs pa spyi yi mtshan nyid ni/ /'dug snying mi 'dod 'dug sa spo/ /'phur ba snyam byed g.yang la 'phyo/ /snying mi dga' zhing 'tshig pa za/ /mi nor ci mthong snying mi sdug /zas kyi ro la tshor ba med/ /lus la ci reg tsher phung bskyur ba 'dra/ /skom dad res che res chung byed/ /dbugs rgod rna ba gzer ba dang / /'ur 'ur seng seng zer ba ni/ /stongs pa spyi yi mtshan nyid yin/ /zhes dang /〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ de ltar stongs tshad rigs mang yang //khyad par mi 'gyur ngos 'dzin rtags/ /ji ltar tsha yang shes pa yang 2/5 /

rlung gsang gnas su mnan mi bzod/ /bsil gyis mi phan tshad rtags skye/ /rlung gsang phyed cing a long grang / /stongs pa'i tsha ba yin par nges/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/sprin bral zla zer/ a gar bco lnga/ srog 'dzin brgyad pa/ a gar so lnga/ srog 'dzin bcu gcig sogs bsten rgyu dang / dpyad du tshigs pa dang po dang drug bdun mes mnan/ mar gsar gyis bsku mnye bya/gzhan yang〈〈gso rig dgos pa kun 'byung〉phros/ rlung stongs spyon pa lam la 'jug pa'i thabs/ /spyi gtsug dang po drug bdun dkar nag dang / /bya rog la sogs hor gyi me btsa'i bdug /rlung gsang rnams su zhun mar bsku mnye bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bcos dgos so/ /gab tshad kyi nad/phyi grang ba ltar snang yang nang du tsha ba grang ba'i 'og tu mi mngon pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa la gab tshad ces bya'o/ /nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu ni rnam par ma gyur pa'i bad kan dang rlung yin la/ rkyen ni tsha ba de nyid yul dus rang bzhin na tshod sogs rlung gi rkyen dang 'phrad pa dang / pho ba dang / mkhal ma/ snying sogs bad rlung gi gnas su tsha ba zhugs pa dang / yang na bad rlung shas che ba'i tsha ba de nyid ma smin 26

par gnyen pos bcos sngas pa dang / bad kan gyi ri thang mtshams su bcud bsten sngas pa sogs ni gab tshad kyi rkyen yin no/ /nad kyi rtags/sman bsdus〈ku'e〉〉pas/ gab pa spyi yi mtshan nyid ni/ /lus lci shes pa bying ba dang / /tsha ba rtag tu tsha ba dang / /khyad par srod la tsha ba dang / /ba spu nyal dang shed nyams chung / /yi ga mi bde shes pa bying / /dbang bo myos shing dran pa med/ /zas skom grang mo 'dod snyam byed/ /rtsa dpangs dma' zhing gting na rgyug /chu ni dmar ser gur gu ma mdog /skyi bar byung na tshad pa'i rtags/ /dri ma skam zhing mnam dku che/ /bsil drod dag la 'dar zhing grang shum byed/ /res 'ga' rna ba 'ur zhing rlung rtags 'dra/ /gab pa'i tshad pa'i rtags rnams so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mi dzhar ba'i rtags/〈〈kong sprul zin tig〉phros/ gting du tsha ba gab pa la bad rlung gi rtags ston/ khyad par pho mkhal snying gsum la gab na khrag rlung dang nor nyen yod pas zhib tu brtag pa gal che/ de'i rtags ni rtsa dal yang gting grims/ chu sngo dkar la ldog skyen zhing ku ya ling gis 'dril/bsil drod gang yang 'phral 'phrod pa ltar snang yang btud na gnod na nges pa yin zhes gsungs/27

gso thabs dngos/snying la gab na a gar rigs/ pho bar gab na se 'bru'i rigs/mkhal mar gab na a ru bcu ba/ gur gum bcu ba sogs drod ldan bsten pas dang po bad rlung la slebs pas phan/ bar du bad rlung thal bas phan gnod med/ mthar gting tshad la slebs pas drod kyis gnod cing tshad rtags mngon gyur byung dus tshad bcos gong gsal byed ces kong sprul zin tig las gsungs so/ /rnyings tshad kyi nad/tshad pa'i nad kyi dus yun 'gyur tshul la bltos nas btags pa'i ming ste/ rkyen gsum(rang bzhin gyis rnyings pa/ rkyen gyis rnyings pa/sbyong ba dman pas rnyings pa)gang rung gis tsha ba lo zla 'das nas lus kyi zungs su 'dres shing zhen pas gting nas 'don dka' ba lta bu yun ring du lon pa'i nad cig la tsha ba rnyings pa zhes bshad pa yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rnyings tshad kyi rgyu ni lo dang zla ba lon pa yin la de yang zla ba gcig phan 'das pa dus kyi rnyings pa yin zhing skyed par byed pa'i rkyen ni gsum yin pa ste/ rang bzhin gyis rnyings pa/ rkyen gyis rnyings pa/sbyor ba dman pas rnyings pa bcas yin/ zhib rgyas gso rig gi gzhung tshad ldan dag las shes par bya'o/ /28

nad kyi rtags/〈〈kong sprul zin tig〉phros/ lus sems ljid/ gzer phran nges med ldang / rtsa rgyud phra la gting grims/ chu mdog nges pa med cing dri dang bro ba che/ ldog dka' zhing log na ku ya mthug stod khengs shing mgo dang rus tshigs skabs su na/ rlung dang bsdongs na rlung rtags thor bu'ang 'byung ba yin no/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/(gso rig dgos pa kun 'byung〉las/ rtags ni gdong snum mig chu dmar/ /rtsa grims skabs su chu ser 'byung / /ro stod tsha la rngul kha snyi/kha skam sngo la dreg chung chags/ /bsil grib snyeg cing grang mo 'dod/ /nyi ma'i gung dang srod la na/ /gnyid che drod bag rjes la ldang / /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/gting 'don nyer lnga/ man rgyud shing sna brgyad pa/ sle tres lnga thang /thang chen nyer lnga/ a gar so lnga/ a gar brgyad pa/ a gar bco lnga sogs nad rtags dang bstun nas gso bcos bya dgos/ mi 'phrod pa'i zas spyod lo zla'i bar du gzab pa gal che/rnyogs tshad kyi nad/ngo bo rlung khrag chu ser gsum 'dus pa'i nad de/ dpe chu dīg

rnyogs sam bye chab g.yos pa bzhin nad la bcos nyes pas nad dang lus zungs 'dres par byas pa'i phyir rnyogs tshad ces bshad pa yin te/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ rnyogs tshad ma smin tshad pa'i rigs/ /sman dpyad zas spyod bsten sngas pas/ /bad kan bskyed de me drod 'chor/ /rlung skyed tsha ba rtsa mig byer/ /rlung gis khrag g.yos chu ser skyes/ /kha thal bad kan ri thang mtshams/ /bsil drag pho ba'i me shi bas/ /de nyid grang chur 'gyur ba'ang yod/ /rlung khrag chu ser 'dus ba'i nad/ /chu rnyogs bye chab g.yos dang 'dra/ /bcos sngas rnyogs phyir rnyogs tshad ces/ /ming du btags pas go bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu chu ser yin pa la rkyen rang bzhin chu ser shas che ba'i rigs la tsha ba'i nad bcos rjes tsha ba de nad gzhi'i thog tu lhung ba dang ma smin tsha ba la sman dpyad zas spyod sogs gnyen po bsten sngas pas bad kan bskyed de pho ba'i me drod shor ba dang / rlung bskyed nas tsha ba rtsa mig tu byer te khrag g.yos pas chu ser bskyed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/tsha ba chu ser dang bsdongs pa yin pas tshad rtags spyi'i steng du mig dang rkang bol g.yo/ snying 'phar zhing rtse chung deg dbugs rgod/30

rtsa cung 'dar/ chu la rgya bshal 'byung ba yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈gso rig dgos pa kun 'byung〉phros/ de rtags gdong ba ser la sbos/ /rtsa ni phra mgyogs gting na rgyug /chu yang dmar ser rgya bshal 'dra/ /lce rnyil sen mo'i bkrag kyang 'chor/ /rngam pa 'degs la glo snying 'phar/ /shed chung rngul kha shin tu snyi/ /gnyid che skabs su glo chung lu/ /kha skam lus lci gzer phran 'ong / /pho ba brang zhol rkang bol g.yo/ /skrangs 'bur byung rjes rnag tu lu/ /rngul kha snyi zhing sna khrag 'ong / /rnyogs pa'i tsha ba yin par nges/ /zhes gsungs yod/ /gso thabs dngos/sle tres bzhi thang / dngul chu bco brgyad/ gi wang dgu ba/ 'bol sman bdun pa/ glang chen bcu gsum/ ga bur nyer lnga'i steng chu ser sman gsum bsnan pa sogs gtong shes par bya dgos/ rjes su don ༵/ //nga /rgyas kyi rtsa la mang du gtar zhing khrag nyung ngu dbyung dgos pa 'grams tshad kyi nad/lus zungs rnams 'grams pas khrag 'khrugs nas mkhris tshad bslangs pa'i phyir 'grams kyi tshad pa zhes brjod pa yin/31

nad kyi 'byung rkyen/lus kyi bya ba drag shul gyi rigs/ bang dang mchong sogs rtsal 'gran pa dang / pha bong 'degs pa/ lus kyis mi theg bzhin du khur ba/gzhu sran bkang ba/ sa sran brkos pa/ g.yang du lhung ba/ rta yis brdabs pa/ thibs 'og tshud pa/ rdo dang dbyug pas brdung ba sogs kyis lus zungs rnams 'grams pas khrag 'khrugs nas mkhris tshad bslang ba yin te/ 〈zhayu thog bu don ma〉phros/ de rgyu khrag gi tsha ba las/ /lus ngag yid kyi drag shul gyis/ /rkyen byas zungs de 'khrugs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nad kyi rtags/rtsa rgyud phra la grims par 'phar ba dang / chu mdog dmar la dwangs pa 'byung / phyi yul lus la tsha ba skye zhing / khyad par gang 'grams pa'i yul du na zhing zug gzer ldang ba dang / gdong ba snum zhing rngam pa 'degs/ lus kyi dgye dgu dang 'gro 'dug sogs bya ba dka' bar 'gyur ro/ /mi 'thar ba'i rtags/〈〈sman bsdus e yig〉phros/ gang 'grams gzer ldang zhing / drag po'i las kyi rjes su na na 'grams tshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gtso bo 'grams tshad 'khrugs tshad sogs phal cher rgyas tshad gzhir bzhag 3 2

la bsdongs zla gang byung gi rtags dang 'phrul shes par bya dgos/gso thabs dngos/ga bur nyer lnga/ rgyud kyi srog 'dzin brgyad pa/ gtso bo brgyad pa/rta zi dmar po/ sprin bral zla zer sosas spyi ltar don snod gang 'grams kyi sman dang bsdebs dgos pa yin/dpyad du〈〈sman bsdus e yig〉phros/ 'grams dang rgyas 'khrugs nad la ni/ /ga bur lug gi mgo tsam las/ /gtar ga'i khrag ni rlangs thon dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mang du gtar la nyung du dbyung ba ni gal che ba yin/'khrugs tshad kyi nad/rkyen gyis nyes pa 'khrugs te nad zungs kyi mtshan nyid rnams 'brel zhing 'thab pas tsha ba'i stobs su gyur pas na 'khrugs kyi tsha ba zhes zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉lkes/ rgyu rkyen zas spyod gdon rkyen gyis/ /khrag mkhris tsha ba'i me bus pas/ /rtsa don tsha bas bsreg pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nad gzhi'i mkhris pa mtshan nyid bdun ldan can der rkyen dus gdon zas spyod dman lhag log pa sogs ci rigs kyis bskyed pa yin no/ /33

nad kyi rtags/〈〈gso rig dgos pa kun 'byung〉phros/ ro rgyab mchin na gzer la dbugs mi bde/ /gyen la bskyod pa mi nus rngam pa thung / /zas skom thams cad zhim la smad khog lci/ /mig sprin dmar la glo gcig rtag tu lu/ /gyen rgyu'i rlung dang mchin khrag 'khrugs pa yin/ /lud pa sngon po'i gseb tu khrag thigs 'byung / /ro stod rgyangs 'dra 'gul ba la sogs las/ /res 'ga' rnag khrag ser ba'ang skabs su lu/ /pho ba'i yul dang mi bde zas mi zhim/ /mnyam gnas rlung dang gyen rgyu glo bar 'khrugs/ /pho ba mkhal rked mi bde rtsa chu bsdam/ /zas mi zhim la res 'ga' stod du gzer/ /rtsa spun chu mdog dmar la ldog pa bul/ /khyab byed srog rtsa'i nad du 'khyugs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ spyi rtags rtsa drag sbom mkhrang mgyogs/ /chu mdog dmar ser rlangs pa dugs/ /phrum ser yun thung car phog yong / /dbugs rgod gzer drag dgye sgur dka'/ /lud pa dmar ser nyungs khu 'dra/ /zhes dang / 〈〈sman bsdus e yig〉phros/'khrugs tshad kyi rtags bsdus na/ gzer dang lud pa 'byung / dbugs mi bde ba ste zhes gsungs yod/34

gso thabs dngos/'grams tshad dang 'khrugs tshad gnyis phal cher rgyas tshad gzhir bzhag la bsdongs zla'i gnyen po dang bsdeb shes dgos pa yin/ sman la ma nu bzhi thang / 'bras bu gsum thang / ga bur nyer lnga/ gtso brgyad g.yu ral ma/ khrag 'khrugs kun sel/ tsan dan brgyad pa sogs gtong shes par bya dgos/ nad bab dang bstun nas gang rgyas rtsa la gtar na shin tu phan/rims tshad kyi nad/nad dug kha rlangs gdug pa sprin du 'khrugs/ /rlung gshog ldan pas phyogs kun rgyu ba ste/ /bar snang khams nas ba spu sna sgor 'jug /dri phog yam thabs 'gos nas mched pa yin/ /zhes 'bu phra dang nad dug rang bzhin gyis 'gos khyab che ba'i nad rigs khag la rims tshad kyi nad zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu ni nad gzhi'i mkhris pa la rkyen dus bzhi'i 'byung ba dman lhag log pa dang / drag shul gyi las byas pa/ rgyud la zhe sdang drag po skyes pa/zas bsil drod dang 'grangs ltogs mi snyoms pa'am lus khams dang mi mthun pa bsten pa/ sems la 'jigs skrag chen po skyes pa/ mya ngan gyis sems gdungs pa/ khyad par nad dngos kyi dri dang nad yod sa'i 35

du ba dang rlung sogs kyi dris phog pas 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i rims su 'gyur ba yin te rkyen de dag gis lus kyi me drod bslangs shing cher bskyed pa ni rims kyi ngo bo yin zhing / de yang thog mar rngul dang de nas bad mkhris rlung gsum la rim pas babs shing / bu ga spyi dang khyad par sna khung nas zhugs te nang gi 'jug sgo drug la rim gyis 'jug pa yin no/ /nad kyi rtags/'gos khyab myur la thog mar grang shum byed pa/ tsha drod rgyag pa/mgo gzer la tshigs gzhi na ba/ sna chu 'dzag la sbrid pa mang ba/ gre ba dang mgrin pa skam zhing tsha ba/ sna khrag 'ong zhing glo lu ba/ zas la dang ga med cing ro mi gsal ba bcas yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ spyi rtags rims tshad mi 'gyur rtags/ /rims tshad rlung la 'bab pa'i phyir/ /khyad par mgo dang tshigs gzhi na/ /phrum ser yun ring lus po lci/ /mi lam za zi mang zhing myos/ /lce skam chu ni dmar la rnyog /rtsa ni phra mgyogs rna ba 'thib/ /shes pa nyog par nges pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/rngul dbyung ba rims tshad kun la gces zhes gsungs pa ltar thog 36

mar nor bu bdun thang dang ma nu bzhi thang btang ste rngul dbyung dgos pa dang / grang shum 'jags mtshams nas spang rtsi bcu gnyis dang /sman ser chen mo/ spru nag nyer dgu/ lo gyon ma/ rta zi dmar po/ gtso bo nyer lnga sogs gang la de 'tshams kyis skabs dang bstun te be+ed spyod gtong dgos pa dang /zas skom dkar mngar dang skyur ba/ drod bcud kyi rigs spang dgos pa yin/sib kyi nad/khrag dang chu ser la gnyan tshad babs pas lus yongs su 'brum pa sib bu mang du 'byung ba la sib bu'i nad ces zer/nad kyi 'byung byun/rgyu chu ser dang khrag la gnyan tshad babs pa/ rkyen ni nam zla dus bzhi'i dbang du byas na dgun dpyid sogs nad 'di dar ba'i dus su nad 'di yod sa'i mkha' rlung mi gtsang bas 'gos khyab byung ba'am yang na nad de yod pa'i nad par 'brel thug byas pa la brten nas byung ba yin/nad kyi rtags/nad 'di phog dus nas mig sprin dmar po chags pa/ tsha drod rgyas shing mgo dang tshigs gzhi na ba/ mig chu dang sna chu yong ba/ mig gis 37

'od mdangs mi non pa/ glo lu zhing lus brtse ba/ mig skyag yod pa/grang shum byed pa/ dgong mo tsha ba che ru 'gro ba/ na nas nyin gnyis dang gsum nas bzung kha yi nang ldebs su thor sib dkar po thon pa/skom tshad che zhing zas la dang ga med pa/ smin 'byed kyi thang btang na nyin zhag gsum bzhi nas rna rgyab dang / mjing ba nas 'go tshugs te rim bzhin brang khog dang sgal sa sogs lus yongs la thor 'brum yong ba yin/ bcos ka dang zas spyod mi 'tshams pa byung na sib thor phyir don ma thub par khong du shor nas glo tshad dang / rgyu tshad sogs 'byung srid/ de bas/ be+e ge mi 'jigs ldog pa 'jigs zhes gsungs pa'ang gnad de dag la thug pa yin no/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/mtshan nyid mgo rkang tshigs gzhi na/ /grang shum byed cing rmyong snying 'dod/ /zas ro mi tshor sbyid pa skyur/ /za zi mang la skyug tshul ston/ /khol bur na zhing pho rnams 'phrig /rtsa ni phra mgyogs rlung ltar g.yo/ /chu ni dmar nag gar la nyog /sha rnams khros nas kha dog dmar/ /smin dus 'brum bu dmar cig pa/ /nyungs dkar lta bus lus kun khyab/ /gre ba tsha zhing skom dad che/ /na lugs phal cher cham pa 'dra/ /zhes gsungs so/ /38

gso thabasasnyedangos/thog mar nad smin cing sib thor don pa'i ched du sman ma nu bzhi thang dang / 'brum pa dang sib bu gang la'ang thog mar nor bu bdun thang steng gu gul bsnan pa btang ste smin par bya dgos/ sib thor yongs su don pa'i rjes de 'phral zungs bzang mkhris can la spang rtsi bcu gnyis dang / dngul chu bzhi sbyor/ bya khyung lnga ba'i steng gu gul dang stag sha bsnan pa gtong dgos la/ zungs zhan rigs la gtso brgyad g.yu ral ma dang / tsan dan brgyad pa/ thang chen nyer lnga/ blon po sum skyon/ ga bur nyer lnga sogs gtong shes par bya dgos/klad gzer gyi nad/gnyan nad mgo bor babs nas klad pa'i gnas yul du gzer zug drag po ldang ba'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/gnyan tshad spyi ltar rims nad khyab pa'i skabs zas spyod log pa dang / lhag par du klad rims nad par 'brel thug byas pa las slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/klad pa gzer la sna khrag 'dzag cing / mur gong dang ltag pa gzer/ 'phar rtsa 'bur la 'khyug mig sprin dmar la sha pags tsha drod 39

che/ stod du gzer la glo mang / dus 'das na smra ba 'chol la smyo lkugs byed/mi nor ba'i rtags/mur gong ltag pa gzer dang 'phar rtsa 'khyug /mig sprin dmar la sha pags drod tsha zhing / /stod du en tsam gzer la glo mang 'ong / /gso thabs dngos/phur nag dgu thang / mgo thang gsum pa/ thang chen nyer lnga kha tshar can gyis gtso bo nyer lnga 'phul ba/ spru nag nyer dgu/ rta zi dmar po/man ngag gur gum bcu gsum/ khyung lnga kha tshar can sogs gtong dgos/dpyad du ltag rtsa dang / ru thung / dpral rtsa sogs gtar dgos so//cham pa'i nad/rgyu rkyen ci rigs kyi sgo nas sna bug gi dbang rtsa cham la phab nas rim bzhin lus yongs la khyab pa 'gos khyab chung ba'i nad la cham pa dang / de'i nang nas rigs gcig rims nad spyi dang 'dra ba 'gos khyab che ba'i nad la rims cham gyi nad ces zer ba yin/nad kyi 'byung byun/sna bug g.yas g.yon gyi dbang rtsa la mi gtsang ba'i zas spyod 'dres pa dang / ston dpyid sogs tsha grang 'thab pa/ dri ngan phog pa sogs 40

kyis slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/1 rlung las gyur pa'i cham pa yin na sbrid pa mang la sna 'gags cing / mur 'gram dang so klad pa sogs na la/ smin ma dang sna'i bar srin bu rgyu snyam byed/ skad 'gags/ mthar smin rtags su mchil ma dang snabs lud mang du 'dzag pa yin/2 mkhris pa las gyur pa'i cham pa'i rtas/sa su mgo dang tshigs gzhi byin nywa sogs na zhing / ro stod mi bde la brla rkang brdung snyam byed/ kha kha la dang ga mi bde zhing grang shum byed/ srod la sha drod tsha zhing rmi lam za zi mang / sna nang 'brum pa 'byung / mchil snabs dmar ser nyid du 'dzag go /3 bad kan las gyur pa'i rtags ni lud pa mang la dbugs jub gtong mi bde ba dang / lus lci la yi ga 'chus pa/ kha mngal zhing g.yal la mchil snabs snum can dkar po 'ong ba yin/4gre cham gyi rtags su dang po gre ba dang rkan mtshul rnams tsha zhing / bar du sna chu 'dzag cing mtshul ba 'gags/ tha ma sbrid pa yang yang bstud nas 'ong ba yin/5 glo cham gyi rtags su gre ba tsha zhing skad 'dzer/ bar du glo mang 41

zhing mgo dang brang rgyab sbrags nas na de'i dus su bcos ma thub na tha ma lud pa rnag tu lu zhing glo gcong gi nad du 'gyur ba yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ dbye ba gre cham glo cham dang / /rims cham gsum yin gre cham la/ /dang po rkan dang mtshul ba tsha/ /bar du sna chu 'dzag cing 'gag /tha ma phrid pa bstud nas 'ong / /glo cham dang po gre ba tsha/ /bar du glo mang mdun rgyab na/ /tha ma cham rgan glo gcong lu/ /rims cham mgo dang tshigs gzhi na/ /ro stod brla rted brdungs snyam byed/ /kha kha dang 'gag grang shum byed/ /srod la sha tsha rmi lam mang /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/cham pa thog mar byung dus smin byed kyi thang ma btang bar gnyen po btang na nad phal cher lus la byer zhing zhen pa dang / chu ser du rnyogs pa dang 'khrugs pa/ grum bur 'gyur ba yin pas/ nor bu bdun thang dang 'phrul thang sogs tsha mor btang ste grang shum 'jags rjes nad stobs dang lus zungs la gzhigs te lo gyon ma dang / rta zi dmar po/ spang rtsi bcu gnyis/ gtso bo brgyad pa/ glo tshad kun sel/gtso bo nyer lnga sogs bed spyod gtong dgos/42

gag pa'i nad/gnyan tshad gre ba'i yul du babs nas 'gag cing / gdug pa'i rang bzhin can srog 'phrog pa'i nad cig la zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/gnyan rims spyi dang 'dra ba la/ khyad par bza' btung nyes pa dang / nyin gnyid dang dmar zas kyis slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/phal cher gnyan nad spyi dang 'dra la/ khyad par gag pa'i nad kyi rtsa ni thung zhing sbom la 'phar 'phro chad cing 'khyig re byed la phyogs su gtong ba dang 'dra/ chu ni phal cher khrag dang mthun la/ mi nor ba'i rtags su khrag la khrag ris 'ong / lce steng du bad kan mthug lce dang mchu'i 'gram dang rkan phug la thor ba chags/ gre ba dang skad 'gag cing za/ zas skom mid par mi thar/ mgo bo na zhing rtse 'dar byed la ba spu g.yo ba sogs 'ong ba yin no/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ de gsum spyi mi 'gyur ba'i rtags/ /mgo na lus brtse rna bar zug /phal cher rims rnams 'dra ba la/ /khyad par sog steng ba spu ldog /lce 'og rtsa rgyas gnag par 'dug /ces gsungs so/ /43

gso thabs dngos/thog mar gu gul dang phur nag gi thang btang rjes sman la rta zi dmar po/ khyung lnga/ gtso khyung / spang rtsi bcu gnyis/ li khyung sogs gtong rgyu yin/dpyad du rtse chung gi mgo dang / ol mdud/ ske stong / tshigs pa drug bdun dkar nag mtshams rnams su me btsa' bya/gnyan gzer thung gi nad/ngo bo gnyan tshad kyi nad de dag ro stod dang / don spyi/ khyad par glo bar babs pa la glo tshad gzer thung zhes zer ba yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/'khrugs tshad kyi nad de dag gnyan rims spyi dang bsdongs pa la rkyen dus dang zas spyod sogs kyis nyes pa 'khrugs pas gzer thung gi nad byung ba yin/nad kyi rtags/〈〈man ngag lhan thabs〉〉pas/ rtags ni rgyas 'khrugs skabs kyi kun tshang steng / /rtsa ni thung la spud sbud lan mang 'phar/ /gzer 'pho lud pa 'gyur ldog mang ba la/ /lce mchu skya ser lus dang shes pa yang / /gnyid chung ba spu ldog cing yams thabs 'byung / /gzhan yang khrag gzer g.yas dang gnyan gzer g.yon/ /rlung gzer nges pa med ces 44

gong sman ṭ+wāṃsungs/ /khyad par 'tshig pa za ba gnyan gyi gzer/ /zhes gsukās no pre/ ba/'i rtags/snying ga na'am mchan 'og gzer/ /lud pa dmar ser kham nag 'ong / /mgo bo na zhing mig sprin ser/ /glo 'gag dbugs thung rngam pa rgod/ /zug gzer che zhing mu cor smra/ /gso thabs dngos/thang chen brgyad pa/ a byag drug thang / rta zi dmar po/ gtso brgyad bcu gnyis/ gtso khyung sogs 'phrod pa yin/dpyad du dmigs bsal ma gtogs gtar dang me btsa' mi rung /dkar mngar skyur gsum la shin tu 'dzem dgos/pho ba'i gnyan glang gi nad/gnyan rims pho bar babs pa la pho ba'i gnyan glang gi nad zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/gnyan rims spyi dang 'dra ba la khyad par kha zas rul sungs can dang / shing tog dang sngo tshod rjen zas kyi rigs/ chu grang mo btung ba sogs rkyen ci rigs kyis bskyed pa yin no/ /nad kyi rtags/nad stobs che na glo bur du pho ba gris dkrugs pa ltar na zhing /45

stobs chung na pho bar na zug che zhing sha sgrim pa/ gyen du skyug cing thur du bshal ba/ pho rnams 'bros shing ba spu ldog pa sogs kyi nad rtags 'byung /mi nor ba'i rtags/pho bar gzer 'dril ba yin/gso thabs dngos/brag khyung / brag zhun dgu ba/ 'chi med srin sel/ zhi khyung /dkar po drug sbyong steng rgyam tshwa/ bse spur/ gla rtsi/ phur nag khaṇ+ḍa rnams sbyar bas gnyan glang pho bar babs pa la zab pa yin/dpyad du lag pa'i gru khug dang / rkang ba'i sbyid khung nas dbyung na glang thabs dang lha 'gyur la shin tu phan pa yin/gnyan rgyu gzer gyi nad/gnyan rims rgyu mar babs pas rgyu ma gzer zhing 'khru ba la gnyan rgyu gzer gyi nad ces zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas skom ma goms pa dang btsog pa/ sha rul dang chang skyur sogs kyis gnyan dang chu ser khrag mkhris bzhi bslangs shing / tshad sgo thur rgyu mar babs pa las gnyan rgyu gzer gyi nad byung ba yin/46

py-i ༵shā ༵༵r+sha/sa phra grims par 'phar ba/ dri chu'i mdog dmar ser dugs la rlangs pa che ba/ mgo dang tshigs gzhi na zhing grang shum byed pa/ rgyu ma gzer zhing 'khru ba/ 'khru bongs chung la zug gzer che ba/sdukhru ṅgidog dmar ser za khu smug po be snabs can sna tshogs pa 'khru ba na ༵ /no/ra ba'i rtags/〈〈gso rig rgyud bzhi〉d+ku/ de rtags dang po mgo dang tshigs gzhi na/ /phrum ser khyer zhing rgyu ma na la 'khru/ /'khru ba'i bongs chung 'khru dus me+eṭ+wāṃ ༵ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ tram̐ngo/sa/da/mar ser za khu smug po be snabs 'khru/ /zhes so//in+d+ra bzhi thang / brag khyung / gam phye dmar po/ mkhris phye bdun pa/mkhris phye nyer lnga sogs 'phrod pa yin/rjes la gser mdog lnga ba/ gser zhi kha sprod/ se 'bru pad 'dab/dwangs ma gnas 'jog sogs kyis me drod gso bar bya'o/ /gnyan me dbal gyi nad/gnyan rims lpags la babs pas 'brum pa me lce ltar lus la 'khor bas na me dbal gyi nad ces zer/47

nad kyi 'byung rkyen/chu ser dang tsha ba rlung gis bus pa yin/nad kyi rtags/grang shum byed cing lus 'dar la ba spu brtse zhing g.ya' ba/ 'brum pa dmar chung lus la myur bar mched pa/ kha kha zhing skam pa/ me lce 'khor ba ltar lus la rgyas shing 'khor la/ de yang lus kyi sked par 'khor ba re re tsam las phal cher rkang lag gi ske la 'khor zhing / me lce tshom bu nywa bzhi dang sgal ba'i gzhung la tshom pa/ 'brum pa'i mdog dmar zhing mchod rten ris su yod pa/ dkar dmar gyi rigs shin tu gnod na nges so/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈phyag rdor mgon po'i gces bsdus〉d+ku/ phyir byung chu bur mes tshig 'dra/ /tsha 'bral che zhing mched pa skyen/ /nang babs glo snying tsha gdung che/ /'ug gzer che zhing nyes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/gso thabs dngos/khrung lnga/ dngul chu rin chen bco brgyad/ dngul khyung me dbal can/ byang lugs gi wang bcu gcig sogs dang / phyi la byug pa reg pa bde byed zab/48dpyad du gang nye'i rtsa la gtar ba shin tu legs/

gnyan rmen bu'i nad/'gram rmen dang ske mjing gi rmen sogs la gnyan rgyas te spangs pa la gnyan rims rmen bu'i nad zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu rkyen drag shul gyi rkyen gyis 'grams pa'am rlung 'khrugs pa then bu la brten skrangs pa 'byung ba'i nad cig la zer/nad kyi rtags/tshigs pa dang / ske mjing / mig zur/ sne sa rnams su 'bab pas gnas de dag tu sba ba lta bu'am nyung gsher 'khyags pa dang 'dra ba'i skrangs pa 'byung la yun du gnas pa yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈man ngag lhan thabs〉phros/ gnas der lba ba'am nyung gsher 'khyags 'dra zhing / /yun gnas 'bab sa'i dbang gis ngo len sla/ /'on kyang la lar ser ba rus zhes pa'i/ /skrangs po de dang 'khrul bas brtag pa gces/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/khyung lnga tshad ldan steng dngul chu/ stag sha nag po/ gu gul/ seng ldeng sbyar ba dang / spang rtsi bcu gnyis/ gtso brgyad bcu gnyis/ a gar so lnga sogs bsten dgos/49

dpyad du steng du me yis tshos par bsreg cing 'bam po sogs kyis lums bya/ zhi bar dka' na gang nye'i rtsa la gtar ga dgos/snyog pa'i nad/gnyan sha la babs pa'i nad de/ nad des zin pa'i rtags su lus kyi sha sna kun lhog lhog tu chu khol ba ltar 'gul zhing 'dar bar 'gyur bas lhog pa'i nad ces zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/〈〈rin gter〉phros/ klu dang sa srin gnod pa yis/ /lhog pa dkatrī /kā shā shādro/ 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /thog mar grang shum byed cing mgo dang tshigs gzhi na ba/ kha kha zhing gzugs po 'dar yengs byed pa/ sems mi bde ba/ gnas gang rung du babs na skrangs shing za 'phrug langs pa/ thor ba yong ba/ sdug tu phyin na bu mo chung chung gi nu ma dang 'dra ba/ thor mgo nag cing mtha' dmar skrangs mkhregs por gyur pa/ na zug yod pa/ lhog nad yin min the tshom byung na mu zi nag po dang / shu dag gla rtsi bcas khong du btang bas nad pa dngangs 'dar yengs pa byung na lhog pa'i nad yin pa'i rtags red/50

mi nor ba'i rtags/spyi ru ngos bzung phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ /phyi rtags skrangs dbyibs 'brum pa chu bur 'dra/ /nya sbrul sdom sdig rta bla sbal lhong dang //na chung nu ma ltar skrangs nyam nga 'jigs/ /kha dog dmar ram nag smug khra bo skrangs/ /na lugs phrum ser khyer zhing tshigs gzhi na/ /mgo na kha kha 'phyo 'dar snying mi dga'/ /rtsa ni kha rgyug gting grims khong na 'dar/ /chu nag rlangs 'thibs ku ya 'khrugs nas 'ong / /reg bya tshor med yang na bzod pa chung / /shin tu tsha'am shin tu grang bar 'gyur/ /rgyun srang sogs sprin 'byil dang ba spu log /an stong 'gram 'phar sgal mchan dmar thig 'byung / /gsang rtags nag po gsum(mu zi shu dag gla rtsi)btang dngangs 'dar yin/ /gso babs dngos/khyung lnga/ spang rtsi bcu gnyis/ phan pa kun ldan/ stag sha nyer lnga/dngul chu bco brgyad/ a gar so lnga sogs gtong rgyu dang / mjug tu yan lag gi rma ltar gso dgos/gnyan 'azas kyi nad/gnyan de 'bab sa'i dbang gis sha rus rtsa sogs kyi gnas su babs na 'bras zhes bya ste/ gnas de dag tu bam por skrangs shing dbyibs 'bras bu'i rdog po 'dra ba 'byung bas na de skad ces ming 51

chags pa yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/khyad par drag shul rkyen gyis lus zungs 'grams pa'am 'khrugs pa 'byung bas ngan khrag rgyas pa dang / ngan khrag dang / chu ser/ rkun bu sogs rlung gis gcig tu bsgril ba de la lus gnas lhan skyes kyi srin bu mkhris pa dang bsdongs pas lus kyi cha shas sha dang / rus pa/rtsa la sogs par zhen pa las byung ba yin/nad kyi rtags/phyi 'bras ni rtsa rgyud phra la 'dar ba spangs pa mnan na sra ba'o/ /sha 'bras ni nyung gsher 'khyags pa dang 'dra/ rus 'bras ni rus pa'i mdog 'gyur zhing rtsi nyams la zos pa dang / yang na rus pa'i steng du lcags kyi gzer bu btab pa dang 'dra ba'o/ /rtsa 'bras ni rtsa rgyud skrangs shing sbrul nag khros pa dang 'dra ba'o/ /khong 'bras ni skran ltar lag pas mnan na sra ba'am yang na mi mngon yang zas la sred pa che zhing / 'bras de yun lon nas smin pa'i tshe gyen thur gnyis kar rnag brdol bar 'gyur ro/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/phyi rtags rtsa rgyud 'phra 'dar skrangs mnan sra/ /sha yis 'bras ni nyung gsher 'khyags pa 'dra/ /rus 'bras rus pa mdog 'gyur rtsi 52

nyams zos/ /yang na rus steng lcags kyis gzer btab 'dra/ /rtsa 'bras skrangs shing sbrul nag khros pa 'dra/ /de yi brtag pa gul nag ldong ros dang / /ba bla mu zi mtshal mnyam dri chur sbyar/ /rma chen rma med gang yin dogs sar byug /min na mi 'byar yin na 'byar ba la/ /shul dang sha ro byung na 'khrul ba med/ /ces gsungs/gso thabs dngos/khyung lnga'i steng dngul chu/ stag sha gu gul/ seng ldeng sbyar ba btang zhing / khyung chen nyer lnga/ klu bdud bco brgyad/ dngul chu bco brgyad/grang sbyor/ mang sbyor sogs gtong dgos/tsha skyur gnyis ni 'bras nad kyi dug yin pas spang rgyu gal che/gnyan 'dzum bu ltag dgye'i nad/gnyan tshad rgyungs par babs pas lus ltag par dgye zhing 'then 'gro ba dang / kha gcigs bzhin mdangs nyams par 'gyur bas na 'dzum bu ltag dgye'i nad zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/gnyan nad sdig pa can de nyid mkhris pa dang bsdongs la rlung gis rkyen byas te klad yul dang sgal gzhung sogs la 'bab cing / spyir ma nges pa sna tshogs 'byung ste na ba med bzhin du 'chi ba'ang srid par gsungs/53

nad kyi rtags/dri chu khrag gam yang na mar nag dang 'dra/ snying mi dga' zhing nad byung ma thag tu sgal rgyud la gzer che/ lus stobs 'chor zhing sha mdangs ser por 'gro/ bzung bas mi thub la gzer gyis ltag pa dgyed dgyed du 'then 'gro/misnyenor ba'i rtags/〈〈rin gter〉phros/ de rtags cung zad snying mi dga'/ /na ma thag nas lus stobs 'chor/ /lus kun btso ma'i gser dang 'dra/ /dri chu khrag gam mar nag 'dra/ /zungs mi thub la ltag dgye 'gyel/ /zhes gsungs/gso thabs dngos/thog mar 'bros 'phrang bsdam dgos te tshigs pa drug bdun dang /lag mgul du spra tshugs chung ngu gdu bu ltar bskor nas bsreg dgos/sman du phur nag bdun thang / gar nag bzhi thang / khyung lnga/ gnyan sbyongs drag po bcu gsum sogs zab pa yin/gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsar rgyug gi nad/nad 'dir rang bzhin zas spyod rkyen gyis mkhris pa 'be+el nas rtsar rgyug pa tsam zhig ma yin par/ phyi'i gnyan rims nang khrag srin la 'phos pa'i dug rlangs kyis mkhris pa'i go 'phrog nas rtsar rgyugs shing 54

nad gdug pa can du 'phel phyir gnyan rims mkhris pa rtsar rgyug gi nad ces zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ tshad pa ba spu'i bu ga dang / /dri ma rngul la brten nas 'jug /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gnyan rims mkhris pa'i tshad pa lus kyi phyi rol rngul gyi sgor zhugs te/ don mchin pa dang snod mkhris pa'i yul du babs nas rang sar mi gnas par rtsa mig kun tu rgyug cing / yar mgo dang klad par song nas bad kan gyi yul 'phrog pa/ mar mkhal ma'i yul du brgyud nas chu khams kyi yul 'phrog pa/ gzhan don glo snying la song nas rlung yu la 'phrog pa/ snod pho long rgyu ma'i yul du song nas mkhris yul 'phrog pa/ phyi'i sha pags kyi yul du shor nas stobs dang kha dog 'phrog pa/ mjug tu mkhris gnas rlung gis spyad pas rang gnas srog rtsar 'chor bar gyur tshe 'tsho ba nyung bar 'gyur ro/ /nad kyi rtags/dang por grang shum byed cing / yi ga 'gag pa dang dri ma'i rgyun gnyis zhan pa/ rtsa stong zhing myur la 'dar shas yod pa/ chu dmar ser nyog cing khong nas log pa/ mgo dang tshigs gzhi na zhing za zi che ba/bar du nad rgyas pa'i tshe dri chu'i mdog mar nag 'dra ba 'byung ba/55

mig sprin dang lce 'og mur gong gi sha mdangs ser ba/ kha kha zhing lus tsha/ gnyid chung la dang ga 'gag sen rnyil lce mchu rnams dkar ser 'ong / mgo gzer zhing lce mchu 'gas so dreg chags/ mchin mkhris yul du gzer 'dril zhing mnan na mi bzod/ nad kyi dri dugs che la gzi mdangs 'chor/ nad 'di smin pa'i long med par zhag bdun dang dgu'i dus na 'chi ba mang phyir smin byed dus la sgug mi rung / rtsa spun pa dang shes pa yang la lus stobs shor ba/ phyi'i drod chung ba/pags mdog ha cang ser ba sogs kyi rtags byung tshe dus las 'das pa yin pas bzlog thabs med/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈man ngag lhan thabs〉phros/ de rtags grang shum byed cing rgyu ba zhan/ /rtsa ni stong la myur zhing khong na 'dar/ /chu mdog dmar ser nyog cing khong nas log /mgo dang tshigs gzhi na zhing za zi 'ong / /bar du nad rgyas chu ni mar nag 'dra/ /mig sprin lce 'og mur gong sha mdangs ser/ /kha kha lus tsha gnyid chung dang ga 'gag /sen mo rnyil dang lce mchu dkar ser 'ong / /mgo gzer lce mchu 'gas shing so dreg chags/ /mchin mkhris steng du 'dril ba mnan mi bzod/ /nad kyi dri dugs stobs dang gzi mdangs 'chor/ /smin pa'i long med bdun 56

dgu'i dus na 'chi/ /glun po 'ga' zhig smin byed dus la sdod/ /rtsa spun shes pa yang la lus stobs shor/ /phyi yi drod chung pags mdog gser ltar ser/ /dus 'das rang gnas slebs pas bzlog thabs med/ga/ṭ+wāṃ tram̐ṭ+wāṃs ma da sdispya /dus na bya ra sgrims/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dang por man rgyud mkhris sna drug pa'am bdun pa gu gul gyi chur sbyangs te btang / de nas 'dzin pa drug pa gu gul chu yis phul/ drag po bcu gsum bshal gyis sbyangs/ gzhug tu spang rtsi bcu gnyis dang /gtso khyung sogs nad bab dang bstun nas gtong dgos/ zas spyod gnyan tshad spyi bzhin bya dgos/gnyan khong stog nag po srog rtsar babs pa'i nad/gnyan rims gdug pa can nang srog rtsar babs te lus kyi mdangs 'chor zhing smra ba'i kha lkugs pa'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu gdon gyis byed/ gzhan yang bla ma'i bka' bcag pa/ sngags dī'i dadi tshig nyams pa/ btsun pa mang po'i dge 'dun sde 'khrug na cing shā da py-i /rtags/thog mar zhag 'ga'i gong nas 'tshig pa za ba dang / khong khro spyang

ngu snying 'dod/ skabs su 'khru skyug 'byung / res 'ga' gzer/ lus kyi mdangs 'chor/ mig 'bur tshugs su blta/ kha lkugs la mchu mi 'dzum/lus dgye zhing ltag pa rengs la rngul chu 'dzag pa/ khrag nag 'khru skyug byung na zhag bdun gyis 'chi'o/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈bdud rtsi bum chung〉phros/ srog rtsa la babs na rtags 'di yod/rdo brgyab pa bzhin yong / skabs su na zhing skabs su ci yang min zer shed phyung bar 'gro/ mar la bshal yong / lus dgye bor 'gro/ rngul 'byung / yar la skyug 'ong / so gcigs mdangs 'chor/ lus drod che chung gnyis ka 'ong / khrag nag po 'khru skyug byung na sos mi srid/ zhag bdun tshun chad la 'chi nges so/ /srog rtsa la zhugs pa'i rtags yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/phur nag gdus pa'i khu bar gla rtsi cung zad btab pa dro 'jam yang yang btang / rgyal blon bcu bdun pa gla rtsi sum thang gis phul/khyung lnga mdog bzhi/ stag sha nyer lnga/ a gar so lnga sogs gang 'tshams gtong dgos/spang spos dang shu dag gla rtsi mar dkar dang sbyar nas byug pa byas na'ang bzang /58

gnyan rna rtsa phus 'debs kyi nad/ngo bo gnyan nad de rna ba'i rtsar zhugs te za 'gram dang rna shal gyi rtsar rkyal ba phus btab pa bzhin skrangs pa'i nad cig la zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/nad kyi 'byung rkyen gong gi rims tshad spyi ltar shes par bya/nad kyi rtags/rna khung 'khyug cing gzer la/ za 'gram dang rna shal gyi rtsar rkyal ba phus btab pa bzhin skrangs shing / dbugs dang skad cher bton na gnod pa/ rtsa grims shing chu dmar ba/ lus drod che la ba spu brtse ba/nad stobs chung na zhag 'ga' nas rang bzhin du zhi 'gro ba dang /stobs che na rna ba 'on pa'am skrangs po khong du shor nas 'tsho dka' ba'ang yod pas gzab dgos so/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/rna sbug 'khyug la gzer zhing za 'gram skrangs/ /rtsa grims chu dmar drod che rtse 'dar 'byung / /zhes lhan thabs las gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/khyung lnga kha tshar can/ (kha tshar la gu gul/ stag sha dngul chu)khyung sngon dgu ba/ phyi byugs la byug pa bya khyung sngon po/ drag po'i lam nas thur du sbyangs pa gal che ba yin/59

rgyu gzer gyi nad/zas spyod mi 'tsham pa'i rkyen gyis rgyu mar gnyan tshad rgyas nas zug che zhing khrag tu 'khru ba'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu rkyen gnyan rims spyi dang 'dra na'ang / khyad par du ngo bo mchin tshad thur du babs pas gnyan dang chu ser mkhris tshad rnams sdusdongs pa dang / khrag mkhris kyi tshad sgo thur du babs pa las byung ba na/nad kyi rtags/mgo dang rkang lag gi tshigs gzhi na zhing grang shum byed pa/ rgyu ma gzer zhing 'khru ba/ 'khru bongs chung la zug che ba/ 'khru mdog dmar ser za khu smug po be+e snabs sogs sna tshogs pa 'khru ba yin no/ /gzhan yang na zug che zhing 'khru ba'i bongs chung ba dang / khrag dang dud khu 'dra ba dri ma shin tu dugs pa 'byung ba ni don 'khru dang /'khru mdog dmar ser ram za khu dang be+e snabs 'dra ba 'khru zhing grangs nyung la 'khru ba'i dri ma dang rtsa chu la tsha ba'i rtags chung na snod 'khru yin pa'i khyad par shes dgos/mi nor ba'i rtags/stirgyu gzer bongs chung zhing yang yang 'khru/ 'khru ba'i dus khyad par

du zug gzer che ba yin/gso thabs dngos/in+d+ra bzhi thang / brag khyung / mkhris phye bdun pa/ in+d+ra bco lnga sogs bsten dgos/sha rnying mar rnying dang btsong sgog sogs mi 'phrod pa'i zas lo dus bar du gzab pa gal che ba yin/margo rlung gi nad/lus stod dbang bo rnams kyi thog ma'am gnas gzhi gtso bo mgo sbyar hāng zhugs te dpral ba smin mtshams lug snyam du sems pa'i nad —ga wa/ /kyi 'byung rkyen/mgo bor rlung 'tshub phog pa/ gtam mang du smras pa/ nyin mtshan mang por gnyid chag pa sogs kyis slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/mur 'gram la zug gzer 'byung ba/ dpral ba dang smin mtshams thur du lug snyam byed pa/ rna ba 'ur ba/ so na ba/ mig gis bltar mi bzod pa/ sna chu mang ba/ mgo bsdams shing ldang dub rang bzhin gyis na ba bcas so/ /61

mi nor ba'i rtags/rlung gis mgo nad mur 'gram zug /smin mtshams dpral bar lhung snyam sems/ /mgo 'khor so dang 'gram pa na/ /mig chung snyam sems rna ba 'ur/ /res na res drag rtsa rnams 'phar/ /snum bskus dugs byas bsdams na bde/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gso thabs dngos/bdud rtsi bcu gcig a gar nyi shu/ a gar brgyad pa/ dza ti nyer lnga/ a gar so lnga sogs btang na 'phrod/bya/ spyi gtsug dang mtshog gsang / ltag pa'i sdud sgo sogs su me btsa' sna khrag 'dzag pa'i nad/sna khrag 'dzag pa ni nad rkyen sna tshogs kyis slong ste sna nas khrag 'dzag pa'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas spyod log pa/ sna nang du gnyan tshad rgyas pa/ khrag 'khrugs pa/khrag shed mtho ba/ cham rims phog pa/ brdabs skyon byung ba bcas kyis slong bar byed/nad kyi rtags/sna khrag nyung tsam don pa/ mang po don pa/ de dag bsdus na khrag 62

mdog ser la sla ba klad pa las byung ba'i rtags/ smug la nag pa mchin khrag brdol ba'i rtags/ dmar la dwangs pa rtsa kha phye ba'i rtags bcas so/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/sna khrag nyung tsam mam mang po don pa/gso thabs dngos/khrag gcod gur brgyad/ thang chen nyer lnga/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ khrag sel 'phrul 'khor can/ gzhan mgo dang dpral bar chu lcag bya/sna rnag ya ma'i nad/sna bug nang du gnyan tshad rgyas nas dmar skrang du gyur pa'am rnag tu smin pa'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/sna bug nang gi spu btsan gyis 'thog pa'am/ yang na phyi rdul mi sdutsang ba'i dris phog pa sogs kyis gnyan tshad rgyas nas bslangs pa na/nad kyi rtags/sna khung nang dmar skrangs rgyas shing na zug yod pa/ sna 'gag pa/za 'phrug langs pa/ mgo na ba/ dri ngan kha ba/ skabs su rnag khrag don zhing sdug tu phyin na sna yang 'khyog 'gro ba yin/6 3

mi nor ba'i rtags/sna 'gag pa/ sna khung dmar zhing skrangs pa/ mgo na ba/ dri ngan kha ba/ skabs su rnag khrag yong ba bcas yin/gso thabs dngos/byi tang bdun pa/ gur khyung / dngul chu bco brgyad/ zla 'od nor khyung / dngul spos snar 'then pa sogs bya dgos/kha yi nad/kha yi nad ni rtse dang kha nang sogs la rma dang 'brum phran byung nas tsha shar dang na zug yod pa/ kha chu bzhur ba sogs 'byung ba'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas spyod log pa/ cham pa rims tshad kyi nad phog pa sogs kyis slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/rtse dang rkan/ 'gram pa'i nang ldebs/ so rnyil bcas dmar skrangs chags shing 'brum thor byung ba/ tsha dang na zug yod pa/ zas za mi thub pa bcas so /mi nor ba'i rtags/kha nang du 'brum phran yod/ tsha dang na zug 'byung / kha chu 'dzag64

gso thabs dngos/spang rtsi bcu gnyis/ khyung lnga kha tshar can/ nag mtshur sum thang gis kha bshal byas na shin tu phan/so srin gyi nad/so rul nas gas chag shor ba'am kha sho byung ba'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas ro so gseng du lus nas rul skyur byung ba dang / so gral mi 'grig pa/ mngar skyur bsten drags pa sogs kyis slong bar byed/nad kyi rtags/so yi grub char nag thig dang khung bu brdol ba/ zas skom mngar skyur dang / tsha grang gang yang 'thung skabs na zug yod pa/ 'gram pa dang rna ba'i rgyud du gzer zug rgyag pa bcas yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/sman bsdus〈〈e〉r+yāg las/ srin nad so ni ldang dub byed/ /tsha grang gnyis ka reg na gnod/ /ces gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/khyung lnga/ gur khyung / spang rtsi bcu gnyis/ yang na btsan dug dang /gla rtsi/ mu zi nag po/ shing kun bcas sbyar ba'i ril bu so yi steng du bzung na phan/ so rtsa gtar na'ang chog pa yin/65

g.yan pa'i nad/g.yan pa ni thog mar pags pa'i thog la skyi skogs skya thig can gon nas za 'phrug mi bzod pa zhig langs pa'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung byun/zas spyod mi mthun pa/ 'du ba 'khrugs pa/ srin dang chu ser 'phel ba sogs kyis slong bar byed/nad kyi rtags/lus kyi gnas nges med du skya thig sgor dbyibs can don pa/bzod mi thub pa'i za 'phrug langs nas 'phrug dus phyi skogs dkar po bud pa dang / thor ba yong ba/ lhag par sos ka dang ston kha tsha ba che ba'i skabs je stug tu 'gro ba bcas yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈sman bsdus e yig〉phros/ g.yan pa 'phrug na slar za byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/spos dkar bcu ba/ klu bdud bco brgyad/ khyung lnga/ zla 'od nor khyung sogs bsten dgos/ gzhan yang spos dkar bcu ba phag tshil dang sbyar nas byug pa byas na'ang bzang ba yin/

glang shu'i nad/glang thug gi gnya' ba'i pags pa lta bu mthug mkhregs ldan zhing /rtsub pa/ shu thor sogs 'byung ba'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/tsha skyur gyi zas skom spyod thal che ba/ tshad pa che ba'i skabs 'khrugs las ches drags pa sogs kyis slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/nad 'di mang che ba mjing ba dang / ltag pa gnyis la 'byung zhing /za 'phrug langs pa/ rim bzhin lus kyi gnas nges med du khyab nas pags mdog gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i mthug cing rtsub pa dang / gas pa sogs kyi rtags yod pa yin/misnyenor ba'i rtags/〈〈sman bsdus e yig〉toras/ glang shu mdog ser pags pa tshos/ /sra zhing za la glang gnya' 'dra/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/khyung lnga/ spos dkar bcu ba/ dngul chu bco brgyad/ klu bdud bco brgyad sogs zab pa yin/rtsa 'azas kyi nad/khrag dang chu ser byer ba rlung gis bsgril te skrangs pa rtsa thog tu 67

'byung zhing 'bur 'khyog tu thon pa'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/lus la lhan skyes su yod pa'i rnam par ma gyur pa'i rlung mkhris bad kan khrag chu ser la drag shul gyi las kyis 'grams 'khrugs byung ba'am kha zas ma smin pa sogs kyis ngan khrag dang chu ser 'phel nas byer ba rlung gis bsgril nas byung ba yin/nad kyi rtags/skrangs pa rtsa thog tu 'byung zhing na zug che/ gzer 'khyug nas na/rtsa gnad thog byung na gso dka' ba yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈man ngag lhan thabs〉phros/ rtsa 'bras spangs shing sbrul nag khros pa 'dra/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/bsil ba'i sngo sman sna tshogs kyi lums rgyag pa dang / 'bras bu sum thang gtong ba rjes su gang nye'i rtsa gtar dgos/khong sman du khyung lnga/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ rta zi dmar po sogs nad bab dang bstun nas gtong shes dgos/pho 'bras kyi nad/68'grams 'khrugs sogs kyis dwangs ma rang gnas su ma smin par

khrag ngan rgyas te rtsa mig tu byer ba rlung gis bsgril nas pho ba'i gnas su be 'bras ltar smin zhing rgyas pa la pho 'bras kyi nad ces zer/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rnam par ma gyur pa'i rlung mkhris bad kan dang / khrag chu ser la/rkyen drag shul dang 'grams 'khrugs kyi rkyen la sogs pas ngan khrag dang chu ser 'phel ba las byung ba yin/nad kyi rtags/sto ba sbos shing zas la sred pa/ mid pa na zhing zas skom zos 'phral du skyug pa bcas yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/pho ba na zhing zas kyi dang ga zhan pa/ zas la sred cing zas skom 'gro dka' ba/ khrag zhan zhing lus kyi stobs nyams pa/ yar la skyug cing bshang ba skam po yin pa bcas so/ /gso thabs dngos/dwangs btso/ dwags btso/ zla shel chen mo/ skran 'joms/ btso zla sogs gtong dgos/gzhang 'drum gyi nad/zas spyod log pa dang srin 'khrugs pa sogs kyis gzhang gi gnas su 'brum thor 'byung zhing za 'phrug lang ba'i nad cig yin/ 69

nad kyi 'byung rkyen/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ de rgyu 'khru drags bshang lam btsan/ /bshang gci 'phyen bkag bcir ba dang / /bzhon bsten stan srab tsog pur 'dug /thur sel rlung 'khrugs gzhang 'brum 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /nad kyi rtags/'brum pas bshang lam 'gags pa/ khong ba sbo zhing mgo 'khor yi ga 'chus/ 'khru ba'am rtug pa skam pa/ gzhang kha gzer zhing za ba/ dri ma khrag bcas 'byung ba yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ de rtags drod chung yi ga 'chus/ /'khru'am skam mam rlung 'khyil sbo/ /gcin mang bshang nyung lus stobs chung / /sha skam gzhang gzer rus tshigs na/ /dri ma khrag bcas sla'am ska/ /dri ma'i yul las grang phyogs dpag /ces gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/dzā ti bdun pa/ zla shel myu gu/ khyung lnga mdog bzhi/ dngul chu rin chen bco brgyad/ byi tang bdun pa/ khyad par dngul khyung dar bas phul na shin tu bzang /70

blo ba'i sur ya'i nad/khrag ngan glo ba'i rtsa mig tu 'dus nas ngo bo skrangs pa zug rngu dang bcas pa gzhug tu rnag tu smin pa'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas spyod dman lhag log pa'i rkyen gyis khrag 'phel ba dang /gzhan rims dug tsha ba rtsar babs pa dus su ma gtar ba'i skyon gyis khrag ngan chu ser glo ba'i rtsa mig tu 'dus nas byung ba yin/nad kyi rtags/mchan 'og skrangs/ stod gzer/ glo lu mang ba yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ glo ba glo lu ro stod gzer/ /mchan 'og skrangs rdol rnag chu 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/dngul chu bco brgyad/ ga bur nyer lnga/ pa yag bsnan pa'i tsan dan brgyad pa/ zangs thal nyer lnga/ bsam nor/ khyung lnga kha tshar can sogs bsten dgos/mkhal ma'i rlung tshabs kyi nad/khrag tshabs yun lon pa rlung dang bsdongs nas mkhal mar babs pa la mkhal ma'i rlung tshabs kyi nad ces zer/71

nad kyi 'byung rkyen/payirdon/ gyi las dang zas spyod log pa/ gdon rkyen sogs kyis bskyed py-ir+shaṭ+wāṃ /ṭā r+sha/nga snying mi bde ba/ mgo 'khor zhing grang bsil byed pa/ lus spangs shing sbrid pa/ mig mi gsal zhing snying 'dar la 'phyo ba/smyo 'bog dang brjed ngas che ba/ chu so dang rgyu zhabs bsdams shing za khu 'bab pa/ zla mtshan rgyun du mi chod par 'dzag pa yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/rked tshigs khol zhing na ba/ lhag par grang na na zhing rked pa man chad bshal ba yin/gso thabs dngos/go yu bdun sbyor/ sug smrel skyin gor/ gso byed nyi ma/ se 'bru bzhi ba/ a gar brgyad pa/ a gar so lnga sogs gtong dgos/mngal skran gyi nad/mngal nang du skran 'dril ba'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas dang spyod lam log pa/ mi gtsang ba'i rigs sna tshogs mngal naX2 du shor ba las byung ba yin/

nad kyi rtags/rgyu zhabs na ba/ zla mtshan mi snyoms pa/ za khu 'dzag pa/ gcin kha snyi ba/ mngal mi chags pa bcas yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/rgyu zhabs na zhing / sbo ba/ zla mtshan mi snyoms pa/ mkhal rked chad snyam byed pa/ gcin kha snyi ba/ dbugs rgod la snying mi bde ba bcas so/ /gso thabs dngos/zhi byed bcu gcig 'ol se nyer lnga/ khrag bshig zhi byed nyer dgu sogs bsten dgos/pho rlung gi nad/ci sdi bar rlung zhugs te zas mi 'ju zhing sbo 'khrog byed pa'i nad —ga shā/ /kyi 'byung rkyen/bsam blo'i 'gul skyod drag pa dang yang rtsub kyi zas skom bsten pa sogs kyikā slong bar byed pa yin//r+sha ṭ+wāṃ / kā sab/ na zhing sbos brgyangs byed pa/ sgreg cing pho ba tsha 'brab byed pa/ pho ba ltogs skabs lhag par na ba/ zas zos rjes bde snyam byed pa/ gnyid yer ba bcas so/ / 73

mi nor ba'i rtags/sbo zhing stong sgreg byed pa/ 'brab pa bzhin du na zhing stong skyug byed pa/ yang na sgra bcas 'khrog kyang 'khru ba'ang 'byung ngo / /gso babs dngos/dgoṭ+wāṃ/rgyad lnga/ ru zhi/ bdud rtsi bcu gcig a gar nyi shu sogs bsten pho tshad kyi nad/pho bar tsha ba 'grams te rgyun tu na zug gtong ba'i rgyun mthong gi nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/zas skom tsha skyur dang rul sungs/ ma goms pa/ dus min du zos pa sogs kyis slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/pho bar na zug yod cing zas kyi dang ga zhan pa/ khog pa sbo 'khrog byed pa/ skabs 'gar skyug pa dang bshal ba sogs 'byung /mi nor ba'i rtags/pho stod gzer ba/ glang thabs su na ba/ skyug cing grang dro gang yang gnod pa bcas so/ /74gso thabs dngos/
