thang chen nyer lnga/ brag zhun dgu ba/ zla shel/ g.yu khyung sogs bsten rgyu dang / spyir pho ba ni bad kan gyi gnas yin stabs tsha ba'i nad zhugs kyang nad mjug drod kyis gso dgos pas/ rjes su sman la se 'bru dwangs gnas/ dwags btso/ g.yu dril bcu gsum sogs bsten dgos pa yin/rgyu rgan gyi nad/rgyu mar tsha ba zhugs pa'am/ yang na ma zhu bas bslangs pa'i rgyu ma'i nad la skabs 'phral sman bcos yag po ma byung bar zas spyod log pa sogs kyis rtag par grod khog bshal ba'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/rgyu tshad sogs rgyu ma'i nad rigs la dus thog sma na bcos yag po ma byas par rgyun ring lus pa/ yang na zas skom tsha skyur dang / grang mo rigs bsten drags pa las byung ba yin/nad kyi rtags/rtag tu grod khog bshal ba/ bshal dus phal che bar na zug mi 'byung ba/ za ma gang zos kyang bshal ba/ bshal mdog la nges pa med pa/ bshal yun ring ba/ skabs rer rgyu smad na nas sbo 'khrog byed pa/lus stobs je zhan du 'gro ba bcas so /75

mi nor ba'i rtags/rgyun du lto ba bshal ba dang / bshal dus phal cher na zug mi mngon pa/ kha zas gang zos kyang bshal ba/ lhag par sha zos pa'am chang btung ba'i tshe 'phral mar bshal ba/ bshang ba'i mdog la nges pa med pa/ skabs 'gar rgyu smad na zhing sbo 'khrog byed pa/ sgreg pa 'byung ba/ lus stobs zhan pa bcas so/ /gso thabs dngos/dwags sman bco lnga/ se 'bru dgu ba/ se 'bru dwangs gnas/ gser mdog lnga ba/ gser khyung sogs bsten dgos/snying rlung gi nad/sems la phog thug chen po byung nas shes pa 'phyo zhing yid la nges gtan med par gyur pa'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/ rgyu shān sna tshogs kyis sems la phog thug byung ba las nad de byung ba rna shā da kyi/ /rtags/shes pa 'phyo zhing don med du snying mi dga' ba/ res 'ga' ma dris par yang mu cor smra zhing res 'ga' dris na'ang phyir lan mi ldon pa/ mi snyan pa'i tshig gis dngangs shing shu yis 'debs pa yin/76

mi 'byur ba'i rtags/〈〈g.yu thog bu don ma〉phros/ snying la rlung nad zhugs gyur na/ /mgo bo na zhing brjed ngas che/ /'phyo zhing don med snying mi dga'/ /res 'ga' ma dris mu cor smra/ /res 'ga' dris kyang lan mi 'debs/ /ha'am shu yis 'debs kyis 'khun/ /dbugs thung mi snyan tshig gis dngangs/ /snying chung snying ni stong zhing khengs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/bste/ ṭ+wāṃ/ la/ sems bde/ a gar brgyad pa/ a gar so lnga sogs dpyad du brang gzhung dkar nag mtshams dang / tshigs pa bdun pa/ spyi gtsug rnams me yis gnon dgos/mkhal tshad kyi nad/mkhal mar tsha ba zhugs nas gnyan kha rgyas pa'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/tshad mjug 'grams pa dang / gzha' brlan dang grang ngad rigs kyis lus khams 'khyags pa/ rjen pa dang mngar mo'i rigs bsten drags pa sogs kyis slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/rked pa na zhing gcin kha snyi ba/ gcin yang yang gtong dgos ṭ+wāṃ/

gtong ba'i skabs tsha shar rgyag pa/ gdong dang mig lcibs skrangs pa/dri chu dmar zhing ku ya bye ma 'dra ba gting na gnas pa bcas so/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈gso rig rgyud bzhi〉phros/ mkhal tshad chang 'thung 'gro 'dug byas tshe na/ /chu kha tsha zhing sha rus bar na 'khyug /ces gsungs so/ /gso thabs dngos/thog mar a ru bcu ba/ a ru bco brgyad/ pad rag mdog ldan/sar khyung sogs bsten rgyu dang / rjes su nyi khyung / sug smel bcu ba/se 'bru lnga ba sogs bsten dgos/mkhal 'grams kyi nad/mkhal rked la brdab rmas byung ba sogs kyis chu rtsa 'grams te brla sul nas rkang mthil bar gzer zug yod cing rkang mdzub sbrid pa 'byung ba'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen/mkhal rked brdab rmas byung ba'am gcus pa/ mi theg pa'i khur po trītsan /sdu 'khur ba/ lus khams 'khyags pa sogs kyis slong bar —da dṛ da py-i /rtags/gzhogs ngos gang rung gi rked tshigs sam mtshang rus dang dpyi 78

rus 'brel mtshams brgyud brla rkang dang / sgyid khug pus mo/ rje ngar bcas kyi phyi zur nas rkang mthil bar gyi chu rtsa'i 'brel rgyud du thad kar gzer zug yod pa/ sbrid bam chags pa/ 'gro 'dug dang ngal dub byung tshe lhag par na ba bcas yin/mi nor ba'i rtags/〈〈gso rig rgyud bzhi〉phros/ smad du lhung na rkang ba bshal zhing ṭīd/ // /brla sul byin sul pus mo'i tshigs mtshams na/ /zhes gsungs gso thabs dngos/bsam nor/ bsam khyung / seng ldeng nyer sasum/ cob rtsi/ a gar nyi shu/ bya khyung bcu gsum sogs bsten dgos/dreg gi nad/zas spyod mi 'tshams pa'i rkyen gyis gtso bo ngo bo rlung khrag 'khrugs te thog mar rkang ba'i mthe bong dang rkang mthil rus tshigs dmar nag skrangs te na zug yod pa'i nad cig yin/nad kyi 'byung rkyen chang 'thung ches pa dang / lu sa khams 'khrugs pa/ nyin par gnyid log pa/ chags spyod mang ba/ rdo dang dbyug pas bsnun pa sogs kyis slong bar byed pa yin/79

nad kyi rtags/thog mar rkang ba'i mthe bong dang / bol tshigs/ rkang mthil bcas la ldang dub can gyi na zug drag po yod pa/ dmar nag tu skrangs shing sngo thig yod pa/ ngo bo sra zhing tsha drod rgyas pa/ reg dus bzod sdi thub pa'i na zug yod pa/ mtshan mor na zug je thur 'gro ba bcasdu rte/ra/ ba'i rtags/gong gsal las gzhan/ 〈〈shog dril〉〉pas/ dreg gi rtsa ni sna thung mkhrang la grims/ /khrag tshad rtsa 'dra khyad par cung zhig g.yung / /dreg gi chu la nges med tshad pa 'dra/ /mi nor rtags su rwa gzhob kho na bro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gso thabs dngos/spos khyung bco lnga dang bong khrag nyer lnga gang rung seng ldeng khu bas phul la btang / dwangs ma gnas 'jog dngul chu rin chen bco brgyad/dreg thang / klu bdud bco brgyad sogs gtong dgos/grum bu'i nad/rus pa'i tshigs mtshams la chu ser zhen nas gnyan kha rgyas te chag grum byung ba ltar du gyur pas na grum bu'i nad zer/80

nad kyi 'byung rkyen/thog mar cham pa dang rims tshad sogs ma smin pa'i skabs bcos sngas pa dang / zas spyod log pa/ lus khams 'khyags pa/ bzha' tshan che sar bsdad ches pa sogs kyis slong bar byed pa yin/nad kyi rtags/grang shum yun ring byed cing sha pags brtse ba/ gdong la snum bag chags pa/ mgo dang rked pa dpyi mig rnams na zug yod pa/ shed chung la sgyid pa skyur ba/ lus kyi sha 'bros shing rngul kha snyi ba/ rkang lag bzhi bo na res byed pa/ rus tshigs dang sha rus sogs khol zhing na ba/ chu rgyus gyong la 'gul spyod byas tshe na zug che zhing skad ngan 'don pa/mtshan mo lhag par na ba/ nyin mo gnyid mi thub cing mtshan mo bya ltar yer ba yin no/ /mi nor ba'i rtags/gong gsal las gzhan/ 〈〈shog dril〉phros/ grum bu'i rtsa ni kha drag gting na rgyug /grum bu'i chu ni ser dang rlangs pa che/ /mi nor rtags su ngang ba'i rgyab dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /gso thabs dngos/grum zug chen mo/ klu bdud bco brgyad/ dngul chu bco brgyad/bsam nor/ bong khrag nyer lnga/ se 'bru dwangs gnas sogs gtong daṭ+wāṃs/

zur bkod/gcig nad sman sprod pa'i nyams yigaspre dge bla sman chos grags rgya mtshos brtsams/thog mar nad thams cad kyi sngon 'gro mjug sdud byed pa rlung yin phyir sngon du 'bri ba la/ nad rtags ni/ rtsa stong la chu sngo zhing wu ba che/gnyid mi 'ong / mgo yu 'khor/ snying dang ro stod na gzer 'pho len byed/ wu sob lu/ 'dar g.yeng byed pa rlung yin pas/ de la sman shing kun nyer lnga/ dzā ti bcu bzhi/ ar gar nyer lnga sogs 'phrod/ rlung gsang mgo dkyil/ brang gzhung / gnya' ltag rkang lag dkyil bzhi sogs la phye 'phur byugs/ de yang go snyod phye 'phur byung na zab/ dzā ti mar sbyar byugs/ sha gsar chang bzang sogs btang /de yang khrag dang bsdongs na khrag rlung yin pas dbugs 'tshangs/ro stod gzer shin tu che/ skabs rer bde la skabs rer thu ba res mos byed/ 'di la sman gong gsal rlung gi sman 'di rnams mi 'phrod pas/ 'tshangs che ba dang gzer che na ko byi bdun pa/ rdo rje rab 'joms/ khrag rlung sman dud 'then/ lus byings gzer dmigs nges med la/ a gar so lnga/ a gar bco lnga/ ko byi lnga thang / gser thang bco brgyad/ ge sar bco brgyad/82

cham pa dang bsdongs na/ ko byi lnga thang zab/ sprin bral zla zer/khrag rlung gis mgo gzer na/ thod rus bcu ba'i thang byas nas gong gi sman rnams 'phul rdzas byed/ gdon grib dang bsdongs na/ 'brong rtse ar brgyad/ a gar so lnga gnyis zab che/ rdo rje rab 'joms kyang zab/ko byi bco lnga dang / a gar nyi shu gdon grib shin tu che ba la zab/ brla rkang dpyi rked na srol yod pas/ a gar bco lnga tsam btang na stod smad spyi sman yin pa las skyon med/ phye 'phur byugs na phan/ de min rkang nad kyi sman dang byugs pa'i skor gtan nas mi nyan/ khrag rlung 'di smad du babs tshe 'bam du 'gyur ba'ang srid/'bam yin pa'i rtags ni/ nad stod nas rim bzhin smad du babs pa'am/ stod smad res mos byas nas na/ khrag rlung bcos byas pas 'bam la 'gyur ba yin/ dang po'i dus sman bzi sogs btang mi nyan gnad che/ 'bam nad 'di byung ba'i rgyu rkyen ni/ 'gro che ba dang /sdod che ba dang / chang rag ja khreb sogs 'thung che ba'i las kyis thog mar stod nad smad mkhal rked sogs la babs pa yin/ 'bam rtags ni/ so rkan rgyas/ mig dmar/ mchu sngo nag tu skrangs/ so dang / mur 'gram/ brang dang ro stod na ba 'di rnams smad du babs dus de la sman bzi can mi btang ba gdams ngag yin/ bab sman ni/ gong gi khrag rlung gi sman rnams dang / la phyi'i 'bam thang / lu ba mang du byed 83

ro stod gzer na/ tsan dan bco brgyad 'thung / smug po'i nad gzhi che na/ glang chen bco brgyad dang / thang chen nyer lnga/ pho mchin ma bde tshe man ngag bsil sbyor dang / skyu ru nyer lnga/ mkhal rked ma bde tshe go yu dgu sbyor/ a ru nyer lnga/ a ru bcu ba/ a ru bco brgyad/ bzi med bcas btang / cham pas 'bam dkrug 'ong na cham pa'i sman a gar bco lnga/ bsil bcud bco lnga/ gtso brgyad/ ko byi lnga thang sogs btang / cham pas srin dkrug 'ong na/ gur gum bcu gsum/ tshangs pa dbugs sel du byed 'then na 'di rnams kyis 'bam gzhi la mi gnod/'bam gyi dngos gzhi rtsa dang chu rgyus gzer dmigs shin tu che/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon gang red gcig sa la 'dzugs mi phod 'ong ba'i dus su khog sman ni sngon gyi so lnga dang / glang chen bco brgyad gnyis snga dro dang nyin gzhung / nub mo bong khrag nyer lnga/ zug gzer shin tu che na spos khyung bzi chung can btang bas gzer chen de chag skrangs pa la glog spyi gog zha lugs la 'phar ldang med pa'i dus su/ la phug btang ran rtags yin kyang 'di'i dus gnad 'gag shin tu che/ bzi sman btang bas/ chu rtags wu ba g.yung yod na chu rtags de nang / la phug gri gzhog gcig gnyis 'phen/ des chu rtags dwangs zhad dang / wu ba che na btang ran rtags yin pas/ sha gsar spar mo do'i nang du/ la phug ka hrug spar mo gang btab pa'i skyo thang spyi rgyugs ltar byas nas phor 84

chung gang 'thung / de'i phyir nang thu zhad med na sha spar mo do yi thug pa sngon ltar byas nas phor chung do 'thung / yang de'i phyir nang thu med na la phug 'phrod rtags yin pas de mus zhag gnyis gsum 'thung / de mtshams ma skyon na la phug shun pa bshus nas/ la brdar la brdar ba ras dkar nang nas khu ba phor ba gang tsam bcir/ de dkrugs nas wu ba lan nyi shu tsam phar bcad/ wu ba bcad tshar ba'i la khu dkar yol nang du khyim bya gso bya zer ba'i sgo nga shun do tsam gyi mang nyung de blugasnod gang red kyi nang du dbyar kha yin na bye ma/ dgun kha yin na nas sogs kyi nang du bzhag de ni khengs rul mi 'gro ba'i gnad yin/ kha bkab nas 'ag gcig bzhag phyir nang nyi dros dkar yol chu tshan du bsros te drod 'thung bde dus gtong / snga dro'i skor la kha zas 'dzem rgyu byung na dga'/ de'i phyir nang la phug btsags snyigs de'i nang du dmar bo lnga'i 'byar gyi phye ma btab/ chu cung zad blug chu ma dgos par la khu byug byung na legs/ ska sla zho tsam byas nas me'i thog tu drod brgyab nas/ rkang pa'i skrangs dang / gzer gang yod la khyad par byugs/ de steng ras kyis dkris nas de nub bzhag la phug khu ba 'thung lugs dang / 'byar sogs 'di ltar zhag bdun tsam bya/ skrangs zhi dka' ba dang / gzer ma chag na ni rdo 'byar tshan mo 'byar chen reg pa bde skyid/ byu khyung dmar bo dang sngon po/ la phug khu bar btab 85

nas byugs/ de rnams kyis skrangs dang gzer gtan nas med par song dus/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byug pa snum nag gam mar rnying gang red du bsres nas yun ring byug dgos pa phyi mtha' la gnad che/ 'di rnams kyi tshe la spos khyung dang / seng ldeng nyer lnga 'thung / shin tu bde nas nad lhag sogs med nges byung tshe/ ngar gdong la babs pa rnams la chu ser gdong rtsa sgyid khug la babs pa rnams la byin gzhug dang /long rtsa gang thebs gtar dgos kyang khrag gtar dgos nges can red min lha rje nyams can zhig la dri rtog nan du ma byas na/ na tshod dang bstun pa'i ja bzod che mi nyan/ cis kyang gtar rgyu byas na/ dkar yol lam phor pa 'bring tshad kyi phyed thun tsam las gtar mi nyan/ khrag mang song na/ spangs pa chu gsog dang / rlung gis zin/ lus stobs zhan/ rgas mgyogs lhags ka mi thub/ za ma mi zhu ba sogs red 'ong bas nan tan ci nas gal che/ khrag gtar rgyu dang / me gtar rgyu ci byas kyang lums dang / tsha nyal sogs byas na phan che/ chu gsog gzhi yod na lums mi 'phrod/ chu nyal gyis dga'/ 'bam 'di'i mgo snga ma'i gzhug la nad lhag byung na/mkhris shas che na/ tig brgyad/ 'bring na gser mdog lnga ba/ chung na ril dkar pad sdong / bad kan shas che na/ smug po g.yul rgyal/bde byed kun phan gnyis res mos babs bstun dgos/ bdud rtsi 86

sum sbyor 'thung na'ang phan/ grang khams dkrug 'ong na/ a ru nyer lnga/bsam 'phel nor sbyor/ a ru bcu ba/ gu yu dgu sbyor 'di rnams kyis grang khams la phan/ 'bam gzhi la mi gnod/ za ma ma zhu ba dang /sbran dug skor gyi rigs byung na gong gi bde byed kun phan zhi byed drug pa/ gser mdog lnga pa dang / zhi byed drug pa gnyis bsres pa/ ru rta drug pa shin tu zab/ 'di rnams kyis 'bam gzhi la mi gnod/grum bu'i nad rtags ni/ lag pa'i tshigs dang / gnya' ltag sgal tshigs rnams gzer na/ de 'bam du bsgyur dgos pas/ bab sman dus nas bong khrag nyer lnga btang na de 'bam du 'gyur 'gro bas bcos bde/de las grum bu'i sman gzhan rnams mi btang / rtsa dkar dang bsdongs na/ lag pa dang rkang pa sogs sbrid cing na ba 'ong bas de la rtsa dkar gyi bcos gzhan mi byed par a gar nyi shu dang / bsam 'phel nor sbyor gnyis btang bas/ rtsa dkar 'bam du 'gyur 'gro bas bcos bde/ dreg dang bsdongs byung na/ nad rtags ni/ rkang ba'i mthe bong skrangs/ gzer shin tu che/ de la bcos ni/ spos khyung dang / dngul chu bco brgyad sman bzi can btang / de'i gzer chags nas la bcos byas pas 'thus/ 'bam 'di skrangs gzhi la 'gyur 'gro ba mang bas/de dus chu 'bam la bsgyur ci thub byed dgos pas/ chu gsog la 'gyur ba'i rtags ni/ chu rtags wu ba sob/ rtsa dam zhing phra/ dbugs kha rgod/87

thod pa dang / sna gshong / brang / tshang ra'i mdo/ rkang ldebs bcas skrangs 'ong na/ skrangs pa chu gsog dang po'i rtags yin pa'i chu gsog 'bam du bsgyur ba'i sman ni/ chu rtags ser na/ glang chen chu bsgyur dang / gur gum chu bsgyur/ chu rtags chu mdog ltar red na/ glang chen chu bsgyur dang / da lis bcu drug rnams btang na chu gsog 'bam du 'gyur 'gro bas bzang / 'bam gyis rkang nad gzer zug che byung na/btang snyoms su btang shes dgos/ chu gsog 'bam du 'gyur rtags ni/ chu gsang kho nar skrangs shing zug gzer shin tu che/ 'bam 'ga' re zhig la sngo khra dang / dmar thig sogs 'ong / mdog mi 'gyur ba'ang yod/ de dus la phug cung zad btang snga na legs/snying srog la rlung zhugs pa'i rtags ni/ 'tshig pa za/ gnyid mi 'ong / don med par sems sdug de la gdon can dang / gdon med gnyis yod/ gdon can rigs la rim gro bya/ sman ni/ rdo rje rab 'joms/ srog rlung 'joms rdor/ rgod po gzer 'joms/ sems kyi bde skyid sogs dang / skabs re sga lo yang btang bas phan pa bcas rlung gi bcos yin/mkhris pa'i bcos tshul la/ nad rtags ni/ chu mdog ser/ rtsa grims/ kha kha/ mgo na/ lus byings nyob pa/ zhen pa log de la thang chen nyer lnga/ tig brgyad/ g.ya' kyi nyer lnga sogs btang / pho ba la 88

babs na mkhris khu skyug pho ba gzer/ de la brag zhun dgu ba/ bdud rtsi slebs chog bzi chung can/ brag khyung bzi chung yod pa bcas zab che/rgyu mar babs nas ser po sbyang ba la/ mkhris phye bdun pa dang bug zhun dgu ba zab/grang mkhris kyi zhe log kha zas mi zhu ba la gser mdog lnga ba/g.ya' kyi bdun pa/ se 'bru pad ma 'dab brgyad/ gser mdog lnga ba/zhi drug bsres pa sogs kyis phan/ mkhris srin gyi mgo'i srin tshang gzer ba la gser mdog bcu gcig bzi yod pas phan/bad kan smug pos brang tsha/ chu skyur skyug pho mchin ro rgyab na/'di la dang po drod btang mi nyan pas/ thang chen nyer lnga/ smug po g.yul rgyal/ khrag stobs che na skyu ru nyer lnga/ gi wang dgu ba/ glang chen bco brgyad/ bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ man ngag bsil sbyor bcas btang /des chu mdog dmar smug de dwangs nas/ zas mi zhu ba sbran dug lta bu na ba byung na/ bar gyi smug po 'thab pa'i skabs yin pas g.yu ril/ ru rta drug pa/ cong zhi cur nis bde byed snyoms ldan/ zla shel/ rnam rgyal ril bu bde byed kun phan sogs btang / de rjes mtha' ma grang ba la babs na/ mkhal rked na/ lus zungs zags/ kha zas gtan nas mi zhu ba sogs la/ se 'bru dwangs ma gnas 'jog rdo zho ril bu/ 'phrul thal bco lnga drag sbyor sogs 'phrod/89

bad kan gre thog tu 'gro ba'i rtags/ brang rgyab dang / phrag mig gzer/ brang tsha/ skabs su gre ba'i nang spu yod snyam pa/ phreng rdog lta bu yar 'gro phyir 'gro byed pa sogs byung na gre thog gi rtags yin/'di la sman drod kyi rigs btang mi nyan pas man ngag bsil sbyor/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ spang rgyan nyer lnga/ bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ go gre bco brgyad sogs btang / rang sngags dang lag 'khor gzhan nas gsal ba ltar bya/ pho thog ni/ zas zos tshe yar skyugs nas lus je skam du 'gro ba zhig yin/ 'di la rdo zho ril bu/ 'phrul thal gzhi 'dzin dar gdugs can/ bco lnga drag sbyor sogs zab kyang / las nad yin pas brgya nang re re las thar ba ma mthong bas nad pa la bshad pa mi nyan/ bad kan gyi nad bcos tshul snying po bsdus pa yin/de nas ma zhu bcos pa'i skor la/ ma zhu gsar pa rnams la zhi drugabaco lnga drag sbyor/ dkar po drug sbyor sogs kyis phan/ zhag grangs ma zhu na/ ru rta drug pa/ g.yu ril/ zla shel/ rnam rgyal ril bu/ mang sbyor dang / dbang ril/ rta ri ma/ shel dkar mchod rten/ rin chen ril bu sogs dug gi bcos kho na bya dgos/skran bcos pa'i skor ni/ skran 'di ma zhu bas skyed pa zhig yin/yun lon pa la skran zer/ tsha grang gnyis yod/ gsar pa rnams tsha shas che/ nang rtags ni/ gar yod kyi steng der dreg pa chags/ lto stong lag 90

pas byang bas gsal/ sman rdo zho ril bu/ 'phrul thal/ dar mgon me mnyam/ bye ba ring bsrel gyi me mnyam chen po sogs 'phrod/skya rbab 'or/ dmu chu gsum pha tsho lta bu gcig gi khong du gcig gtogs la/ thog mar pho ba'i me zhan pa dang / lus rgas mi sa chu sogs ma 'phrod pas slong bar/ skya rbab ni phal cher glo bar babs pa'i lu skyug byed cing / mig wags dang / rkang ldebs skrangs pa zhig yin/'di la chu mdog ser kha byung tshe 'bol sman bdun pa/ da li bcu drugaglo sman tsan dan bco lnga/ bdud rtsi 'chi sos sogs btang / des ngo lon na dwangs ma chu 'dren dang / se 'bru kun phan gyis nad gzhug bcad/ de la skrangs dang chu ser ba dang / tsha shas cher song na dmu chu dang / 'or sogs yin pas/ 'bol sman bdun pa/ bong dkar bcu ba/glang chen gang hā chu bsgyur/ bde byed chu bsgyur/ gur gum chu bsgyur/chu rtsi nyer lnga sogs btang bas grang chur bsgyur/ grang chur 'gyur ba'i rtags ni/ skrangs zhi/ chu dwangs pa sogs byung na bde byed kun phan/dwangs ma chu 'dren/ chu sman bde ba'i 'khor lo sogs btang / 'on kyang 'di la drod che rigs ni mi 'phrod par shes dgos/tsha ba dang / rims gnyis bcos lugs gcig gis 'thus la/rims dang / tsha ba sogs lus 'dar 'khyag snang shar zhing mgo dang lha bzhi gzer/ de dus ma smin pa yin pas nor bu bdun thang thun gsum 91

blud/ gtso brgyad/ sprin bral zla zer/ rlung che na bsil bcud bco lnga/phyi nang 'khyag snang sogs byung tshe khyung sngon dgu ba tsam btang / des ma phan na/ rtsa grims/ chu dmar ba sogs red 'ong ba de smin rtags yin/ de dus mkhris shas che na bdud rtsi slebs chog spang rtsi bcu gnyis sogs btang /tsha ba red nas/ glo snying sogs don snod la babs pas rtsib ma gzer/ khrag lu/ dbugs stod du 'tshang ba sogs byung tshe/ rta zi dmar po/ gtso khyung / rta zi ser po/ khyung sngon dgu ba/ a byag drug thang / sro ma rta ri'i bshal sogs btang /mgo tshad la/ gser mdog bcu gcig mgo thang gsum/ pho tshad la/ brag khyung / slebs chog brag zhun dgu ba sogs btang / rgyu mar babs tshe/ mkhris phye nyer lnga/ mkhris phye bdun pa/ bdud rtsi slebs chog sogs btang / rims dang tsha ba'i sman rnams bzi che ba gal che/ sman de rnams kyis phan na/ chu dwangs shing wu ba che/ rtsa dal/ gzer chog nas ri thang mtshams slebs pa yin/ de dus/ snod tshad kyi ri thang brtag pa'i sman/ man ngag bsil sbyor/ cu gang bde byed sogs thun chung btang / don tshad kyi ri thang brtag pa'i sman/ a gar bco lnga/ so lnga gnyan sman can sogs thun chung btang ba'i phyir nang chu dwangs shing /khams bde ba dang / thu zhad med tshe de ltar nyin gnyis gsum btang /92

sre long gtong lugs ni/ nor gyi sre long gsar ba lpags phud pa dum bu bdun byas pa'i dum gnyis tsam zhag bcad nas nyin gsum btang / des bde nyams yod na/ sha gsar byi'u ro tsam btang / rgas po sogs la chu dwangs yang la phug legs par btang dgos/ cham pas gre ba tsha ba la/ khyung sngon dgu ba/ 'khrug glo kun sel sogs kyis phan/lug mur bdun pa 'di cham pa thu mo la mi 'phrod/ rims 'gos rgyu yod pa'i rigs 'di rnams la/ spru nag nyer dgu/ sngo ril sogs sman bzang gras yin/ rims dang tsha ba la thog mtha' kun tu mngar rigs 'gro ba dang / ga bur gyi skor btang mi nyan pa gdams ngag yin/ dus dbang gis thor pa/ skrangs 'bur/ ske skrangs/ pho skrangs/ mig rims sogs mang bas lhan thabs gnyan gyi le'u ltar bcos/mgo gzer bcos skor ni/ bad mkhris khrag mkhris rnams ni mgo byings gzer/ srin nad kyi mgo phyed re dang / so mur 'gram sogs gzer bas shes/ khrag mkhris la gi tig grang mkhris la gser mdog lnga ba/ ril dkar pad sdong sogs zab/ srin la gur gum bcu gsum/gser mdog bcu gcig bzi yod pa/ gar nag dgu pa bzi yod pa/gur khyung sogs btang / gdong srin la tshangs pa dbugs sel/ tha ma kha ltar 'then pas phan/so srin la/ khyung lnga bzang po so bar bzung ba sogs yin lags/9 3

khrag dang 'bam gyi rkan rtsa g.yos pa la/ ldong ros drug pa dang / nag mtshur sum thang sogs khar bzung mchil ma 'pho/ 'bam smad du bab legs byung na bder 'gro/mig nad skor ni/ dmar po tsha ba can khrag mig zur za ba srin/mchi ma zags nas tsha ba rlung yin/ na tsha med nas mi mthong ba rnams bad kan yin/ khrag rkyen la/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ sga lo/ tsan+dan bco brgyad/rlung rkyen la/ so lnga/ a gar bco lnga sogs skabs su bstun/ mig srin la gur gum bcu gsum/ bad kan can la/ bdud rtsi sum spyor/ lcags ril/ zla shel/ gur gum nyer lnga/ nyi zla'i 'khor lo sogs khong sman dang / skyer khan dang / spos reng chung ba ni mig sman spyi khyab bzang /mig rlung la/ dzā ti/ go snyod sogs btab pa'i zan dron mos bsros byed pa las mig sman gyis phan cher ma mthong /rna ba'i nad ni/ rna skyag skya bo can 'ur sgra grags pa rlung yin/gzer 'khyug cing rna skyag snum zhad can de/ khrag dang srin yin/ rlung la shing kun nyer lnga 'thung / shing kun nyer lnga'i phye ras thum mar khur btsos pa bcir pa bcir bas phan/ srin la/ gur khyung / lang thang nyer lnga/ rtsa rtsi rdo sbyor/ gur gum bcu gsum sogs btang / 'chi med srin sel/ ug chos bcu pa'i khu ba byugs/ rnag zags pa la la phug khu ba dang / ra gcin blug pa sogs btang / spyir mkhal bcos bgyis 94

pas 'thus che/snying gi nad rnams gong gi khrag rlung gi skabs gsal bas smos ma dgos/ lag len yod na btsan dug sman mar yang zab/glo nad bcos skor/ nad 'di cham pa dang khrag 'khrug sogs kyi nad mjug glo bar zhen pa yin/ glo tshad gong gi tsha ba'i skabs su song bas mi dgos/ glo nad kun la thog mar gtso bo nyer lnga dang / tsan+dan bco lngas tshad pa bcagaglo rnag rtags chu gar zhing ku ya sprin ltar 'ong / de la dkar po yar 'dren rlung shas dang / gnyan kha med na ga bur nyer lnga/ darnga/'a bo bcu bzhi sogs btang bas/ lu ba gar nas 'ong / mtha' lu ba skya sob can du 'gyur zhing chu dwangs/ rlung rtags byung na so lnga/ drang srong ar brgyad/ a gar bco lnga sogs btang zhing / sha gsar dang / ba 'os lus gso zhing / cu gang nyer lnga yun ring 'thung / bad glo 'tshang ba rnams la rgun 'brum bdun pa/ spang rgyan bco lnga yang zab/ glo rlung wu sob lu ba sel/ a gar gyi sbyor ba rnams dang / bdud rtsi 'chi sos/'khrug glo kun sel sogs 'o chang 'os bstun 'phul dgos/mchin pa'i bcos skor/ chu dmar smug kan rtsa 'bur/ yang na zhan/ mig dmar/ ngo smug pa sogs 'ong / rtsib logs g.yas gzer/chang rag 'thung che ba dang / smug po'i khrag rul mchin par lhag pa 95

sogs kyis 'ong / mkhris pa yun lon gyis kyang 'ong / 'di nad zhen shor tshe bcos dka'i nad yin pas/ thang chen bco brgyad/ gur gum chu bsgyur/ glang chen nyer lnga/ lcags ril/ zla shel/ mang sbyor sogs kyis bcos nas/ mchin rtsa gtar/ smug po'i shas che tshe grang gzhi med na/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ spyi la bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ g.yul rgyal/ man bsil sogs kyang zab/ mchin pa'i lu ba byed pa mang bas/ lud pa skya sob can yin/ de la nyi zla kha sbyor zab/mtsher nad ni/ sbos gzer byed/ mchu sngo/ skrangs/ glog shu 'ong /shu thor 'ong / mkhan yang mang / shig mang/ de la chu dmar na/ ko la bco brgyad/ a ru bdun pa sogs btang / zhi drug a ru bdun pa bsres pa zab/ za 'phrug byung na de steng spos bcu bsdebs pa zab/mkhal ma'i nad bcos skor/ 'di dang po khrag nad smad du babs pa'i rgyu yin pas/ da lta grang khrag dang / rtsa 'gram gnyan 'gram sogs ming btags 'di yin/ chu dmar po snyigs ma can mkhal rked gzer ba zhig yin/ 'di la a ru bcu ba/ a ru nyer lnga/ a ru bco brgyad btang / ar khyung / sār khyung sogs kyis gnyan tshad gcog de nas chu dwangs/ gzer chag tshe nyi dkyil/ go yu dgu sbyor/ a ru 'ba' sam se 'bru lnga pa sogs btang bas 'thus/ lar ni/ deng sang mo 'dre dang /klu gdon che bas/ nad 'di 'gram shas che ba las mi 'ong /96

'grams yin rtags chu lam tsha rgyu zhabs gzer/ chu lam nas 'o rul lta bu'i snyigs ma zags pa de ser shas che na khrag dang gnyan yin/sngo shas che na/ rlung dang grang ba yin/ res 'ga' gcin dang zags pa thams cad khrag rang du 'ong ba yang yod/ 'di la gnyan dang gdon chen po yod/ thog mar drod 'gro mi nyan/ ar khyung / sā khyung / a ru bco brgyad/ chos nyid dmar po sogs kyis gnyan bcag nas yun ring 'thung / zug gzer chag chu'i dmar mdangs yal na/ go yu dgu sbyor/ nyi dkyil/ bsam 'phel nor sbyor/ a ru bcu sogs btang /shin tu zug gzer med pa zhig byung skabs/ nyi zla gyen bzlog sug smel bcu ba/ a ru zags gcod sogs gtong / 'bras bu spangs pa dang / pho rtags 'grengs nas skrangs pa sogs kyang 'di'i khongs su gtogs pas/ 'di la bre ga bcu gsum/ rtsa thag bcu drug chos nyid ma sogs btang / na so rgas pa la me btsa' dang gzhon pa la khrag gtar/skabs gar bab shes dgos/snod kyi nad bcos skor/ mkhris pa'i nad ni mkhris bcos kyis 'thus/ pho ba'i nad rnams bad kan skabs ltar bcos pa dang / long ni nadarlung dang bad kan phyed mar bcos/ rgyu ma'i nad rnams mkhris pa ltar bcos/ sgang pa dang bsam se'u nad rnams ma/khal ma'i bcos kyis 'thus/ tsha grang gi rtags rnams dbye phye shes par gal che/97

gcin 'gags pa ni/ bad kan gyi be snabs rtsa sbubs su 'khar ba dang / rlung gis lgang pa kha log pa dang / grang bas chu rgyu'i lam 'gags pa sogs yod/ mo nad dang rims kyis chu 'gags pa'ang mthong / bad kan grang rlung gis chu 'gags pa la/ sug smrel bcu ba/gu gul bcu gcig zab/ mo nad kyis chu 'gags pa la rdo rje can bcas btang /gcin ma tshogs na 'gram bcos kyis 'thus pas mi dgos/rkang ba'i dreg nad khrag ngan chu ser rtsa la babs pa zhig yin/'di rkang mthe bong la babs pa shes/ bong khrag nyer lnga/ spos khyung /spos bcu/ klu bdud/ khyung lnga/ grang shas che na/ seng ldeng nyer lnga/ mdzo gcin lci ba sogs kyis 'byar byas pas zhi/ gtar me sogs mthong brgyud ltar bya/chu ser ni/ za 'phrug byed pa'i rigs yin/ sman gong gi dreg sman las zur du mi dgos/ byug pa reg pa bde skyed bya khyung shel ral can sogs byugs pas 'thus/lpags nad rgan yang gong gi dreg nad skabs 'di las zur du mi dgos/rtsa dkar 'di brdab 'grams dang / rlung dang / grib sogs kyis rkyeḍi8 las dpung sog gru mo gnya' ba sogs na ba zhig yin pas/ byug

pa rtsa dkar kun sel/ rdo byug sogs byed la/ khong du bsam 'phel nor sbyor/ da li bco brgyad/ rtsa dkar bya khyung rat+na bsam 'phel sogs btang / gser tshugs rwa tshugs/ seng ldeng gi tshugs sogs zab/khrag gtar ba mi 'phrod/kha skom nad bcos skor/ skom nad 'di khrag dang smug po rlung sogs shas gang che'i sman dang / so phag sum thang / tsan+dan bco brgyad/spang rgyan bco lnga sogs zab che/kig ge'am skyigs bu'i bcos skor 'di tsha ba'i rjes su rlung zhugs pa'am/ bad kan gyen rgyu'i gnas su babs pa la 'ong / 'di che nas pho thog tu 'gyur ba shas che/ 'di la me btsa' dkar nag mtshams bsreg pa dang / rlung la a gar bco lnga/ bad kan la go gre bco brgyad sogs zab/ tshad gzhug la/ a gar so lnga sogs bzang /glang thabs bcos skor/ nad ni pho long gi srin 'bu kha zas ma 'phrod pas slong ba zhig yin/ 'dir gnyan glang dang / srin glang / ma zhu dug smug gi glang thabs gsum yod/rtags ni/ gnyan glang pho ba gris dkrugs pa ltar gzer/ srin glang pho ba lhod 'byar byas nas na/ smug po glang thabs ni sbos nas rngul chu 'dzag cing na/ dang po gnyan gyi glang thabs la/ 'chi med srin sel bzi chung can/ phan pa kun ldan/ ru khyung sogs btang / srin 99

gyi glang thabs la'ang de phan/ smug po'i glang thabs la g.yu ril bcu gsum/ zla shel/ ru rta drug pa sogs zab nges yin/ glang thabs spyi la/dmar po spyi 'joms bzi med kyis sbyangs kyang zab lags/ skyugs nas sman ma blangs na/ bu ram sen mo tsam btab nas/ de rjes sman gyi rigs btang bas mi skyug cis kyang ma phan na/ ni ru ha tshad ldan gyis bcos/smug po'i glang thabs long rtsa gtar/ srin glang me btsa' bzhagaganyan glang sman gyis bcos dgos pa'ang shes dgos par bya'o/ /srin nad mgo bcos kyi skabs su song bas mi dgos/sbyong skyug bcos skor/ sbyong ba la tsha sbyong mdog dmar ser 'byung /grang sbyong skya bo zas mdog kho na sbyong bas/ tsha sbyong la mkhris phye bdun pa/ in+d+ra bzhi thang / in+d+ra bco lnga sogs zab/ grang sbyong la da trig bdun dgu/ gu ling 'bras kyi ril bu sogs kyis bcad dgos kyang /bcad snga byas na gzer che 'ong bas mtshams shes dgos/sgyug pa rnams/ shing mngar drug pa/ 'bras yos gsum pa sogs kyis bcad/ dang po gdal me bzhag pas 'thus pa lags/byis pa'i nad phal cher/ rna be+er rgyas na tsha ba dang / rims/ phra stong grang ba sogs yin pas/ rims tshad kyi nad la/ blon po sum sbyor/phyi rgyud gur gum bdun pa'i 'phrul 'khor/ nyams yig nang gsal 100

ltar/ na lugs dang rna rtsa bstun pa'i sman bya bas 'thus/mo nad kyi rigs ni/ khrag tshabs khrag mkhris dang / de nyid rgas nas rlung yin par/ thog mar khrag tshabs dus/ sgyug rtsi nyer lnga/ pho ba na tshe star bu bcu dgu rgyu zhabs dang ro stod stel nas na tshe/ rgya ru bcu bzhi/ mngal skran byis pa ltar chags pa la tsha bsreg sbyor ba sogs btang / mngal bshal sogs bya/ kun gyi mtha' la long rtsa gtar zhing /rang gsang mes bsdams pas 'thus/yan lag chag pa la/ bya mo khud pa'i bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ 'bri lugs thig sman/ rim pa bcu gsum/ gnam gter mgo sman sogs ༵ṭ+wāṃ/ba/ rma kha la bcad 'byor nyer lnga/ ldum chen brgyad sbyor sogs sbyar dug la/ thog mar bsdu gsod kyi thang sman pa gzhung chen gyis sbyar ba btang / de rjes ko ṭha'i bshal/ dbang ril shel dkar/ rta ri ma/ mang sbyor ril nag chen mo sogs btang bas rjes chod par gsungs pa sogs rang gi gang shes kyi nad sman sprod thabs rags rim du zhus pa lags/rgas dang ro tsa gso ba'i skor man ngag shes pa'i gang zag cig las tho yor shes lo tsam gyis mi 'thus pas ma bris pa sogs/ 'di skor la 'khod pa rnams mkho dgos gang che'i rigs thams cad nag 101

'gros kyis sil bur ston pa yin cing / res 'ga' lag len shes dka' ba rnams tho tsam bris pa las ci ltar bris kyang slob dpon gyi gsung rgyun dang mthong rgyus med par nad steng du 'gro dka' bas rgya cher ma bris pa chad pa'i skyon du ma rtog cig /

zur bkod/gnyis/ nad sman sprod pa'i nyams yig bdud rtsi'i dzigs pa/stag bla nor bus brtsams/o su ste/ /bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po dang / /drang srong rig 'dzin brgyud bcas la/ /bdag yid gus pas phyag bgyis te/ /nad sman sprod pa'i nyams yig ni/ /mdo tsam bdag gis brjod par bya/ /de la 'dir dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi brtse ba gcig tu bsdus pa a tsa ra mkha' lding nag po dang sman gyi lha mo grub pa'i blo gros ma gnyis kyi 'phrin las las byung ba'i gangs can 'dir gso ba rig pa'i rgyud dang man ngag las byung ba ji snyed kyi bcud phyung ste/ sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis nyams yig rgyu rkyen dbye ba rtags bcos la sogs pa man ngag rgyud dang kho bos bris pa'i tho le kor gyi rtsa 'grel mtha' dpyad sogs las shes par bya'o/ /nad rnams kun gyi sngon 'gro dang mjug sdud rlung yin pas rlung gi nad rtags shar na/ a gar so lnga/ a gar nyer lnga/ rlung sman dkar po gcig thub/ bad mkhris dang ldan na dkar po gcig thub ut+pal brgyad cu dzā ti go snyod sgog skya'i kha bsgyur can dang / 'don bzhi 103

sogs rig pas dpyad de bcos/ de'i steng du mgo rlung la thab dkyil gyi sas me btsa' dang / shing kun nyer lnga/ mgo thang gsum pa shing kun gyis kha bsgyur ba/ mkhris pa dang ldan na tig ta'i 'phrul 'khor sogs zab/ rna bar rlung zhugs na sgog skya dang sman chen gyi khu ba re res kyang phan par snang / mig rlung la go snyod dang 'bru mar rtsam pa dang bsres te mig yang yang phyi/ bya mtshal lu'i brun go snyod dang bsres nas glum byas pas kyang phan par snang / sna rlung la 'tshangs pa dbul sel shing kun gyis kha bsgyur ba 'then/ lce rlung la ut+pal tsha sbyor pi ling dang cha mnyam sbyar ba lce thog tu bzung / dbyangs can ril bus kyang phan/srog rlung rdo rje rab 'joms/ srog rlung 'joms pa'i rdo rje/ li shi nyer lnga sogs zab/ khrag rlung la ko byi bdun pa/ ga bur brgya rtsa a gar gyis kha bsgyur pa sogs zab/ snying rlung la bi ma la/ sems kyi bde skyed/sha chen nyer lnga/ bad mkhris dang ldan na ga bur brgya rtsa ri bong dang bya rgod snying gis kha bsgyur pa sogs zab/ don lnga snod drug la rlung zhugs pa dang sha rus pags pa la rlung zhugs pa sogs mdor na rlung nad drug cu rtsa gsum po'i rang rang gi sgos bcos rnams man ngag rgyud kyi sgos bcos dang kho bos bris pa'i nad kyi dgra dpung 'joms pa'i tho ba las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mkhris nad la tig ta brgyad pa/ tig ta nyer lnga/ pho bar 104

mkhris pa babs na g.ya' kyi nyer lnga/ karma mtshan dpe'i sman nag sman nag brgyad pa/ gnyan dang bsdongs na brag khyung dgu ba/ chu yi 'phrul 'khor bya/ mgo bo gzer na gser mdog bcu sacig gser mdog lnga ba/ mgo thang gsum pa tig ta gtso bor byas pa sogs zab/ mkhris skran la gar nag bcu gcig ut+pal brgyad cu mgron bus kha bsgyur pa sogs zab/ mkhris sman spyir ga bur/ ut+pal bsil sbyor/ thang chen sogs 'phrod/ tshangs pa'i sman sbyor stong dang rtsa gnyis las tsha ba thams cad la gur kum gyis kha bsgyur ba dang / grang ba thams cad la se 'brus sel bar bshad pas gur kum bdun pa bcu bzhi po gang rigs dang / se 'bru lnga pa gur kum kha bsgyur pa dang / khrag dang bsdongs na skyu ru nyer lnga 'phrul 'khor can dang / uṣ+pel tig tas kha bsgyur ba sogs zab/ don lnga snod drug sha rus pags pa sogs la nad zhugs pa'i bcos thabs dgra dpung 'joms pa'i tho lusnu/ las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa bad kan nad rang rgyud can la phag mo grub pa / bsreg sbyor bco lnga/ cong zhi 'phrul thal/ grang 'joms bdud rtsi dpa' bo sogs zab/ bad kan gzhan rgyud can ser po smug po gnyis las ser po la gser zhi kha sprod/ bdud rtsi sum sbyor/ bdud tig kha sprod/ gar nag bcu ba sogs mdor na bad mkhris ldan pa'i nad rnams sel ba'i 105

sman dag rig pas 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /smug po la byer ba/ rgyas pa/'gyings pa/ rdol ba gang yin kyang ut+pal bsil sbyor/ da li brgya rtsa/bdud rtsi lnga sbyor/ phag grub/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ se 'bru brgyad pa/ dkar po chig thub rnams kyis phan pa myong grub bo/ /man ngag rgyud nas bshad pa'i rdo rtsi sngo gsum gyi sbyor ba dang / byer rgyas sogs la gang la gang phan dang / yan lag brgyad pa'i smug po'i sman bzhi sbyor sogs kyis phan pa myong grub bo/ /bad kan gre bar babs pa'i mgul 'gag la/ mkha' 'gro bcu sbyor/ be khrag nyer lnga/ dkar po chig thub sman nad thon nus/ go gre bcu bdun/ go gre bco brgyad/ 'brong khrag drug pa/ ga bur brgya rtsa li shi spang rgyan ru rta cha mnyam byas pa rnams zab/an stong tshigs pa dang po sogs nad dmigs gang cher hor gyi me btsa' gdab/ phan pa byung na me btsa' dngos bzhag 'di'i bcos rgyas pa ra mo shel sman gyis gsungs pa ltar byas na phan pa myong grub bo//bad 7na pho bar babs pa'i pho thog 'di 'chi nad yin kyang gsar ba'i dus bcos byas na phan pa myong grub bo/ /de la grang 'joms bdud rtsi dpa' bo/ rdo zhun pho ba ris dang mnyam sbyor rgyun sman bsten/ gzer che dus dkar po chig thub 'thung / bad kan mang du skyug pa la mi sun par yang nas yang du btung nas srin 'bu skyug thub na phan pa myong grub bo/ /gzhan yang rdo zhun nyer bdun/ cong zhi drug pa/ ut+pal tsha 106

sbyor/ se 'bru brgyad pa/ se 'bru lnga pa/ se 'bru cur nis sogs rig pas 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /skya rbab la thog mar da li brgya rtsa/ da li bdun pa/ da li bcu drug da li brgyad pa/ da li dgu pa/ lcags phye bco lnga/ a gi brgya rtsa sogs kyis phan pa myong grub bo/ /'or du lhung na gong sman rnams dang a gi drug thang / gur kum bdun pa/ dwangs ma chu 'byed/ ut+pal dgu pa/ chu sbyong gis kyang phan par snang ngo / /dmu chu la ra mo shel sman gyis mdzad pa'i gsang sman rnams dus su btu zhing skam gsed legs par bgyis pa'i sman sbyor rnams dang /srad rigs dgu'i khaṣ+ṭa/ glang chen gang ga chu bsgyur/ ut+pal bsil sbyor/'bol sman bdun pa/ nor bu chu dwangs/ da li nyer lnga/ sprin bral zla zer/ yan lag brgyad pa'i bzhi sbyor/ 'u su nyer lnga sogs mdor na tsha chu grang chur bsgyur ba la stobs bskyed de rig pas 'phrul shes par bya'o//grang chur 'gyur nas se 'bru lnga pa rgyun sman 'thung / skabs dang skabs su shi kru drug bdun re chig rgyug tu btang / nad pa'i nyams dang sbyar te se 'bru nyer lnga/ skyu ru nyer lnga/ ut+pal tsha sbyor/ chu mang du 'phel te lus gsob na tsha chu la mar gsar/ grang chu la mar rnying du sbyar te byug pa reg pa bde byed yang yang byug tsha chu gtar na srog 'dor bas mi 107

gtar/ grang chu yang yang gtar la khrag nyung du dbyung / me btsa' gdab pas kyang phan/ chu bsags 'di bcos dka' zhing shes sla ba yin pas rgyud dang man ngag gces btus sogs las shes par bya'o/ /gcong chen sde bzhi'i rtsa ba ma zhu ba yin pas de bcos thabs la/dwangs ma ma zhu bar se 'bru dwangs ma gnas 'jog grang 'joms bdud rtsi dpa' bo/ dom nag drug pa/ man rgyud se 'bru kha bsgyur can rnams zab/ snyigs ma ma zhu na zhi drug zla shel/ rdo zhun drug pa/ rdo zhun nyer lnga/ mkhris pa dang bsdongs na gser zhi kha sprod/ rlung dang bsdongs na kha ru tshwa bsnan pa'i se 'bru drug pa/ pho gsang rnams su me btsa' gdab/gcong chen zad byed la g.yi spyang khyi gang rung gi pags pa rked par dkri/ mi sha za ba'i gcan gzan gyi sha za/ grang 'joms dkar nag gang rung la spyang ki'i pho ba dang go ba'i sha mnyam bsres zab/ zhi drug che chen/ phag grub/ bsreg sbyor bco lnga/ tsi tra ka dang dom nag drug pa mnyam bsres sogs gang la gang phan rnams rig pas 'phrul te shes par bya'o/ /tshad nad bcu drug la nor bu bdun thang / thang chen nyer lnga/thang chen brgya rtsa sogs kyis sdud smin byas la/ gtso brgyad/ gur kum bdun pa/ ga bur nyer lnga/ gnyan rlung cham pa can gyi tshad pa la ga 108

bur brgya rtsa/ ut+pal brgyad cu/ spang rtsi bcu gnyis/ bdud rtsi slebs chog khyung sngon dgu pa/ g.yu thog ldum bzhi/ spru nag nyer dgu/ khyung lnga sogs gang phan rig pas 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /gnyan nad bco brgyad la sgos bcos nad kyi dgra dpung 'joms pa'i tho lum dang sde srid lhan thabs/ e yig bdud rtsi bum pa che chung sogs las shes par bya'o/ /spyi sman la dkar po chig thub/ karma mtshan dpe'i sman nag yang sman nag chen mo/ glo tshad la gzer 'joms lnga pa/ gnyan kha med la gla rtsi bzhi sbyor/ rna rtsa phus 'debs la sman chen chig rgyug pho glang la khyung lnga/ brag khyung dgu pa/ 'chi med srin sel/rgyu gzer la in+d+ra bzhi thang / mgo gzer la mgo thang gsum pa/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyug la sman nag brgyad pa/ mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i be+e ga'i sman/gla rtsi snyi waṃ gur kum dom mkhris bzhi mnyam gyi thang 'di nyid mkhris pa rtsar rgyug gi sman du sbyar na phan pa sman pa rnams kyi myong grub bo/ /de la sogs pa'i gnyan bcos rnams deng dus gter gsar na yod pa rnams kyang phan thogs che bar snang /mgo nad la mgo thang gsum pa/ shing kun nyer lnga/ tig ta'i 'phrul 'khor/ mgo khrol bskol ba dang mgo bo'i re thag bzhi la me btsa' gdab pa yang bzang bar snang / gzhan yang ga bur brgya rtsa/ut+pal brgyad cu gang rung la kha bsgyur rlung la shing kun/ mkhris par 109

tig ta/ bad kan la mi thod dang 'brug rus kyis kha bsgyur ba sogs kyang bzang /mig nad la mig sman bdud rtsi sum sbyor bzhi sbyor/ gsal byed spos ring / gsal byed lnga pa sogs byug sman zab/ 'thung sman gsal byed nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/ a wa lnga sbyor/ lcags phye lnga sbyor/ 'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar sogs kyang bzang / mig sman chig rgyug skor la na hu'i 'phel gdung mig tu bzhag pa dang / skyes chen dam pa'i dbu ljon gyi du ba mig tu bdug pa/ du tsha'i du ba dang go snyod mar sbyar rkang mthil du byug pa dang / rta nag gi rnga mas ling thog len pa dang / ni la tho ṭhas kyang lon/ rgya shog gi dud pa dang la cha'i du bas kyang phan zer/ut+pal brgyad cu go snyod dzā ti mnyam sbyor bzang bar snang ngo / /rna nad la ug chos lnga pa dang / ug chos bcu sbyor/ ru rta gnyis thang / sman chen dang sgog skya sogs rlung la mar/ mkhris par chu/ bad kan la sbrang rtsi'i chu dang sbyar te rna bar gtigs na phan pa myong grub bo//yang na rna bar spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dwangs gsal zhig bsgom nas sngags 'di bzla/ o ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ sang sang yer yer swā hā/ mang du bzlas nas phus gdab na phan/sna nad la tshangs pa dbugs sel gla rtsi dang mnyam sbyor sna nad kun la 'then na phan par snang / ga bur brgya rtsa spang spos dang mnyam 110

sbyor 'then kyang bzang / sna nad kyi bcos man rgyud nas gsungs pa rnams lag len la thebs na shin tu bzang ngo / /rtse nad la spyang lce bdun pa sogs dang lce bzhar gyis lce dag par byas nas pi pi ling thur mgo gang gdab pa dang man rgyud nas bshad pa'i lce bcos rnams kyang bzang / spyang lce pi pi ling a ru ra rnams ut+pal brgyad cu dang mnyam sbyor lce nad kun la phan/ lce gag gcod pa dang lce rtsa gtar ba rnams man rgyud nas bshad pa ltar bya/kha nad la a ru nag tshur skyer ba gsum pos mkhur bkang zhing phyir 'pho/ ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi gang rung mur ba dang rlung mkhris bad kan gang yin gyi gnyen po bsten/so nad la shing rta drug pa/ srin 'joms yun bsten so yi bcud len sogs dang dkar po chig thub so bar du bzung nas zhu ba'i tshe na bsku/ yang na gang na ba'i so'i mgo bsreg ka bar me btsa' bzhag nas so mi na'am zhes sogs rten 'brel dang sngags bcos rnams bzang bar snang /gre nad la spang rgyan bco lnga/ nyer lnga/ ru rta drug pa sogs dang spang rgyan ru rtas ga bur kha bsgyur sogs kyang bzang /mgul wa la man rgyud dang e waṃ nas gsungs pa rnams zab/snying nad la bi ma la/ sems kyi bde skyed/ a gar brgyad pa/ a 111

gar nyer lnga/ so lnga/ rdo rje rab 'joms/ srog rlung 'joms rdor sogs dang man rgyud nas bshad pa'i rang rang gi bcos dang / nyes gsum gang yin gyi gnyen po kho bo'i rtsa sman gsum rang rang la 'bri snying 'brong snying ri bong snying bya rgod kyi snying sogs snying sna gang 'dzoms dang / dzā ti li shi go snyod tang kun sgog skya rnams kyis kha bsgyur pa'am gang rigs kyis kha bsgyur na phan pa myong grub bo/ /glo nad la cu gang nyer lnga/ bse ru nyer lnga/ zangs thal nyer lnga/skyu ru nyer lnga 'phrul 'khor can/ rgun 'brum bdun pa/ star bu pañtsa/wa glo bdun pa/ cu gang brgya rtsa/ rgun 'brum ka ra shing mngar sbrang rtsi gang rigs kyis rtsa sman gsum la kha bsgyur pa'am/ yang na cu gang ka ra ga bur rnams bongs cher bskyed de ut+pal kha bsgyur te gtong ba dang / deng dus gnyan kha dar bas ga bur gtong mi rung tshul sman pa mkhas pa'i ngag rgyun la 'dug kyang e yig tu glo nad thog mtha' gang rung la ga bur zhig ma song na mi sos gsungs pas/ ga bur nyer lnga/ga bur dgu pa/ ga bur lnga pa sogs tshad ldan dang / ga bur gcig rgyug gtong tshul la mkhas par bslab pa dang / deng dus rig ldan ril bu zer ba yang phan par snang /mchin nad la brag zhun dgu pa/ gur kum bdun pa sogs dang rtsa sman gsum pa gur kum/ pri yang ku/ brag zhun/ gla gor zho sha gang 112

rigs kyis kha bsgyur pa zab/mtsher nad la ko la bdun pa/ ko la bco brgyad/ tsha ba gsum dang ka ko la rgyam tshwa rnams sha tshil nang du zhib par 'thag la g.yag lug gi mtsher ba'i nang du blug ste zos na phan pa myong grub bo/ /mkhal nad la go yu bdun pa/ sār khyung ar khyung sogs dang grang nad la sug smel bdun pa dang / tsha ba gsum dang sug smel bongs cher bskyed de ut+pal brgyad cu kha bsgyur pa zab/pho nad la se 'bru lnga pa/ se 'bru nyer lnga/ se 'bru nyi dkyil/ se 'bru brgyad pa sogs dang / tsi tra ka se 'bru pho ba ris gang rigs kyis bsgyur pa zab bo/ /long la kha ru tshwa bsnan pa'i se 'bru lnga pa/ brgyad pa/ rgyam tshwa bzhi thang bca' sga chu bskol sogs dang / kha ru tshwa rgyam tshwa sogs tshwa rigs gang rnyed lcags thab tu brngos nas rtsa sman gsum la kha bsgyur pa'am/zhi drug la kha bsgyur pas phan pa myong grub bo/ /rgyu ma'i nad la tshwa rigs gsum dang tsha ba gsum gyis rtsa sman gsum la kha bsgyur pa'am/ man ngag rgyud kyi rgyu ma'i nad rigs kyi sman rnams zab par snang /sgang pa'i nad la chu sbur bdun pa/ chu sman sum sbyor sogs dang /rtsa sman gsum la ze tshwa rgya tshwa chu 'gag de'u dngos sam tshab kyis kyang 113

rung / de rnams gang rigs kyis kha bsgyur pa zab/ grang ba'i chu kha snyi ba la sug smel bdun pa dang / sga ser/ skyer ba/ skyu ru ra'i thang dang /brag mtshe'i khaṣ+ṭa/ gla rtsi skyu ru'i ril bu dril ba gang / sgang pa'i kha gsang mdun rgyab la me gdab na phan pa myong grub bo/ /pho mtshan gyi nad la 'brum pa can sogs gang yin kyang rung se 'bru nyi dkyil/ bre ga lnga pa/ sug smel bcu pa sogs 'phrod/ dmar po gsum dang zhu mkhan ldong ros skyer shun rnams rlung la mar dang /mkhris par dri chu/ bad kan la sbrang rtsis byug par bya/ yang na skyer ba/gla rtsi/ skyu ru ras ut+pal brgyad cu'i kha bsgyur te ka ra bongs bskyed nas bya grags dus su thur mgo gang re 'thung / byug sman reg pa bde spyar+sha snag/ ron brun dang cha mnyam byas te mar dang sbyar ba srod dus mo mtshan gyi nad la mngal kha 'chus pa sogs la 'ol se 'phang 'bras/ sran ma'i me tog chang gi sbang ma/ nas zan brun rnams mo nad stong 'joms sbyar te rlung la mar/ mkhris par dri chu/ bad kan brag mtshe'i khañtsa dang sbyar te byug blug bya/ mngal khrag ma chod na bya pho tsi 'am srad ma them gtsangs su bya ba dang / gur kum/ dom mkhris/ skyer khaṇa rnams mo nad stong 'joms dang sbyar te blud/ 'og tu dong brus te me nang du mkhan skya'i du ba bdug des kyang ma chod na rkang pa'i nang 114

snad+ngha dro/na tshun me gdab/ khrag gi 'ol kha bsgyur te dpral rtsa'am rna ljon skad 'gags nad la spang rgyan bco lnga dang nyer lnga/ li shi drug pa sogs dang / spang rgyan/ ru rta/ li shi a ru gang rung ut+pal brgyad cu dang sbyar te g.yer khus phul/ yang na spang rgyan ru rta ka ra sbrang rtsi dang sbyar nas g.yer khus phul/ dbyangs can ril bu rgyun bsten bzang /yi ga 'chus pa la se 'bru lnga pa bu ram bongs bskyed de 'thung / rgya tshwa bzhi thang / sga gcig thang / bu ram dang rgun 'brum zho dang sbyar ba yang yang btung / bu ram sos thog chang dang sbyar te btung /skom nad la skyu ru nyer lnga/ star bu pañtsa sogs dang char chu sbrang sbyar/ bu ram/ star bu/ rgun 'brum rnams rtsa sman gsum gang rigs dang bongs mnyam byas te 'thung /skyigs bu'i nad la shu dag bzhi pa lnga pa sogs dang / bred dngangs bya ba/ chu bskol hub dgu bar chad du 'thung ba/ dbugs bsdam pa/ pi ling / tsi tra ka na le sham gang rung snar dzub/ sha zos nas skyugs su byung na sha bsnam/ zas zos zas la bsnam pa sogs bya'o/ /dbugs mi bde ba la se 'bru lnga pa/ ko byi bdun pa sogs dang /se 'bru ru rta ma nu sga skya gang rung ga bur brgya rtsa'am ut+pal dang sbyar te btung /115

glang thabs la tsha glang / grang glang / srin glang gang yin kyang 'chi med srin sel/ ru rta drug pa/ zla shel ril nag sogs 'phrod/ ko byi/thang phrom dkar po/ dwa 'bras/ gla rtsi re res kyang phan/ yang na ga bur brgya rtsa la gong sman rnams kyis kha bsgyur pa chu bskol gyis dbul/ tsha glang long rtsa gtar/ grang glang gzer mig steng me gdab/ srin glang la thang phrom gyis bcing lums bya/srin nad la mgo srin so srin sogs gang yin kyang byi tang bdun pa/ byi tang bcu gsum/ gdong srin la sna nas gtong / so srin du ba rngub/ lpags srin dwa ba'i khalco dang sbyar te phyi nas byug gzhang srin la zo mar sbyar te ring bu gzhang nang du gzhug nas phying ba lo lon la mu zi tshwa gnyis mar rnying dang sbyar te drod dugs yang yang bya/ pho srin long srin sogs la khong du btang / tsi tra ka'i sman mar/ dkar po chig thub/ shing kun brgya rtsa sogs kyang zab/ sha rus gang la'ang srin zhugs na dugs 'byar bya ba dang zab mo sngags kyis bcos pa zab/skyugs nad la se 'bru bde byed kun phan/ bde byed snyoms ldan/phag grub sogs dang / sog ka ba/ bca' sga/ gla rtsi/ ga bur brgya rtsa dang sbyar te bur khus btang /'khru nad la ta trog bdun pa/ se 'bru brgyad pa sogs dang /'bras yos gro rtsam mar dkar dang sbyar ba/ chur tshos/ bya rkang ba/ gla 116

rtsi dang sbyar te btung bar bya/ zho phrum zhes pa chu bre gang du zho khyor ba gang blug nas gdus pa zho'i bongs tsam lhag tshe 'thung / lug sha'i tsho khu la rta mon lo ma btsos na phan/dri ma 'gags pa la kha ru tshwa drug pa sogs dang / zhi drug bongs mnyam ug chos sbyar/ yang na myum rtsa bul tog ug chos a ru dang sbyar ba btung / zho nang du lan tshwa btab ste dkrugs nas ut+pal brgyad cu btang / g.yer ma/ tsi tra ka lan tshwa rnams rgyun du kha zas dang sbyar te za/ tshwa dang zas snum can gal che/gcin 'gags dang gcin snyi'i sman gong du bshad zin/dreg nad la mdzo sngo dmar gyi lci ba dron mos 'byar bya/ seng ldeng nyer lnga/ spos khyung bco lnga sogs dang dreg rtsa yang yang gtar/ byug sman reg pa bde byed kyis bsku byug yang yang bya/grum bu'i nad la bong khrag bzhi pa/ bong khrag nyer lnga/ klu bdud bco brgyad/ nor bu bdun thang / dkar po chig thub/ seng ldeng brgya rtsa/ seng ldeng gi khu bas phul na zab/chu ser dkar nag dang pags nad gang yin kyang byug sman rlung la mar rnying / mkhris par phag tshil/ bad kan la sbrang rtsis byug na phan/phran bu'i nad rnams man rgyud ltar dang / mes tshig la pha wang dog ti/ sin rnyu ra/ ga bur brgya rtsa chu bal gyis yang yang byug na rma 117

shul mi 'dug pa sogs phan pa myong bas grub/rtsa dkar la a gar so lnga/ a gar nyer lnga/ sa 'dzin nyer lnga/bsam 'phel nor bu/ grib bdug rnams kyang bzang /lhan skyes rma'i 'bras nad la spru rtsa re lcag mi rus nya sha rnams kyis 'byar yang yang bya/ lan tshwas drod dugs bya/ gtar dang me btsa' byas na phan/gzhang 'brum lo gcig 'das rjes gso mi rung / se 'bru gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ tsi tra ka'i sman mar sogs kyis phan no/ /me dbal nad la dkar po chig thub/ byug sman phag tshil gyis byug ras bal gyis me bsreg bya ba gnad/sur+ya'i nad la bse ru nyer lnga sogs dang / ra ma'i ril lums/ut+pal brgyad cu/ dkar po chig thub sogs kyang 'phrod/rmen bu la brag zhun dri chur sbyar ba dang / khur mong ser pos bcing lums/ ut+pal brgyad cu/ ga bur brgya rtsa sogs kyang 'phrod/rlig rlugs la khyung lnga/ rtsa ba lnga'i sman mar/ se 'bru nyi dkyil/dkar po chig thub/ ut+pal brgyad cu 'phrod/rkang 'bam la gser thang bco brgyad/ nor bu chu dwangs/ gi khyung bdun pa/ la phug khang phug chu rug pa zas dang sbres nas 'thung /rtoṭ+wāṃ1 tram̐ nang khrol cha tshang ba/ gur kum/ pri yang ku/ rgyam tshwa rnams kyis

spod mdog 'gyur tsam btab ste 'thung / rta 'o lug zho rtol gyi sha re res kyang phan/ grum bur bsdongs na klu bdud bco brgyad/ dreg dang bsdongs na seng ldeng nyer lnga sogs kyang phan/mtshan bar rdol ba la se 'bru nyi dkyil/ dzā khyung / 'bras bu gsum dang byi la'i rus pa rma la byug 'dzag sgo mes bsdam pa sogs bya/ lar don snod sogs kyi nad de rnams la man ngag rgyud kyi sman sbyor dang kho bo'i yan lag brgyad pa dang / nad 'joms rdo rje pha lam sogs las ji skad bshad pa bzhin nyams myong dang bstun te sman sbyin na gzhan dbang sngon las ma gtogs nad rigs phal mo che sos 'gro ba mngon sum mo/ /de yan chad kun khyab thun mong gi nad ces kyang bya'o/ /byis nad nyer bzhi po rang rang gi sgos bcos man ngag rgyud dang lhan thabs e yig bka' rgya ma sogs las gsungs pa rnams dang de rnams ma grub na gcig shes kun grol/ tshad pa la blon po sum sbyor/'khru ba la kri ka han/ ser la rgyam tshwa bsnan pa'i se 'bru drug pa/ brang la rang rang gi sgos bcos dang ut+pal brgyad cu la gur kum/ pri yang ku/ snyi waṃ/ cu gang rnams kyis kha bsgyur pa dang / bdud rtsi sum sbyor/zhi drug sogs sman nyung sbyor gyis phan thogs che bar snang / byis gdon la gdon bcos rang rang gi skor dang rdzas chen bco brgyad/ nag po dgu sbyor sogs rdzas bsrung zab mo'i bdug rdzas dang gdon chen bco 119

lnga'i mdos/ mo pra gtsug lag sogs kyis sku rim skabs gang bde byas pas phan par snang /mo nad la 'ol se nyer lnga/ ru rta drug pa/ ru rta nyer gcig ze tshwa bdun pa/ star bu bdun pa/ zhi drug sogs dang sgos bcos yan lag brgyad pa dang man rgyud ltar bya/ gzhan yang spyi bzhur sha ba'i khrag dang rwa co'i khrag rnyed na rab/ ma rnyed na ga dor gsum dang hong len/ 'ol se/ 'phang 'bras/ nas tshig thal ba/ go snyod/ gla mjug dwa tshwa sogs mdor na mo nad la phan pa'i sman gcig rgyug rnams bongs bskyed de ga bur brgya rtsa dang sbyar ba mo nad stong 'joms su grags pa 'dis mo nad kun la phan pa myong grub bo/ /gdon nad la smyo byed brjed byed phyogs skyong bcu'i gdon/gza' gdon rnams la rim gro byed pa las sman len mkhan re zung las ma byung / sman dgos na yan lag brgyad pa dang man rgyud las gsungs pa ltar dang yan lag brgyad pa'i gdon bcos rnams kyang phan thogs che bar snang / klu gdon la man ngag rgyud las zab pa med/ 'on kyang seng ldeng nyer lnga/ klu bdud bco brgyad/ dkar po chig thub/ ut+pal tsha sbyor/ byug sman reg pa bde byed/ bya tshan gsum gyis kha bsgyur pa zab pa myong grub bo/ /rma nad la lhan skyes rma brgyad dang mda' rdo mtshon rma bcos thabs 120

man ngag rgyud nas gsungs pa las lhag pa ma mthong / 'on kyang rma spyi khyab la dom mkhris/ gla rtsi/ bcad 'byor ji snyed/ ni la tho ṭha bongs bskyed de rma la byug ga bur brgya rtsa dom mkhris/ gur kum/ gla rtsi gang rung gi chig thang gis phul ba phan thogs che bar snang / yang na ga bur brgya rtsa rma gsar la zho/ rma rnying mar gsar/ gnyan dang bsdongs na stag sha'i khaṣ+ṭa/ srin dang bsdongs na phug ron brun/ rma gzha' byung na bya rog gi brun/ rma lhog byung na phag tshil dang sbyar ba sogs rig pas 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /dug nad la sbyar dug khong song yod med dang brtag thabs nad pa'i zo nyams sogs man ngag rgyud las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin brtags nas dug yin thag chod dus thang chen nyer lnga/ bse ru bzhi sbyor lan grangs mang du 'thung / nad pa'i shes pa 'khrul ba dang sman yi gar mi 'ong zhing 'chi ltas sna tshogs shar na 'chi sos kyi thag chod phyir dbang rim gcig rgyug tu btang zhing lu na lug mur bdun pa dang / star bu lnga pa 'thung /rgyun du thang chen nyer lnga dang nyung ma zas su bsten/ 'om bu brgya rtsa dang gser shing brgya rtsas kyang phan thogs par snang / thang phrom la sbyar ba'i dug rigs kha rma rgyu skam la de rnams myong grub yin/ srin bu rna zan sogs dug rigs gzhan la myong ba med/ gyur dug la zla shel ril bu/ zhi drugadom nag drug pa sogs dang yan lag brgyad pa'i sman sbyor rnams 'phrod/121

sha drug 'om bu'i thang gis phul ba dang / ga bur brgya rtsa byi'u la phug dang bya rog nyung ma gang rung thang gis phul bas phan thogs myong grub bo/ /sha dug gi bcos rnams lhan thabs(sde srid)nas bshad pa rnams zab par snang / khyi dug la dug yod med brtag thabs lhan thabs nang ltar bya/ dug yod thag chod na lha bas 'jib pa yul༄7 yin/ des kyang ma phan na sngags dang za yig gdon bcos bka' rgya ma ltar byas na legs snyam/ sbrul dug la gla ba'i nor bu rnyed na rab/ ma rnyed na gla rtsi btab 'thung bya ba dang / 'om bu brgya rtsa dang dom nag drug pa sogs kyis phan pa myong grub bo//sdom sdig sbrang ma sogs srin bu'i rigs kun la gla rtsi ram bu'i khu bas sbyar te byug na phan pa myong grub bo/ /bse dug la lo rgyus sna tshogs 'dug kyang deng dus ma ma'i dug bse mog ces pa 'di la bcos thabs e yig na yod pa rnams bzang / nad ro phyir mi ldang ba g.yu thog yon tan mgon po la mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo ches gnang ba'i sman ra khrag lnga pa dang byug sman de yang zab par snang / yang na gnyis sbyor sogs nad pa'i zo dang bstun nas byug na phan par snang / gser shing brgya rtsa/ g.yu shing brgya rtsa/dom nag drug pa/ ra khrag bco lnga/ gur kum bcu gsum sogs nad la gang phan gyi sman sbyor ba dang / deng dus rgya'i shel khab kyi 'debs sman 'di yang kun la grags che bas phan thogs par snang ngo / /rgas pa gso ba tshe'i bcud len man ngag rgyud dang yan lag brgyad pa 122

las gsungs pa rnams lag len la thebs na rab/ yang na cong zhi'i bcud len/ nas chang bcud len/ 'ba' sam sman mar/ 'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar/ dbyangs can ril bu/ kha zas dkar gsum mngar gsum/ gos bsil drod snyoms pa/ thig le mi nyams pa/ spyod lam dal bar gnas shing skabs dang skabs su rtsol bcag bsten pa dang skyid sdug ci byung yang sems la bze re mi bya bar sngon las su shes par bya ba dang / 'phral rkyen ci byung yang bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab ste sems can la byams snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms te blo bde zhing gud yangs par bya/ lus ma dag pa'i zhing du gnas kyang sems dag pa'i zhing gi rgyal sras ltar yid bde 'ba' zhig la bsten par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ dpag med bskal pa'i gong nas thugs bskyed mthus//lnga bdo'i 'gro ba'i nad rims rgya mtsho cher/ /skem byed rta gdong me chen sbar byas nas/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin par shog /ces pa 'di ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi rdzong chen du 'tsho byed dam pa rig dpal gyis bskul ngor rnam rgyal zla tshes27la 'jigs med thub bstan rnam rgyal gyis smras pa ltar bskul ba po nyid kyis bris pa sarba maṅga lam/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan gyur cig /123

skabs gnyis pa/ sngo sman 'thu sgrub kyi lag len/kaza ka ri/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/rigs dkar smug gnyis las 'dir dkar po ste/ srib kyi nags tshal dang / shing phran/ rtsa gseb/ lam zur bcas su skyes shing / sdong po ni rtsa ba las gyen du gshib nas skye ba/ rtse stod la ma gtogs phal cher yal ga med pa/ khong stong rkang sob skya bos khengs pa/ shun pa dmar smug 'jam la gzhon dus phyi la thal rtsi skya dkar 'gos yod pa/sdong po yongs la tsher ma yod pa dang / se rgod kyi sdong po 'dra ba/ lo ma lnga bdun dgu sogs sgro dbyibs ltar skye ba/ lo leb rtsub la spu chung yod pa/ rgyab ljang skya can de'o/ /'drasnyedape'am dbyibs rnam/kaṇ+ḍa ka ri zhes bya ba/ /srib kyi nags ri dag la skye/ /sdong po se ba gzhon nu 'dra/ /me tog dkar ser mdangs dang ldan/ /'bras bu dmar po spungs nas skye/ /lo sdong tsher ma ba spu can/ /khong stong ro ni mngar la bska/ /zhes so/ /btu dusasnyedang bkol yul/sman du sbyar bya ni ngar ba ste zla gsum pa nas bzhi pa'am/ yang na 124

zla ba bcu pa nas bcu gcig par btus nas phyi'i shun pa dang nang gi rkang dor ba'i bar shing de skam tshags legs par bya/gartso brtsas dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re thang du bskol ba tsha mor btang bas grang shum byed pa/glo cham/ rlung dang tshad pa ldan pa/ glo ba'i nad rigs sogs la phan/kyi lce dkar po/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di bar stod kyi spang dang shing gseb/ zhing mu sogs gang du'ang skye shing 'bel yod pa/ mang che ba sa ngos su bgrad nas skye ba/ rtsa ba sra mkhregs gnyer ma dang dreg pa nag po can/ stod char shun pa spu sogs kyis g.yogs pa/ lo ma ljang smug 'jam la rgyab ljang rting ba dkar ba/dbyibs ral gri'am khyi lce 'dra ba/ rgas dus dmar smug tu 'gyur ba la yal phran dang lo phran kha sprod du skye ba/ me tog dkar po rgya gling la 'dab ma lnga can ge sar dang bcas pa zhig go /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/kyi lce dkar po spang la skye/ /lo ma sngo la mthug 'jam ring / /sdong po dmar la me tog dkar/ /'bras bu nag po lcags phye 'dra/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste bod zla bdun pa nas brgyad par 125

btus nas rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang babokha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas pho tshad dang mchin tshad/ gre tshad/ mkhris tshad sogs la phan pa dang / khrag gcod pa/ phye ma btul mas dkris na skrangs zhi ba/ rma btul ba/ dug gi tshad pa zhi ba/ snod du lhung ba'i mkhris pa la phan/klu bdud rdo rje/skye rtsal dang ngos 'dzin/'di la stod srib kyi spang dang / shing phran gyi gseb tu skyes shing /rtsa ba dkar sob sbom zhing rgyas la yan lag nyung ba/ ngar ba spu chung can phra ldem bcad na 'o ma thon pa/ lo ma snying dbyibs ljang skya spu chung can mang po kha sprod dang / res mos skye ba/ lo rkang shin tu snyi la mnyen pa/ me tog sngo skya 'dab zur lnga ba dbyibs cong dril lta bu thur du gug pa/ nang du rtsa ris dmar smug dang ge sar dkar po mngon pa zhig go /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/skyes bu klu bdud rdo rje 'di/ /nyin na mi skye srib na skye/ /srib kyi shing phran gseb las skyes/ /lo ma dngul gyi mde'u zhib 'dra/ /sdong po smug ring lcags skud 'dra/ /me tog thal dkar glang chen mdog /dril bu 'dra ba thur du bub/ /ze'u 'bru rdo'i ra rtse 'dra/ /nang mdog klad 126

pa'i rtsa ris can/ /snom na glang chen dri ma bro/ /bcad na 'o ma khu ba 'bab ces so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog 'bras bu yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa py-is/ brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas dreg grum chu ser gyis rus tshigs spangs nas gzer ba dang / chu rgyus rengs pa/ mdze nad dang grib skyon sogs la phan/skyer ba'i bar shun/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di klung skyes te nags gseb dang bye khreb/ chu 'gram sogs gang sar skyes pa dang / rigs dkar nag gnyis las 'dir dkar po ste/srib dang rlan tshad che sar skye ba/ shing sdong sra mkhregs ser po la shun pa dkar skya sbrul dkar gyi pags pa lta bu/ nang du bar shun ser po ro shin tu kha ba/ lo ma'i mchan khung nas rno ngar ldan pa'i tsher ma kha dbrag gsum re byi'u spar gyi dbyibs can/ me tog dkar ser sdum dbyibs can chung ngu mang po tshom tshom du bzhad pa de'o/ /127

'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/skyer pa'i shing ni tsher ma can/ /skyer pa dkar po zhes kyang bya/ /nyin srib gnyis ka'i mtshams su skye/ /pags pa dngul mdog snying po ser/ /me tog ser la 'bras bu dmar/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni bar shun te bod zla lnga pa nas drug par bshus te bsil skam byed pa dang yang na khaṇ+ḍa bskol bar bya/gartso brtsas dang bgokha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas chu ser gyi nad dang gnyan skrangs/ khrag bshal ba/ mig la dmar tshag rgyag pa/ sha mdzer dang ling tog skyes pa/khrag dang grang ba 'dzag nas gcin lam la tsha shar rgyag pa sogs la phan/khu byug pa/skyi yul dang ngos 'jin/'di bar stod srib kyi spang dang / nags 'dabs/ sdum gseb bcas su skye la/ rtsa ba ser skya rkang gcig thung la rgyus phran mang po bkram pa/ lo ma ljang 'jam rno ba/ rtsa ris gzhung du yod pa dbang lag gi lo ma 'dra ba/ me tog mchu dbyibs gos dang 'dab ma ser po rtsa ris smug po phra zhib gshib nas yod pa dang / ma mchu dmar smug khong 128

stong bum pa 'dra ba che chung ri bong gi snying tsam de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/sdum bu byang chub ces bya ba/ /lo ma gres ma gzhon nu 'dra/ /me tog mchong gi bum pa 'dra/ /rtsa ba gser gyi skor tshe 'dra/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba drug pa ṭā/sa bdun par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rtsa kha 'byed/ chu 'gags 'byin/ mkhal sgang sogs kyi lde'u nad sel/khur mong /skye yul dang ngos 'jin/khur mong la rigs mang yang wa khur nag po ni bar stod kyi yul kun tu yod cing / gtso bo spang dang zhing rgod/ rdo gseb/ chu 'gram bcas gang sar skye ba dang / rtsa ba rkang gcig stod cha shun dreg nag pos g.yogs pa/ lo ma sgro dbyibs mjug ldog gi nyag mang ba/ ngar ba phra ldem yal ga dang lo ma gang yang med pa/ rtsa lo ngar gsum gang bcad kyang 'o ma 'dzag pa/ me tog ser po 'dab ma stong mdangs shin 129

tu gsal ba/ nyin mo dwangs dus bzhad cing / mtshan mo 'thibs dus zum pa/ 'bras bu skam po 'jong nar kha dog kham skya 'bru dkar po can 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/wa khur kha stod spang la skye/ /lo ma phra snum nyag ga can/ /me tog gcig pu skye ba yin/ /ro kha yud tsam 'bol la mngar/ /rtsa ba dkar mnyen 'o ma 'bab/ /ming ni skyabs las dkar po zer/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/ gartso bcos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas bad kan smug po'i nad dang / khrag mkhris rgyas pa sel/ tshad pa rnying pa dang / rims tshad/ dug tshad/ glo bur dug thabs/ de min dug rigs sogs la phan/mkhan dkar/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di bar stod rdza dang gad khreb/ sa nag sogs gar yang skye ba lo ma sngo sib spra ba dkar pos khyab pa/ me tog ser po mdangs gsal ba/130

dbyibs mkhan 'brum can phal gyis mkhan chung gser mgo zhes 'bod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/mkhan pa a grong g.ya' smad skye/ /lo ma dkar 'jam thung la spun/ /ring thung mtho re mdzub re tsam/ /me tog ser po dri ma mngar/ /mkhan chung gser mgo zhes kyang bya/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btu la sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bkol yul/'di thob brdung byas pa'i rags phye'i gdus khu la lums brgyab pas rlung nad sel zhing grang skran 'dul/ khyad par du rma dang mkhal ma'i nad la phan/gang ga chung /skye skyal dang ngos 'dzin/'di kha mtho'i rdza 'jam g.ya' zhib can du skye zhing thon tshad nyung /rtsa ba thung la rgyus phran 'dzings pa 'dra ba/ ngar ba dmar smug dang lo ma ljang dkar mthug la 'jam pa/ phyogs bzhi nas gnyis gnyis kha sprod du tshags dam por skye ba/ nang chung zhing phyi rim bzhin che bas 131

dbyibs gru bzhir brtsegs pa 'dra ba ni sngo de'i dmigs gsal gyi khyad chos yin pa dang / me tog thal dkar mdog phyi'i rtsa ris rgya smug can dbyibs dril bu kha gyen du bstan pa 'dra ba/ nyi ma shar dus kha 'byed pa/ grib nag phog dus kha zum pa ro kha ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/gang ga chung zhes bya ba ni/ /lo ma this tshe brtsegs pa yi/ /zur bzhi logs brgyad mchod rten brtsegs/ /dril bu gyen du kha bzed 'dra/ /rtsa ba rgyus pa 'dzings pa 'dra/ /zhes so/ /babyu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog yin kyang phyag len du lo sdong me 'bras lhan cig mdzad srol yod pas zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/ rtsa ba bkol na skye rgyun chad nyen yod pas gzab par rigs/gatsho bachos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas dug tsha ba'i nad kun 'joms/ tshad 'khru gcod skrangs pa zhi/ rma tshad sel/ pho ba smug po khrag lam ma chad par phan/ gur tigaskye yul dang ngos 'jin/132

'di yul 'ga' zhig tu nyin gyi shug gseb dang / gram khreb sogs su skyes shing / rtsa ba thung la kha spu chu 'dzin pa/ lo rkang shin tu phra ba/mang che ba rtsa ba nas gyes pa dang / ngar ba phra la lo ma res mos skye ba/rting pa dmar smug lo mas dril ba'i stod char me tog ser skya dbyibs dril chung 'dra ba 'dab ma lnga can kha zum pa snye ma'i dbyibs ltar phyogs gcig tu gug nas bzhad pa/ 'bras bu slug nag cig 'dogs pa ste/ yul skad du shug tig dang tig ta zer ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/gsang sman bdud rtsi gur tig ni/ /nyin gyi shing gseb bsil grib skye/ /lo ma sgor mo mthug pa la/ /bdud rtsi dngul gyi zil ba can/ /sdong po spun thung phag sug 'dra/ /me tog ser skya zum pa'i tshul/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab dang nyi skam legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang babos yul/thun re phye ma'am thang du bsten pas mkhris pa'i tsha ba dang / rtsa tshad/ rma tshad/ khrag tshad sogs tsha ba'i rigs kun sel zhing rma 'drubs/ tshad 'khru gcod/133

go snyod/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/zhing 'brog gnyis ka'i spang dang sa nag zhing rgod/ lam 'gram sogs gang sar skye zhing lo mang skye ba'i sdum rigs yin/ rtsa ba dkar po rkang gcig sbom la sob pa gnyer ris can sa gting du thad kar zug pa dang / ngar pa phra ldem mnyen la yal phran can/ lo ma ljang 'jam spu med sgro dbyibs nyag chen sngo sib pa tra 'dra ba/ rtsa bas ngar ba btum nas res mos skye ba/ 'bras bu 'jong dbyibs kham smug can bcir na snum yod pa/ dri ngad la ro tsha zhing lce cung zad sbrid nyams byed pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/go snyod la lung na las skye/ /lo ma 'jong stabs nyag ga can/ /sdong po phra ring rtse mang gyes/ /me tog dkar po gdugs ltar zlum/ /'bras bu la la phud 'dra sdum/ /zhes so/ /bcu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla ba brgyad pa nas dgu par btus nas skam gsed legs tshags bya/gtsa bcos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rlung nad spyi dang / snying rlung / snying tshad/134

dug nad/ mig nad/ pho ba'i drod bskyed pa sogs la phan/ phye ma phying pa snum ldan la sbyar te snying srog dang / ro stod gzer dmigs yod sar snum dugs byas pas rlung gzer dang gnyid yer ba/ gzer nges med 'pho ba sogs la phan/gro ma/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di 'brog pa'i mtsher nag dang / zhing rgod/ sa nag sogs yul kun tu skye zhing / rtsa ba nas gyes pa'i lo ma sar 'byar la lo chung mda' sgro'i dbyibs can res mos skye ba/ mdun ljang gu rgas nas dmar por gyur pa rgyab tu spu chung dkar po can/ yal phran dmar po phra la ring bas sa ngos nas phan tshun spa thag sbrel ba/ me tog ser po 'dab ma lnga can chung ngur bzhad pa/ rtsa ba kham nag phra la kha spu dang rgyus phran mang ba/ yal ga mang po'i sne mor rtsa ba rdog po phyi dmar la nang dkar ba gro ma zhes kun gyis bza' bas ngos zin sla'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/gro ma zhes pa kha lung skye/ /lo ma sngo skya 'og dkar la/ /lo sdong sa steng khyab par gdal/ /ngar ba dmar po'i dra ba brkyangs/ /me tog ser po mdangs dang ldan/ /rtsa ba rdog po ril ma 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/135

sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas nyi skam bya/gartso bcos dang phan nus/nyung zad zas su bsten pas lus stobs 'phel/ tsha 'khru gcod/grog ging /gle 8la dang dzos 'jin/'di mang che ba brag dang gad khreb/ gyang dang rtsig rwa rnying pa sogs kyi ngos su char chu yun ring phog sar skyes pa'i ngo bo sngo ldum gyi rigs su gtogs pa ste/ rnam pa rtsa'i rgyu phung bor skye ba/ rgya khyon ci rigs la spang gi rnam pa gzhon nu'i dus su kham ser dang nag por 'gyur ba kun gyis shes sla/bsku dus dang las snon/dus ma nges par mkho dus blangs la chu gtsang gis bkrus te nyi skam bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha 8la/sla nga la brngos pa'i tsha dugs kyis rma dang zug gzer rgyag pa/skrangs rigs/ gcin gtong dka' ba bcas la phan/136

gla sgang rgod pa/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di yul gar yang yod pa dang / khyad par du 'brog khul du mang zhing spang kho nar 'khrungs pa/ rtsa ba kham nag mkhregs la bcad kha zing dmar can gnyer tshigs dang rgyus phran yod pa/ ram bu'i rtsa ba las chung ba/ rtsa ba nas gyes pa'i lo ma ljang 'jam 'jong nar phra la rtse mo rno ba/ rgyab ngos ljang skya sru 'jam dkar po can/ lo rkang phra ring leb mo can la ngar ba ljang gu phra mnyen sgyug tshigs can/ tshigs mtshams re /ṭ+wāṃ/ lo/ phran chung ngu re skyes pa/ 'bras bu sgang gsum 'od dang ldan pa 'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/gla sgang mon chung skam po 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las sdon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba bcu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkru ba dang / kha spu med par byas la skam gsed legs tshags bya/gatsho brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re thang du bskol ba'am phye ma bsten pas skad 'gags pa dang / glo ba'i nad sel/ rgyu long gi 'khru ba 'joms pa cham rims 137

dang tsha ba sogs la phan/gla sgang g.yung ba/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di sa 'bol dang zhing rgod/ mtsher rnying sogs gang sar skye ba/rtsa ba ril zhib gro ma 'dra ba spu can mang po stel ba'i 'dzing thag bcas sa 'og nas phan tshun khyab pa/ lo ma spar dbyibs nyag chen kha dbrag lnga ba la lo rkang phra ba re mos skye ba/ ngar ba shin tu phra zhing mnyen pa/yal ga gsum lag can gyi rtser me tog rgya dkar 'dab ma srab 'jam lnga re yod pa/ me tog spen ma'i me tog tsam 'char zhing gang bu mchu ring mjug spu can 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/gla sgang sa nag gro ma 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba bcu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkru ba dang / spu med par byas la skam gsed legs tshags bya/gatsho bcos dang bkolu yul/phye ma thun re thang du'am phye ma bsten pas glo ba'i nad rigs dang /rgyu long gi nad/ tsha 'khru/ cham rims dang tshad pa sogs la phan/138

rgya drus/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/sa mtho'i srib ri'i rdza 'dabs kyi spang dang / shing gseb sogs la skye shing lo mang skye ba'i sngo rigs yin/ lo ma ljang 'jam mtha' snyoms 'jong nar smad cha phra ba/ mang che ba rtsa ba nas gyes pa/ stod cha'i tshigs mtshams re nas lo ma kha sprod du skye ba/ de'i mchan khung nas me tog dkar po 'dab lnga/ 'dab ma'i nang du rtsa ris sngon po/ phyi sngo skya can/ nyin mo kha phye ba dang mtshan mo dang gnam 'thib dus zum pa gnyis re cha 'grig 'char ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dasbyibs rnam/rgu drus nyin srib gnyis kar skye/ /lo ma phra la 'jam pa ste/ /me tog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs/ /dbyibs ni kyi lce nag po 'dra/ /'bras bu dag gis phyur bur gang / /rtsa ba gser gyi lcug ma 'dra/ /zhes so/ /banu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa lo me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par brkos nas rtsa ba'i dreg pa sogs gtsang mar bkrus la/sngo 'chol rma phab bsil skam legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rgyu gzer dang snod tshad sel/ dug 139

'joms/ rma 'drub/ rtsa chad mthud/ rims nad la phan no/ /rgun 'drum/skye skyal dang ngos 'dzin/'di sa gnas mi nyung ba zhig la 'debs 'dzugs byed kyi yod pa dang / sdong po phra la ring ba yal phran gyi tshul du shing gzhan dang dngos po gzhan la 'khril nas skye ba/ lo ma che chung ma gtogs lham lo'i dbyibs ltar rtse mo lnga re yod la/ lo ma'i mchan khung nas yal phran ljang skya phra mo 'ga' shas dung 'khyil gyi dbyibs su skye ba/ 'bras bu ljang dkar/ smin nas rim bzhin dmar ljang ngam 'ga' zhig smug por 'gyur ba/ chu bur ltar rdol la khad pa mang po tshom bur skye ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/yal ga mtho rer 'bras bu brgya/ /'bras bu re la rus pa gsum/ /rus pa re yi steng 'og tu/ /pho mo gnyis kyi mtshan ma gsal/ /'bras bu rlon pa khrag rkyal 'dra/ /skam na byang nag ro skam 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu par btus nas skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bkol yul/thang du bskol ba'i skyo mas glo ba'i nad sel/ glo ba la sogs pa'i 140

tshad pa sbyong / cham rims dang dbugs mi bde ba/ byis pa'i glo nad dang skad 'dzer ba sogs la phan/sga tigarkye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di 'brog khul gyi khreb dang brag gseb sogs kun tu'ang skyes shing / ngar ba dmar smug spu chung can gyi mtha' skor du lo ma chung chung spu chung can mang pos pad 'dab ltar bskor ba/ rtsa ba phra la thung ba rgyus phran thar thor yod pa/ ngar ba'i rtser me tog zing dmar dril bu kha g.yel 'dra ba/ 'dab ma lnga can/ ge sar mi mngon pa/ 'dab ma la dbrag med pa ma gtogs g.yar mo thang ba'i me tog dang mtshungs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe dang dbyibs rnam/sga tig nag po zhes bya ba/ /rtsa ba rgyus pa bshad pa 'dra/ /lo ma sum cu tig gi dbyibs/ /me tog dmar po bya mig 'dra/ /g.yar mo thang dang gnyis med mtshungs/ /zhes so/ /gartso bcos dang bgokha rtsal/phye ma thun re bsten pas dmu rdzing dang skya rbab kyis chu sri ba sel ba dang / skrangs pa sel ba/ chu ser skem pa/ khyad par du tsha ba 'joms shing chu ser 'dren par phan no/ /141

dngul tigaskye skyal dang ngos 'jin/'di mang che ba sa khreb dang / thang rgod/ zhing mu/ gram thang / lam 'gram sogs su skye ba dang / lo mang skye ba'i sdum rigs yin/ skye tshul rtsa ba rkang gcig thung la spu can/ ngar ba ljang 'jam sul ris can tshigs mtshams re nas lo ma ljang gu rgas nas kham ser du 'gyur ba/dbyibs khyi rtse 'dra ba smad chas ngar ba btum pa gnyis re kha sprod du skye ba dang / me tog sngo dkar 'dab lnga skar ma zur lnga'i dbyibs 'dra ba 'char zhing / yal rjes gang bu bum dbyibs ma'i nang du 'bras bu zhib mos khengs pa 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/so/ /dngul tig me tog dkar po ste/ /lo ma sdong bu rab tu ring / /zhes btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa ṭ+wāṃs/ brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags gco bachos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas mchin pa'i tsha ba dang / mkhris pa'i tsha ba/142

khyad par du skran sel zhing zug gzer gcog pa la phan/sngon bu/rkye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di bar stod spang dang sa khreb/ gad pa sogs gang sar skyes shing / grangs 'bor mang / rtsa ba rkang gcig phra la thung ba/ ngar ba mang po sa ngos su 'byar nas gyes pa la/ lo ma spu chung can phra zhib res mos skye ba/ yal rkang re re'i rtser me tog sngon po dril chung dbyibs 'dab cha lnga re spu sob can/ smad cha gos kyis byibs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/sngon bu spang gi la phug 'dra/ /me tog sngon po 'dab bzhi mdzes/ /rtsa ba khur ma'i rtsa ba 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bsal la skam gsed bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas thur du sbyong bar byed pa dang / chu ser skem/lca ba/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/143

'di zhing 'brog kun gyi nags khul dang zhing khul/ 'brog khul bcas su skyes shing / rtsa ba rkang gcig sbom la rgyas pa yan lag dang bcas nang sha dkar po 'bol sob dri zhim pa/ sdong po khong stong nar son nas dmar smug tu 'gyur ba stod char yal ga yod pa/ lo ma pa tra 'dra ba/ sdong po dang lo rkang rnams mnyen zhing 'bol ba/ gdugs dbyibs kyi gdengs kar me tog dkar zhib mang po 'char zhing /'bras bu mgo stel lam zur gshog smug skya can 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpo'am dbyibs rnam/lcam pa zhing gi mu las skye/ /sdong bu smug la me tog dkar/ /lo 'bras go snyod 'dra ba'o/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba bcu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos te sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus la nyi skam legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas yan lag gi chu ser skem/ mkhal sked kyi nad grang ba sel/ pho ba'i nad la phan/ khrag sogs lus zungs gso/lcags tigaspe yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di spang dang shing gseb/ gram thang sogs gang sar skyes shing /144

rtsa ba thung la spu phran yod pa/ ngar ba ljang gu gru bzhi phra mnyen drang por skye ba/ lo ma ljang gu snying dbyibs nar mo gnyis gnyis kha sprod du skye ba bcas dang / me tog sngo skya cong dbyibs 'dab bzhi la rting ba'i gos mtshams kyi phyogs bzhir mjug ma thung ngu bzhi re yod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/sdong po lcags kyi thur ma la/ /lo ma sngo ljang rting pas dril/ /me tog sngo skya rdo rje ra/ /gang bu zar ma'i gang bu 'dra/ /'bras bu lcags kyi ring bsrel zhib/ /ces so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa py-is/ brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab bsil skam legs tshags gartso bcos dang bamakha 8la/phye ma thun re bsten pas mkhris tshad dang rma tshad/ rims tshad sogs sel/ khyad par khrag mkhris 'khrugs pa'i mgo gzer la mchog tu phan/lcam pa/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'dir lcam pa la rigs gnyis las bod lcam ni zhing 'brog kun tu 145

yod cing / lo gnyis skye ba'i ldum rigs yin/ skye gnas khang ba'i nye 'khor dang / lhas 'dabs/ sa nag lud phung sogs su skye/ rtsa ba phra la spu can/ lo ma sgor mo nyag chung can sbal dbyibs zur lnga ba la shin tu thung ba'i spu rtsub yod pa/ lo ma'i mchan khung dang ngar ba'i rtser gos ljang skya spu 'jam can gyi tshom bu las me tog rgya dkar zhib mo 'dab ma lnga can 'char zhing / yal rjes gos kyis btum pa'i 'bras bu mkhal dbyibs leb mo rta ri la 'khor nas mtheb skor ltar 'byar ba rgas nas kha mang po 'gas pa de'o/ /'dra dadze+e'am dbyibs rnam/adzha ka zhes bya ba ni/ /lo ma lcam pa kun dang 'dra/ /me tog nyi dga' rgya tshos la/ /nyi ma gar gnas de gar blta/ /'bras bu adzha ka zhes bya/ /rtsa ba sdong po bcas pa la/ /lcam pa zhes bya ro mngar bska/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla brgyad pa nas dgu pa'am nam smin gyi dus su btus nas skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bgokha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas mkhal ma'i stobs bskyed pa dang / dri chu 'gags pa 'byin pa/ rma'i rnag chu skem pa/ skom dad sel zhing 'khru ba 146

gcod pa bcas la phan/lham rtsa/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di la stod kyi spang dang / sa nag shing gseb sogs su 'khrungs shing / dpyid kyi dus thog mar kha 'bus skabs gos kyis btums pa dang rim bzhin kha 'byed pa/ sdong po khong stong sgyug tshigs can/ stod cha tshang me tog gis btum pa/ me tog yal rjes 'bras bu dmar po zur gsum dang / lo ma sbal dbyibs che la reg bya tsub pa/ rtsa ba sbom la ser po gnyer tshigs mang ba/ dreg pa nag po can/ bcad la wags 'og nas tshi ba 'dzag pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/lham ni rdza brag dag las skye/ /lo mas sa gzhi mnan pa 'dra/ /sdong po khong stong dmar smug ring / /me tog dmar po spungs par skye /'bras bu zur gsum rab tu mang / /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla bcu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus thog gshag gtub ci rigs byas te nyi skam bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/147
