phye ma thun re bsten pas dug rigs kyi tshad pa dang / rgyu long sogs snod kyi tshad pa sbyong / chu ser skem/ mkhris pa'i tshad pa sel zhing 'khru/ dri ma 'gags pa sbyong bar byed do/ /chu ma rtsi/skye yulasnyedang ngos 'jin/'di la mtho'i spang ri la skyes shing / lo mang skye ba'i sngo rigs yin/rtsa ba rkang gcig bcad la ngang ser rgyus phran dang yan lag thar thor can la/ lo ma ljang nag rgyab ljang skya 'jam zhing mthug la 'jong sgor snying dbyibs ma lo rkang can mang ba sa ngos nas bgrad de gyes pa dang/sdong po khong sgyug tshigs can rgas nas dmar por 'gyur ba/ stod cha'i tshigs mtshams nas lo phran res mos skye ba/ de'i mchan khung nas myum rigs kyi me tog dmar ljang gi snye ma 'char ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/chu ma rtsi zhes bya ba ni/ /lo ma sngon po ral gri 'dra/ /sdong po rtsa ris dmar po yod/ /snye ma zor ba dag dang 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla dgu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas sa dreg sogs gtsang mar bkrus te skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/148

phye ma thun re bsten pas chu ser dang / dmu chu'i nad rnams sbyong /skom dad sel/chu rtsa/skye 8la dang ngos 'jin/'di la mtho'i rdza ri dang / g.ya' shag sa nag sogs su skyes shing thon tshad 'bel/ rtsa ba ser po sbom la shun pa kham nag gnyer ma can dreg pa nag po bcas che chung ma gtogs myum 'dra ba la lo ma sgor leb che zhing gyong la tsub pa/ lo rkang dang rgyab kyi rtsa ris dmar po can/ lo ma yongs rdzogs rgas nas rim bzhin dmar por 'gyur ba sa ngos su gyes pa/ me tog dang 'bras bu myum gyi me 'bras 'dra ba snye dbyibs su chags pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/chu rtsa lo ma skor chen rtsub/ /sa gzhi mnan la rkang pa dmar/ /sdong po lo ma me tog sogs/ /che chung ma gtogs myum bzhin skye/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya rtsa ba ste zla dgu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas shun pa bshu ba dang gtub nas skam tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang babos rtsal/phye ma thun re bsten pas rma 'drub pa dang / rma tshad sel ba/149

gnyan la sogs nad rnams 'jam por sbyong /skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/ chu rug pa/la mtho'i chu 'gram gyi gram khrod dang / srib kyi rdza 'jam/ shing phran gyi gseb sogs su skye/ ngar ba yung nag gi sdong po lta bu ger skyes dang /lo ma ljang smug mtha' sog le kha mda' sgro kha sprod du skye ba/ me tog zing skya dril chung kha g.yel la 'dab ma bzhi can brgyad dgu tsam tshom du skye bas gdugs dbyibs lta bur gyur pa 'bras bu sogs phur na nyung dri bro ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/chu rug chu 'gram mtshams su skye/ /rtsa ba g.yu 'brug 'khyil pa 'dra/ /lo ma sbal ba'i lag pa 'dra/ /zhes so/ /gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas chu rgyus la zhugs pa'i tshad pa dang /'bam grum sel/ chu rgyus bsnad pa sogs la phan/'jib rtsi chen po/ skye 8la dang ngos 'dzin/'di la mtho'i spang dang shing gseb/ g.ya' shag sogs gang du'ang skyes shing / rtsa ba kham smug spu dang yal phran mang ba/ ngar ba 150

smug la gru bzhi logs su shur ris dang spu chung can/ khong stong tshigs pa yod pa/ lo rkang ring ba/ ngar ba'i stod char me tog gi gos byi'u phrug kha gdangs 'dra ba'i nang nas me tog sngon po sbyab stong kha gdangs pa/ rting ba nas 'jib pas ro mngar ba'i rtsi 'byung ba/ gos dang lo ma/ngar ba yongs rdzogs 'byar bag gi rang bzhin no/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/'jib ji chen po zhes bya ba/ /lo ma khyi yi lce 'dra ba/ /sdong po smug la gru bzhi ba/ /me tog pri yang ku 'dra'o/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa py-is/ brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags gartso brtsos dang bar+shakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas kha'i nad dang so'i tshad pa dang / mchin pa'i tshad pa bcas sel ba la phan/nye zhing /skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la smad kyi grog shul dang gad khreb/ shing gseb bcas su skyes shing / ngar ba'i tshig mtshams su rno ngar med pa'i sngo'i tsher ma yod pa 151

dang / lo ma phra zhib pa ha cang mang bas ldum phung yongs rdzogs sngo sib sib byed pa me tog ljang ser phra mo yal sla ba/ 'bras bu ljang gu bra ba'i grod pa 'dra ba/ rtsa ba dkar sob 'byar chus khengs pa/ shun pa skya bo/rtsa sdong 'brel mtshams su rgyus phran ha cang mang po yod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/bdud rtsi nye shing zhes bya ba/ /lo ma lcags phye gtor ba 'dra/ /sdong po phra ring tsher mas khyab/ /'bras bu lcags kyi sran chung 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu gcig par ༵rko/ sa nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus thog phyi'i shun pa dor nas nyi skam gartso brtsos dang bamakha cal/phye ma thun re bsten pas tshe bsring lus stobs gso/ chu ser skem/ṭādī/ dang grang ba gab tshad rnying ba dang / lten gyi nad rigs la sogs gnyan 'dul ba/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di ri mtho'i rdza dang g.ya' shag sogs su skye/ rtsa ba chung la sra mkhregs rgyus phran mang ba/ 'ga' shas phyogs gcig tu yon por skye ba/152

ngar ba'i rtsa bar lo ma ljang nag sgor mo chung la reg bya rtsub pa 'ga' shas dang / stod char lo ma ljang skya sgor dbyibs spu chung can reg bya 'jam po gcig gis gcig bkab pas/ steng nas byi'u'i rgyab lta bu dang / 'og ngos kyi lo ma'i gseng nas mchu dbyibs kyi me tog sngo skya spub can kha gdangs pa 'jib rtsi can 'ga' shas 'char ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/sngo sman rgyal po gnyan 'dul ba/ /dbyibs ni bya rgod sug pa 'dra/ /phyi skya nang sngo spu dang ldan/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo ma ste zla drug pa nas brgyad par sngo yongs rdzogs btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas tshad rims dang / gag lhog gnyan srin/gzer rigs/ skrangs pa/ rma tshad sogs sel/snya lo/skye 8la dang ngos 'dzin/'di la stod srib ri'i spang dang shing gseb/ zhing mu/ sa nag sogs gang du'ang skyes shing / ngar ba dmar po yal ga mang zhing / lo ma ljang 'jam nar mo ram bu'i lo ma 'dra ba rgas nas dmar por 153

'gyur ba/ rtsa ba la phud 'dra ba yal ga dang bcas pa nang dmar skya dang phyi dreg pa nag po can de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/snya lo srib kyi ri las skye/ /lo ma lcang dkar lo ma 'dra/ /sdong po dmar ring tshigs pa can/ /me tog dkar po sprin bzhin 'thibs/ /rtsa ba dmar po sha ru 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus thog gshag gtub gang bder byas la bsil skam bya/ga bachos dang bamakha 8la/phye ma thun re bsten pas rgyu long la sogs kyi tsha ba sel/ tshad 'khru gcod/ rgyu rims dmar bshal sogs la phan/snyi ba/gye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la mtho'i rdza yul dang srib ri'i shing gseb sogs su skyes shing / skye tshul rtsa ba rdog po skum 'jong sreg pa'i sgo nga tsam dang / ngar pa'i myug ma phra la mnyen pa skud pa ltar ha cang ring ba/ bcad na 'o ma 'dzag pa/ shing phung sogs gzhan la 'khril nas skye ba/ stod cha nas 154

yal ga thar thor gyes pa/ lo phran sgong nar rtse mo rno zhing mthar sog le'i kha tsub yod pa me tog sngon po cong dril dbyibs can 'dab ma lnga ldan de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/snyi ba zhes bya srib mor skye/ /lo ma phra la me tog ni/ /ut+pal ni la dang 'dra bar/ /sngo zhing gzhan la 'khril nas skye /rtsa ba mar gyi rkyal ba 'dra/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla dgu pa nas bcu par brkos nas rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gatsho bcos dang bamakha cal/phye ma thun re bsten pas brang dang gre ba tsha ba/ glo dang sbrid pa mang ba/ sna'i dri tshor nyams pa/ cham pa sogs sel zhing dang ga 'byed par byed do/ /til/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di sa gshis snyoms shing drod che ba'i sa cha gar yang 'debs 'dzugs byed pa'i lo gcig skye ba'i sdum rigs sam zhing skye lo tog ste/ngar ba gru bzhi 'drong por skye ba la ba spus khyab pa/ lo ma kher rkyang sgor 155

dbyibs dang / lce dbyibs can/ zur bzhi ba dang / zur drug pa/zur brgyad pa/ zo spug 'dra ba bcas ci rigs kyi nang du 'bras bu mang po kha dog nag po'am lam ser/ dkar po ci rigs yod pa/ kha dog gi dbye bas dkar nag gnyis yod pa de'o/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni zla ba dgu par bsdus pa'i 'bras bu ste/ sgong dbyibs leb mo zhib pa che chung bre ga'i 'bras bu tsam pa de bcir pa'i snum mar 'bras bu gang rung gtong ngo / /gatsho brtsos dang bamakha rtsal/'bras bu'am snum nyung zad bsten pas rlung nad 'joms/ lus stobs dang me drod bskyed/ bshang pa 'gag pa 'byin/ ro tsa khu ba 'phel zhing dran pa gsal/ pags pa 'jam zhing skra dang smin ma skye/ skra dkar mi skye'o/ /rta spags/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la mtho'i spang ljongs dang sa 'bol sogs gar yang skye ba/ lo ma sgor mo che la gnyer 'brum dang rtsa rigs sasal zhing / mtha' dang reg bya rtsub la gyong ba gnyis re kha sprod du phyogs bzhi nas skye bas ngos su bgrad pa'i dbus nas ngar ba smug la gos smug po'i gseng nas me 156

tog sngo dmar spub can kha gdangs pa 'jib rtsi'i me tog 'dra ba mang po spungs pa/ rtsa ba thur du zug pa/ dreg pa nag po can/ gnyer ma shu dag gi dbyibs dang mtshungs pa/ khar myangs na lce sbrid nyams byed pa'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/lo ma sgor mo mthug pa la/ /'brum bu mthug po yod pa 'dra/ /sa la 'byar nas khrad por skye/ /sdong po gru bzhi thig shing 'dra/ /me tog rgya ser dkar gsum yod/ /tsher ma dang bcas khyi gzhug 'dra/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las sdon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa lo me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla drug pa nas brgyad par btus sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas srin gsod/ chu ser 'dren/ lha ba 'dzin cing rus chag sbyor/ rta rmigaskye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di la mtho'i bar gyi yul gar yang yod pa dang / mang che ba brag rdo'i kheb 'og dang / nags 'dabs sogs nyi len chung zhing rlan bsil che sar skye ba dang / rtsa ba rkang gcig thung zhing rgyus phran/ lo ma 157

ljang 'jam dbyibs rta'i rmig pa 'dra ba mtheb chung gi kha rgya tsam pa/me tog ser po 'dab ma lnga ba/ 'og gi 'dab ma cig shos la skag smug gi rtsa ris mngon pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/rta rmig brag gi rtsa bar skye/ /lo ma nyi dga'i lo ma 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba drug pa ṭ+wāṃ/sa bdun par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rma gso/ rus pa chag pa sbyor/ rtsa'i sgo 'gags/ mgo'i nad rigs la phan/stag ma'i me togaskye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la mtho byang bltas kyi srib ri dang nags gseb sogs su skye ba'i shing rigs yin/ shing phung cung mtho la sdong po sra mkhregs phyi lpags skya bos phyi nang rim par g.yogs pa dang / yal phran gsar ba ljang ser thog lo ma ljang nag mthug la 'jam pa spu chung can/ mtha' gnyis rgyab tu 'dril ba/ me tog dkar po dril dbyibs 'dab ma lnga re 158

yod pa nang gi ldebs ngos kyi gzhogs gcig skag thig zhib mo dod pa/dkyil nas ze'u 'bru'i mdzer bu brgyad dgu nas bcu lhag tsam 'phyang ba lnga drug nas bco lnga tsam tshom bu byas nas bzhad pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/stag ma'i shing ni srib mor skye/ /sdong po mkhregs pa pags pa dang //sbya/ ma/ wa zhabs spra chung ser/ /me tog dkar dmar che la mdzes/ /zhes brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste zla lnga par btus nas skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bkolu yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas byang khog la sogs par gnas pa'i rnag skem/ stag shaskye skyal dang ngos 'jin/'di bar stod kyi gad khreb dang gram thang sogs su skyes shing /dkar nag gnyis las 'di nag po ste/ rtsa ba sbom zhing rgyas la shun pa dang dreg pa kham nag yod pa/ rtsa lo 'brel mtshams su lo rnying bsags pa'i gos sob kyis g.yogs pa/ me tog sngo skya phye leb tshom bur bzhad 159

pa srad nag gi me tog 'dra ba la ngar ba dang lo ma'i ring thung phal cher mnyam pa/ sran ma'i gang bu rkyal chung 'dra ba'i nang du 'bras bu gnyis gsum yod pa dri ngad shin tu che ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/gnyan dug ces bya srib mor skye/ /lo ma g.yu bun 'thibs pa 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo ma ste zla drug pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rma 'drub cing sha'u gso/ rtsa kha 'dzin cing khrag shor gcod/ chu ser skem zhing gnyan tshad sel/ dug nad sel zhing dri ma 'gags pa sbyong /skye kul dang ngos 'jin/ star bu/'di yul phal mo cher thar thor yod pa dang / rigs gsum las 'dir gnam star ni rong chen rnams kyi sa char skye ba'i sdong po mtho la yal phran rnams tsher ma rnon pos khyab pa/ lo ma ma skye gong nas me tog ser skya zhig 'char ba dang / lo ma mthug gyong phra la ring ba kha dog ljang 160

dkar can res mos skye ba/ 'bras bu dmar ser ril mo snyi la rdol la khad pa tshom bur 'dogs pa de'o/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla dgu pa nas bcu par 'bras bu yongs su smin pa'i dus su btus nas nyi skam gtong ba'am zhun dang khaṇ+ḍa byas nas mi rul bar nyar tshags legs par bya/gtso bcos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas glo nad sel zhing lud pa 'dren/ gre ba tsha 'gags dang gre bar bad kan zhugs pa sel/ ma zhu ba 'ju zhing mchin pa'i nad la phan/ khrag tshad dang khrag gzer bcas la phan/stong ri zil ba/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di la mtho'i yul phal mo cher yod pa dang / mang che ba srib kyi rdza brag las babs pa'i chu phran gyi rgyud du skyes shing / skye tshul rtsa ba ser po yan lag mang zhing sbrel ba/ lo ma ljang 'jam nyag ga mang zhing sngo sib pa tra spungs pa 'dra ba rtse mthakhaci skag mdangs can mang che ba bgrad de skye ba/ zla ba bdun pa nas/ brgyad par mchu dbyebs kyi me tog ser po'i nang nas be sar sngon po 'phyang 'ing me tog bi gseb nas lo gos dmar smug skag mdog can mngon pas/ 'ga' zhig gis rma bya 161

zil ba zer ba/ dus nam yang khyad par zhogs pa sogs su lo ma'i gseb tu chu'i zil pa khrom mer chags pa de bzhin myangs na ro shin tu kha ba sngo de'i khyad chos dang mi nor ba'i rtags su 'dzin pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/ti se gangs kyi 'dab ma na/ /chu dang rdza brag 'dres pa'i sar/ /lha dang drang srong gis bskyed sman/ /lo ma mthug la phra ba ste/ /sdong bu khong stong phra la ring / /me tog sngo dang ser gnyis po/ /ming yang so sor lha yis btags/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo ma ste/ zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rims dang tshad rims mtha' dag 'joms/ mkhris tshad sel/ mes 'tshig rma gso/ tsha skrangs 'joms/skom tshad sel/tha ram/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di zhing 'brog kun tu yod pa dang / bde thang dang lam brgyud/zhing god sogs skam shas che sar gar yang skyes pa/ rtsa ba rkang gcig 162

thung la spu thar thor yod pa/ lo ma ljang dbyibs sgor nar rtse mo rno ba/lo rkang gi ring tshad lo ma'i phyed cha tsam zin pa mang po can/ ngar ba ljang gu phra ldem gsegs nas skye ba/ me tog ljang dkar zhib mo spungs pa'i snye ma 'char zhing / 'bras bu smin nas kham nag tu 'gyur ba dbyibs ram 'bras 'dra ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/tha ram zhing rgod tha ba dang / /lam khar skye ba'i lo ma ni/ /snum la rug 'dra dri ro can/ /sdong bu gcan gzan mjug ma 'dra/ /'bras bu ram pa'i snye ma bcas/ /sa la bgrad nas skye ba yin/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla brgyad pa nas dgu par btus nas skam gsed legs tshags bya/gatsho brtsos dang bkol skul/pa setram̐/ ma thun re bsten pas tsha grang gi 'khru ba gcod/ rgyu long gi tshad thang sbom dkar po/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la mtho'i 'brog khul gyi sa nag dang spang ri/ bye shag lhas nag sogs su skye ba dang / rtsa ba dkar po sbom la rgyas pa yan lag sa 163

gting du thad kar zug cing / ngar ba thung bas sa ngos las mi 'phags pa/ lo ma ljang dkar gnyer mthug nar ring can mtha' gya gyu mang ba/ sa ngos su pad gdan ltar bgrad pa'i mchan khung nas me tog ser dkar 'char zhing / gang bu ljang dkar thang khug 'dra ba thur rtsib mang zhing drwa ba'i rtsa ris can gyi nang 'bras bu kham nag mkhal dbyibs leb mo mang po yod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/gangs kyi thang phrom bya ba ni/ /g.ya' ri spang mtshams la khar skye/ /rtsa ba sbom la sdong po med/ /lo ma gnyer mthug sa gzhi mnan/ /me tog dkar la ser kha can/ /'bras bu nag zhib mkhal ma'i dbyibs/ /snum pa'i rang bzhin smin pa yin/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba dang 'bras bu ste/ rtsa ba zla ba bcu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas sa dreg med par byas la gshag gtub bya/'bras bu zla ba brgyad pa nas dgu par btus nas skam gsed legs tshags bya/gtso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas gnyan nad gag lhog 'joms/ rgyu long la sogs kyi snod kyi srin bu gsod par byed do/ /164

thang phrom nag po/skye rtsal dang ngos 'dzin/'di klung skyes te grong ba'i nye 'khor dang rtsig zur/ lhas nagalam 'gram/ zhing mu sogs gang sar skyes shing 'phel stobs che ba rtsa ba dkar po sbom la che zhing ring ba yan lag gyes pa sa gting du thad kar zug pa/ bcad khar lo rim gsal ba/ lo ma ljang smug 'jong dbyibs kher rkyang res mos dang kha sprod ci rigs skye ba/ me tog smug nag dmar 'od mthing mdangs/ dril chung dbyibs can dang / 'bras bu 'dogs pa'i skabs su gos rim bzhin che ru phyin nas gang bu g.yogs pa der gzhung rtse bcu 'bur du thon zhing kha zum pa/ 'bras bu mkhal dbyibs 'dra ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/nag po rda du ra zhes pa/ /rtsa ba shin tu che ba la/ /sdong po ngar ba dgu re gyes/ /lo ma nag mthug khra gshog 'dra/ /me tog smug nag dug dri bro/ /lo ma me tog sa 'og nas/ /rdzogs par mthong bas thang rdzogs zer/ /gang bu mthug gyong thang khug nang / /'bras nag leb zhib mkhal 'bras khengs/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla dgu pa nas bcu par btus nas 165

skam gsed legs tshags bya/gco brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas gnyan dang gag lhog chu ser sel/ khyad ṭ+wāṃr sriṭ+wāṃ gyi nad dang ya ma dkar nag pho long rgyu mar zhugs pa'i srin cigs —la/ thal ka rdo rje/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/kha smad ri rgod dang lam zur/ chu 'gram bcas su skye ba dang /ngar ba drang bor skye ba/ smad char yal phran med pa/ stod char yal phran thung ngu gyes pa'i ngos su lo ma rtse sgor sgro dbyibs drug re kha sprod du skye ba/ yal ga'i mchan khung nas me tog ser po 'dab ma lnga re yungs nag gi me tog 'dra ba yal rjes gang bu nar mo phra la ring ba zor dbyibs lta bu'i nang du 'bras bu ljang skya nar mo sne gnyis bcad pa 'dra ba sra zhing 'od dang ldan pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/thal ka rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /shing phung phra zhing thung ba la/ /me tog ser po sul can te/ /lo ma 'bras bu chung ba yin/ /gang bu ring la 'bras bu ni/ /khyi yi pho mtshan 'dra ba yod/ /ces so/ /166

bangu dus dang las sdon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla brgyad pa nas dgu par btus te nyi skam bya/gatsho brtsos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas pags nad dang shu ba gso/ chu ser skom/gza' dang mdze 'bras sogs la phan/da li/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di la mtho'i srib kyi spang ri dang nags gseb sogs su skye ba'i shing phran yin la/ sdong po shun lpags skya dkar dang / gsar skyes kyi yal phran kham ser/ lo ma chung la mthug pa/ mdun ljang nag rgyab spu chung kham ser can res mos byas nas skye ba/ me tog dkar po zing dkar spub can 'dab ma lnga re yod pa lnga drug nas brgyad dgu'i bar tshom bu bzhad pa/ shing phung yod pa'i phyogs nas dri zhim 'thul ba/kun gyis sur dkar zhes ngos zin sla ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/bdud rtsi da li zhes bya ba/ /ba lu dkar po zhes kyang bya/ /srib mo'i ri mthon dag las skye/ /sdong po dkar la lo ma kham/ /me tog dkar la 'bras bu can/ /zhes so/ /167

btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni de'i me tog dang lo ma gnyis te zla ba lnga pa nas drug par btus te skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas bad kan gang nad sel ba dang / dang ga 'gags pa/ me drod nyams pa gso/ grang rlung sel zhing skad 'gags glo nad sogs la phan/dar ya kan/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di byang khog chu ser skem pa'i klung skyes dar ya kan te/ grong tsho nye 'khor dang rtsig zur/ lam 'gram zhing skam sogs gang sar skyes shing lo gcig dang gnyis su skye ba'i sdum rigs shig yin/ dpyid dus snga mo nas lo chung skye/ rtsa ba phra la thung ba thar thor yod pa/ bre ga'i rtsa ba lta pu la ngar ba gyen du skye zhing yal ga yod pa/ lo ma ljang 'jam nar mo phra la nyag chung mang po sogs kha hral 'dra ba res mos skye ba/yal ga'i rtser me tog dkar zhib 'dab bzhi 'char ba dang / gang bu gor leb chung ngu sog ka ba'i gang bu las zhib pa/ rtser nya ga cung zad yod pa bar chod kyis son khang gnyis su bgos shing re re'i nang sa bon re re yod pa yal phran gyi stod char res mos skye ba de'o/ /1tsho

'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/skye gnas yul ljongs kun la yod/ /lo sdong yal ga khrad por skye/ /me tog dkar po 'dab ma ba'i// /'bras bu mu men dmar po 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs yin kyang / sa cha'i khyad chos la gzhigs te zla gsum pa nas lnga par me tog ma shar spyang lo chung sa 'byar te btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs —gakā trī /bcos dngasnyebar+ṣa yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas byang khog gi khrag ngan dang khyad pa ra chu ser skem/ rkang bam dang 'bam grum sogs la phan/dug mo nyung /gye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la smad srib ri'i spang dang / rdo gseb/ lam 'gram bcas su skyes shing / rtsa ba thung la rgyus phran lta bu'i spu mang ba/ ngar ba spu 'jam can mang po drang por skye ba/ lo ma ljang ser snying dbyibs rtse rno ba wa chung kha sprod du skye ba/ me tog ser ljang 'dab ma bzhi lnga tsam gdugs dbyibs su bzhad pa me tog yal rjes gang bu ljang ser sde phra ba nya'i 169

dbyibs lta bu gnyis mnyam du 'dogs pa'i nang du 'bras bu smug leb spu dkar bya bal 'dra bas byibs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/dug mo nyung ni byi'u lce skam po 'dra/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu yin pas zla brgyad pa nas dgu par btus te skam gsed legs tshags bya/gatsho bcas dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas mkhris pa'i nad rigs spyi dang khyad par snod mkhris kyi tshad pa sel/ tshad 'khru gcod/ rgyu ma'i srin bu langs pa la'ang phan/sprum nag dom mkhris/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la mtho'i spang dang shing gseb/ brag khreb/ sa 'bol sogs gang du'ang skye zhing / ngar ba spu chung can lo ma ljang 'jam spu chung dang bcas gtor dbyibs kha sprod du skye ba/ ngar ba'i stod char snye dbyibs kyi me tog gi gos su spu sob mang po'i gseng nas me tog sngon po dril chung 'dra ba ha cang zhib pa mang po bzhad pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/170

sngo sman dom mkhris zhes bya ni/ /srib mo'i sa nag spang las skye/ /lo ma sngon po spu can mthug /rtsa ba chung la sdong bu ring / /me tog sngon po spungs nas skye/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba drug pa nas brgyad par btus te sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rma gso/ rtsa kha sdom/ khrag gcod/ sha'u skye/rma tshad sel/ riskye rtsal dang ngos 'jin/ldum bu ra ral/rong klung dang nags tshal yod pa'i sa cha'i shing gseb dang brag srubs sogs la skye ba dang / rtsa ba ljang gu 'jam kham ser gyis g.yogs pa/ dbyibs nges med sga skya 'dra ba sbom la rags pa sa 'og nas 'phred nyal du yod pa las/ sgro dbyibs kyi lo ma ljang gu g.yas g.yon nas nyag chen mang pos res mos can la stod cha'i lo phran gyi rgyab ngos su 'brum thig ljang ser gnyis re yod pa'i lo rkang mang po rdzob ste skye ba de'o/ /'dra daspre'am dbyibs rnam/171

rgyal po re ral nyin gyi brag las skye /lo ma me rtse mched pa 'dra/ /rtsa ba spre'u'i mjug ma 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste/ zla ba dgu pa nas bcu par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus la skam gsed legs tshags bya/gatsho brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas sha dug dang sbyar dug sel/ 'khru ba gcod/ dug tshad sel zhing dug rigs kun la mchogasne'u/smre yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di zhing 'brog kun tu yod cing sa nag dang / lhas rdzing / zhing nang / ldum gseb sogs gang sar skyes pa ste/ rtsa ba rkang gcig phra la spu can/ sdong po sngo ljang sul can phra ring yal ga dang bcas pa lo ma ljang 'jam snying dbyibs can/ gzhon dus mtha' snyoms shing cher skyes nas mi snyoms pa/ lo ma'i rgyab ljang dkar la 'jam 'dred can gyi phye zhag dkar po chags pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/sne'u sngon po zhing las skye/ /lo ma g.yu yi bsil yab 'dra/ /rgyab tu bdud rtsi zil ba chags/ /zhes so/ /172

btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa ṭ+wāṃs/ brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags gartso bachos dang baspos skyal/phye ma thun re bsten pas rngul phyi la 'dren cing rlung tshad 'byin/rma gso/ rus chag sbyor/pa yag pa/skye khyal dang jos 'dzin/'di la mtho'i bar gyi spang dang sa 'bol/ zhing 'gram/ shing gseb sogs gang du'ang skye zhing / ngar ba phal cher med pa'am thung la/sa ngos las mi 'phags pa lo ma ljang 'jam sa 'byar gyi mchan khung nas me tog rgya smug sbub can kha gdangs pa'i ldebs ngos gcig la ser thig spu chung can yod pa/ 'bras bu snying gi dbyibs 'dra ba/ smin nas rim bzhin smug nag tu 'gyur ba/ rtsa ba phra la ring ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/pa pa re skon zhes bya ba/ /lo ma ldebs bzhis sa gzhi mnan/ /me tog sngon po cung zad dmar/ /'bras dbyibs sems can snying dang 'dra/ /zhes so/ /17 3

btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba dang lo ma 'bras bu bcas yin pas zla lnga pa nas bdun par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus la sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gtso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas glo ba'i nad sel/ glo snag 'dren/ rtsa kha sdom/ rma gso/ sha gnad skrangs pa 'dul/par ba ta/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di 'brog pa'i mtsher nag dang / yul ba'i zhing skam/ sa nag lam zur sogs gang du'ang skye zhing / sa bon 'thor nas lo gcig skye ba'i sngo yin/ skye tshul ni rtsa ba rkang gcig phra la gnyer zhib can yal ga med pa yung nag gi rtsa ba lta bu/ snyi la mnyen pa'i lo rkang dang ngar ba ljang dkar mang po sa ngos su bgrad nas skye ba/ lo ma kha dbrag can res mos phal cher kha sprod kyi tshul du skye ba/ dbyibs g.yu 'brug zil pa'i lo ma 'dra ba/ me tog phra zhib dkar po 'dab ma bzhi can la zum pa 'char zhing yal rjes gang bu nar mo'i nang sa bon nag po can de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/par ba ta zhes bya ba ni/ /sa nag hrul dang mtsher las skye/ /lo ma 174

sngo sib sa la gram/ /me tog dkar po 'gron tshon 'dra/ /gang bu nar mo nyag ga can/ /'bras bu zhib mo mon sran dbyibs/ /zhes so/ /gartso bachos dang bkolu skyal/phye ma thun re bsten pas rims dang dug tshad sel/ khrag tshad gcog cing pags nad la'ang phan/parnar byu la/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di yul phal mo che'i ldum rar btsugs nas skye ba me tog gi 'dab ma mtha' 'khor du kha tshar ma yin par ze'u 'bru'i gseng nas gyen du zob zob byas nas bzhad pa/ yal ga thung bas me tog rnams steng 'og brtsegs pa'i dbyibs su bzhad pa/ rtsa ba sha rgyas la rkang gcig mkhregs shing ro tsha shas che ba/ bongs tshad rgod pa las chung ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/paṣ+kar mū la lug sug 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu par brkos te sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus la gshag gtub ci rigs kyis skam gsed legs tshags bya/175

gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas bad kan tsha ba dang rtsib logs gzer ba 'joms/bri yang ku/rkye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di klung skyes te g.ya' shag dang / bye khreb/ sa 'bol/ zhing mu/lam zur sogs gang sar skyes shing / ngar ba gru bzhi sra la rgas dus smug por 'gyur ba/ lo ma phra la kha dbrag phal cher lnga re yod pa/mdun ljang gu dang rgyab ljang skya kha sprod du skyes pa/ dri zhim mnam pa/rtser snye ma lta bu'i gos spu chung can rgyob mo'i nang mchu'i dbyibs kyi me tog sngon po sbyab can kha gdangs pa 'jib rtsi can gzhogs gcig tu kha phyogs nas bzhad pa/ rtsa ba nag po thung la dreg pa nag po dang spu can/yul kun tu skye ba dang / ngos 'dzin gcig gyur go sla'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/pri yang ku ni nyin srib gar yang skye/ /lo ma me tog sngon po ste/ /me tog dar sngon 'phyar ba 'dra/ /zhes so/ /brtusnyedus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo ma ste zla ba lnga pa nas drug par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/176

gtso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas pho ba dang / glo ba/ mchin pa'i tshad pa sel/ khrag gcod/ rma 'drub/ chu ser skem/ chu 'dren/spang rgyan dkar po/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di ri mtho'i spang ljongs kho nar skyes pa/ rtsa ba ser po thung la rgyus phran can sdong po sa ngos las mi 'phags shing / lo ma ljang 'jam spu sogs med pa logs bzhir 'khor nas phyi nang brtsegs mar skye bas ngos su bgrad pa/ lo ma'i mchan khung nas zla bcu par me tog dkar po dmar mdangs can rgya gling kha 'dab rtse che chung bcu re yod pa/ gre ba nas ge sar mngon zhing phyir chags ris ljang skya sogs thig ris sogs yod pa che la mdangs gsal ba/ gnyis sam gsum re tsam sa ngos su yon por 'char zhing / nang du gang bu sa bon kham nag can yod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/so/ /spang rgyan dkar po spang las skye/ /lo ma chung la me tog rgyas/ /zhes btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste bzhad pa'i dus su btus nas sngo 177

'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas dug nad 'joms shing tshad rigs spyi dang / khyad par du gre ba dang glo ba'i tshad pa sel zhing gag pa 'joms/spang rgyan nag po/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la mtho'i spang ljongs kho nar skyes la/ lo ma ljang 'jam phra la thung ba'i pad gdan chung ngu la mtha' skor du me tog gi ngar ba phra la ring ba lo ma res mos skye ba sa ngos su bgrad pa las/ zla ba brgyad pa nas dgu par me tog mthing nag mdangs gsal ba/ phyir chags ris ljang ser can/ sngon po las cung zad che ba de'o/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste zla ba brgyad pa nas dgu par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bkol yul/sel/phye ma thun re bsten pas 'brum pa'i nad dang pags pa'i tsha ba spang rtsi do bo/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/178

'di la mtho'i spang dang sa khreb zhing mu sogs gang du'ang skyes shing / rtsa ba sbom la sgrim pa 'dra ba dreg pa nag po can las lo ma nar mo dbyibs gru rkyal 'dra ba dang 'ga' zhig la nya ga yod pa/ reg bya cung rtsub pa'i spu chung 'byar bag gi nyams can gyi gseng nas phra mnyen ldan pa'i ngar ba'i rtser mgo rdog re re'i thog me tog dkar po dbyibs ge sar nag po can ha cang mang po tshom bur bzhad pas dbyibs tsong sgog gi me tog ltar gyur pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/spang rtsi do bo mi rgan mgo se 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa lo me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa ṭ+wāṃs/ brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags gartso bcos dang bkolu yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rims dang dug tshad tsha ba gsar rnying /dreg grum/ khrag nad/ rgyu gzer/ tshad 'khru la sogs sel/spyang tsher/rkye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la dkar nag gnyis las 'dir dkar po ste cung kha stod kyi 179

spang / gad pa/ sa khreb sogs su skyes la/ rtsa ba dkar po sbom la phyi kham skya shun dreg dang bcas pa/ yal ga dang rgyus phran can las lo ma sgro dbyibs ljang 'jam spu med pa/ nya ga mang zhing sog le kha hral tsher ma'i rang bzhin can mang po gyes shing / ngar ba'i stod char tsher ma can gyi lo chung phyogs bzhir 'khor mor skye ba'i dkyil du me tog gi gos ljang dkar mang po yod pa las me tog dkar po mchu dbyibs can 'char ba'i gdengs ka brtsegs mar gnas pa/ 'bras bu skam tshag thig can yod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/bya tra pad ces bya ba ni/ /ri thang ma nges gram la'ang skye /sdong po khong stong dkar zlum dang / /lo ma tsher ma'i so kha can/ /me tog dkar po tsher ma'i gos/ /phung bo zwa tsam yong ba yin/ /rtsa ba ra rog zug pa 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste/ dpyid dus thog mar kha 'bus kyi dus su brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus la nyi skam legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas bad kan gyi nad dang ma zhu ba rnams gyen du drangs te skyugs/ 'bras skran dang skrangs po 'dul/180

spru nagaskye skul dang ngos 'jin/'di zhing khul kha smad dang / nags 'dabs/ rtsa gseb sogs su skyes la/ rtsa ba nag po sbom la mkhregs pa/ lo ma ljang nag 'jam la mtha' sog le kha can gsum dang lnga/ bdun bcas 'brel ba'i lo rkang ring la kha sprod du skye ba dang / sdong po khong stong nar son dus mdog sngo dmar du 'gyur ba/ stod cha nas yal ga re gnyis gyes pa'i tshigs mtshams su shugs kyis g.yogs pa/ rtser gdugs rtsib gyes pa'i gdengs kar me tog ser skya 'dab lnga zhib mo mang po 'char ba dang /yal rjes kha gas pa'i 'bras bu sul mang 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/spru nag lo ma nag la snum/ /spu zhol dkar dmar me tog dkar/ /rkang ba dmar la dri ngad che/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba bcu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus te bsil skam legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang babokha yul༈phye ma thun re bsten pas gnyan tshad 'dul/ srin nad sel/'bras dang mdze nad 'joms shing khrag shor gcod/ rims kyi nad 181

dang cham pa/ mgo gzer/ grum bu bcas la phan/phur mong /skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di la rigs dkar nag smug po gsum las 'dir phur mong nag po ni kha smad kyi yul 'ga' zhig dang / khyad par zhing mu sogs skam shas che ba'i bye khreb dang / g.ya' brag lam zur/ shing gseb sogs su skyes shing / dri zhim can gyi shing sdum rigs te rtsa ba shing gi khe tshe la ngar ba smug po/ lo ma ljang skya spu 'jam gyis khyab par 'char ba 'bras bu kham ser 'dab shog can gos kyi sbub tu byibs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/phur nag srib kyi kha smad skye/ /me tog sngo la nag pa ste/ /dri ni mi zhim ro yang kha/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gtso bcos dang bgos yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas srin gsod/ gnyan dang lhog pa/ rma'i rnag dang chu ser skem/182

'phang 'azas/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la stod sa rong dang nags 'dabs/ shing gseb sogs su skye la/ shing phung mtho la shun pa skya srab phyi nang rim pa mang zhing / yal ga mang ba/ yal phran gsar ba ljang gu rim bzhin kham ser du 'gyur ba spu chung can/ lo rkang gnyis re kha sprod du skye ba/ me tog dkar ser sbub ring mchu dbyibs ma ge sar phyir mngon pa gnyis zel mar 'char zhing / 'bras bu dmar po byu ru'i mdog 'dra ba che chung sran ma tsam pa gnyis re mgo sbrel te 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/'phang ma zhes bya lo ma phra/ /sdong po cung zad che ba la/ /'bras bu smug po ro ni kha/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla brgyad pa nas dgu par btus nas ma rul bar skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas snying gi tshad pa dang mo nad sel/bong dkar/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/183

'di ri mtho'i rdza spang shing gseb sogs gang du'ang skye rtsa ba rdog chung dreg pa nag po can gnyis gsum tsam 'brel ba dang ngar ba cung mtho la/ sbal lag 'dra ba'i lo ma mtha' skor du gyes pa/ ngar ba'i rtser me tog sngon po bya mgo'i dbyibs can nyis tshom dang sum tshom gang rigs skye ba/ me tog yal rjes gang bu gzhu shub 'dra ba tshom bur skye ba'i nang du 'bras bu sro ma ltar dkar zhib can de la bya'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/g.ya' 'dab bsil ljongs 'dzin pa'i bong nga dkar/ /dung rtsa glang chen gzhon nu'i mche ba la/ /g.yu lo dung gi me tog mdzes pas brgyan/ /dug rigs mkhris tshad 'joms pa'i gtso mo lags/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa lo me 'bras yongs rdzogs btus nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkru la sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas tshad rims dang dug tshad/ mkhris tshad/rgyu tshad bcas sel zhing / sdig sbrul gyis so btab la khu bas bkru ba'am khong du btang bas phan/bya rgod sug pa/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/184

'di la mtho'i rdza ri la 'khrungs shing lo mang skye ba'i sngo zhig ste/sdong rkang khong stong sbom po'i phyi ngos yongs rdzogs lo ma spu chung skya dkar srin bal 'dra ba can gyis khyab cing / rtse la me tog rgya smug spu sob phrug shad lta bu tshom bur bzhad pa/ rtsa ba ring la byi ba'i mjug ma 'dra ba/ gsar du skye ba'i na chung la lo der sdong po dang me tog mi skye bar/ lo ma spu dkar can pad ma ltar gyes pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/da byid dkar po zhes bya ba/ /gangs ri mthon po rdza las skye/ /lhog pa 'dul ba'i dar ya kan/ /bya rgod sug pa zhes kyang bya/ /sdong bu khong stong ras bal gyon/ /skye tshul yu mo srol gong bzhin/ /rtse zlum me tog cung zad smug /bya rgod rdza la babs pa 'dra/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba drug pa nas bdun par btus nas skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bgokha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas mgo la sogs pa'i rma gso/ lhog pa 'dul/ pags nad dang gnyan skrangs 'joms/ lus zungs gso zhing gza' nad sel/ tshad pa'i zug gzer gcog zla mtshan mi snyoms pa la phan/185

bya pho cu/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la smad klung shod kyi yul rnams su yod pa dang / mang che ba g.ya' shag bye khreb/ gram khrod bcas skam shas shin tu che ba'i sa char skyes shing / lo mang skye ba'i ldum bu'am shing ldum ste/ rtsa ba shing gi khe tshe 'dra ba/ che chung ci rigs la ngar ba kham ser spu chung dang yal ga can/lo ma ljang zhib gyong rtsub spu chung can re skye ba/ zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par me tog sngon po 'dab ma stong kha can lnga re yod pa 'char zhing / ldum bu yongs rdzogs dang khyad par du me tog gi gos 'bras sogs rgas nas dmar por 'gyur ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/bya pho tsi tsi zhes bya ba/ /ming gi brjod bya skyu rug ma/ /me tog sngon po 'bras dmar ba/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/ sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol dang zhib par gtsabs nas skam gsed bya/gtso bcos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas zla mtshan 'byams pa dang khrag shor ba/186

glo brdol sogs gcod/byu rugaskye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di sa cha phal mo cher yod cing lo gcig skye ba'i ldum rigs yin/mang che ba grong ba'i nye 'khor dang / lhas nag rtsig zur/ shing gseb/chu 'gram sogs gar yang skye ba/ rtsa ba rkang gcig phra la yal phran dang spu mang ba/ sdong po gru bzhi spu chung can/ tshigs mtshams nas yal ga gyes pa/ lo ma ljang 'jam spu chung can 'jong nar rtse mo rno zhing mthar sog le'i kha zhib yod pa tshigs mtshams nas kha sprod skye zhing / me tog sngo dmar zhib mo spungs pa'i snye ma lug thug gi rnga ma 'dra ba 'char ba/'bras bu sra mkhregs zhib chung sgong dbyibs can de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/byu rug sa nag lhas las skye/ /sdong bu gru bzhi thig shing 'dra/ /lo ma g.yu yi hab rtse can/ /me tog mu men bum pa 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa ṭ+wāṃs/ brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/187

phye ma thun re bsten pas bad kan sel/ rma la sbyar na rma'i 'bu srung / srin gyi nad rigs kun dang phol mig sogs la phan/byi'u la phugaskye 8la dang ngos 'jin/rgod g.yung gnyis las 'dir rgod pa ste/ kha mtho'i rdza dang /g.ya' shag gram thang / zhing mu sogs su skyes shing / lo gnyis sam lo mang skye ba'i sngo rigs te/ rtsa ba dkar po rkang gcig rting ba phra la 'khyog pa/ ngar ba phra la sra mkhregs rgas dus smug por 'gyur ba yal phran yod pa/ lo ma 'jong dbyibs mtha' sog le kha smad cha cung zad phra ba res mos skye ba/ me tog dkar po dang 'ga' zhig zing dkar 'dab ma bzhi ba zhib chung 'char zhing / 'bras bu ser nag zhib mo yod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/byi'u la phug gram las skye/ /lo ma ljang gu mthug pa la/ /me tog dkar zhib ngar ba phra/ /ring thung mkhyid re mdzub re tsam/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa lo me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla bdun pa nas dgu par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/188

gco bcos dang babos yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas sha dug dang sbyar dug sel la zas 'ju bar byed/brag skya ha bo/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di grog rong dang / nags tshal/ zhing khul bcas kyi brag gseb tu skyes shing / sa 'byar gyi lo ma ljang nag mthug 'jam gnyer ris can 'og ma che la steng ma rim bzhin chung ba/ phyogs gsum nas res mos su pad ma ltar bgrad nas skye ba/ rgyab tu spu chung rdza mdog gis khyab pa/ dgun dus spar mo ltar nang du kum pa/ me tog sngon po dril dbyibs mgo tsel ma yu ba kham smug can 'ga' shas bzhad pa rtsa ba chung la rgyus phran yod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/btsun mo re ral brag log skye/ /lo ma leb mo me tog ni/ /sngo la rgas dus dkar ba yod/ /ro ni kha la mngar ba yin/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te/ zla ba drug pa py-is/ brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags 189

gtso bcos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas dug rigs sel/ sbyar dug sdud cing gsod/ rma 'drub cing bsam se'u dang mkhal ma'i nad sel/bre gaskye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di zhing 'brog kun tu yod cing khang ba'i nye 'khor dang / zhing gseb/ lam zur/ lhas nag sogs su skyes shing / lo gcig skye ba'i ldum rigs yin/ rtsa ba phra la thung ba rtsa phran can la ngar ba ljang skya 'jam la spu med pa gyen du skye ba yal ga dang bcas lo ma ljang mthug 'jong dbyibs can res mos kyis skye ba/ me tog dkar zhib 'dab bzhi can tshem bur 'char zhing / gang bu sgor leb che chung sen mo'i kha rgya tsam/ rtse mor nyag ga can/ dbus kyi son khang bar chod kyis gnyis su bgos pa'i nang 'bras bu smug po til 'bru tsam la ri mo mdzub mo'i sha ris 'dra ba yod pa can mang po 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/sngo yi gtso bo bre ga ni/ /'bol sa dag dang zhing gseb skye/ /lo ma sngo mthug mdangs dang ldan/ /sdong po sgyug 'dra ngar ba mang / /me tog dkar la chung ba yin/ /gong bu rnga chung 'dra ba'i nang / /'bras bu dmar smug zhib pa la/ /ne'u le yi ri mo gsal/ /zhes so/ /190

btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla bdun pa nas dgu par btus nas skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsas dang bkolu yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas mkhal nad kun la phan cing dang ga 'byed/ yan lag tshigs kyi chu ser skem/dbang po lag pa/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di cung kha mtho'i spang ri dang shing gseb sogs su skyes shing /lo ma che la ring ba/ rting bas ngar ba btum nas res mos skye ba/ ngar ba'i stod char me tog tshom bu snye ma'i dbyibs lta bu gos dang lo phran 'dres pa'i gseng nas me tog dkar ser kha gdangs pa 'jib rtsi can mang po 'char ba/ rtsa ba dkar po yal ga gsum bzhi nas lnga drug tsam yod pa byis pa'i lag pa 'dra ba mtshams nas rgyus phran gyes pa/ lo rjes mar skye ba'i rtsa ba dkar po mche ba mngon pa zhig dang thal mo sbyar ba ltar 'byar ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/dbang lag nyin srib skam gsher skye/ /sdum bu mi rgod lag pa 'dra/ /lo ma ral gri'i 'khor lo can/ /sdong po lha yi mchod sdong la/ /me tog 191

dngul gyi pa tra can/ /skam skye dkar la rlan skyes dmar/ /rtsa ba mi yi lag pa de/ /gsar rnying thal mo sbyar nas skye/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba rjes ma ste/ zla bdun pa nas brgyad par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus te nyi skam bya/gtso bachos dang bkolu yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas lus stobs gso/ khu ba dwangs ma skyed/bcud len ro tsa mkhal drod gso/'bri ta sa 'dzin/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di mang che ba gram thang dang / bye gzhung / lam 'gram/ chu rgyud sogs su skyes shing / lo mang skye ba'i sngo rigs te/ rtsa ba thung la rgyus phran phan tshun gyes pa dang / rtsa lo 'brel mtshams su rtsa spu kham ser gyis g.yogs pa/ lo ma ljang gu mthug cing 'jam la 'od dang ldan pa/dbyibs 'jong nar phra la cung ring ba ral gri'am khyi lce 'dra ba spu dang rtsa ris sogs med pa/ rug pa'i lo ma lta bu sa ngos su 'byar nas gyes pa'i mchan khung nas ngar ba'am ba thag phra zhing mnyen la ring ba phan tshun brkyangs nas gcig gis gcig la bhel ba kha dog dmar ljang rgas dus rim bzhin dmar smug tu 'gyur ba/ me tog dkar zhib dril 192

dbyibs 'dab ma bzhi ba spungs nas bzhad pas snye ma'i dbyibs ltar chags pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/'bri ta thang dang rlan ljongs skye/ /lo ma rug pa 'dra la chung / /me tog dkar dmar mdangs mdzes chung / /ngar ba dmar pos sa steng khyab/ /'bras bur smin nas byur tshon 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te/ zla bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas byang khog gi rnag khrag dang chu ser skem/glo ba'i nad sel/ lud pa 'dren/ bad mkhris kyi nad dang yan lag rtsa dkar sogs la phan/ma nu pa tra/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di yul phal mo che'i sdum rar btsugs na skye ba/ ngar ba mtho la lo ma ljang ser che la rkang ring ba dbyibs ri sho'i lo ma 'dra ba/ me tog ser po 'dab mang la tshar can rgya khur gyi me tog 'dra ba mgo sbrel bzhi lnga tsam 'char ba/ rtsa ba'i dbyibs ma nges pa dkar po rdog che la 19 3

yan lag mang ba/ phyi lpags skya bo dreg pa nag po can dri zhim mnam pa de'o/ /'dra daspre'am dbyibs rnam/lho bal rig pa'i 'byung gnas dang / /bsod nams ldan pa'i sdum rar skye/ /rtsa ba dung gi cho lo 'dra/ /lo ma g.yu lo gyen du 'bar/ /rgyab la dngul gyi ba spu chags/ /me tog ser 'od mdangs dang ldan/ /dri zhim spos ngad rgyun mi chad/ /ces so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste/ zla ba bcu pa nas bcu gcig par dang yang na phyi lo zla ba bzhi pa nas lnga par brkos te sa dreg gtsang mar bkru ba dang / gshag gtub gang bder byas nas skam tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/ phye ma thun re bsten pas pho ba'i nyen dang bad mkhris 'joms me drod skyed cing zas 'ju dang ga wod/rtsa mkhris/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/kha mtho'i spang dang shing gseb/ brag khrib bcas su skyes shing rtsa ba thung la spu can/ lo ma ljang gu rgyab ljang skya ba spu dkar pos khyab pa phra la ring ba dbyibs sbrul lce 'dra ba/ me tog sngo dmar spu sug dom 'dra 194

ba phur na spra ba 'byung ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/mkhris nad 'joms pa'i ba mo kha/ /mtho ba'i spang dang brag las skye/ /lo ma phra 'jam bal gyis g.yogs/ /phur na spra ba'i phung bor 'gyur/ /sdong po mkhyid re mdzub re tsam/ /me tog smug po dom dom 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bgos yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas mkhris pa'i tshad pa sel/ rtsa gso/ mchin mkhris kyi nad kun la mchogatshar bong /skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di mang che ba gram khrod dang / spang / lam zur/ zhing mu sogs gang sar skyes shing lo mang skye ba'i ldum rigs te thon tshad 'bel/ skye tshul rtsa ba rkang gcig rgyus phran thar thor can las/ ngar ba phra 'jam mang po skye zhing / shin tu phra ba'i lo ma ljang 'jam byi'u'i spar mo 'dra ba rtsa ba nas lo rkang dang bcas gyes pa dang / ngar ba'i stod char me tog 195

mkhan 'brum ma skya zhib snye ma ltar 'char ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/mkhan rigs tshar bong zhes bya ba/ /sdong po re la yal ga mang / /thog bu mi rgan mgo bo 'dra/ /zhes so//btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla bdun pa ṭ+wāṃs/ brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab bsil skam legs tshags gartso bcos dang bapos yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas gre ba'i tshad pa dang glo ba'i nad rigs sel/ tsha skrangs gzhom/tsher sngon/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la mtho'i rdza dang spang / brag khreb sogs su skyes shing rtsa ba sbom la ring ba nang dkar sob ro mngar ba yul skad du dred mo lca ba zhes pa/ lo ma ljang gu rgyab ljang skya dbyibs gru rkyal 'dra ba dang lug rna 'dra ba ci rigs la phyi nang yongs rdzogs tsher mas khyab pa rtsa ba nas gyes pa/ ngar ba khong stong bcad na zho 'dzag pa tsher ma'i spu can/ me tog yal rjes gang bu rmog gi dbyibs 'dra ba la'ang tsher mas khyab pa'o/ /196

'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/a byag tsher sngon sngo yi rigs/ /lo ma sdong po tsher ma can/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni zla ba drug pa nas brgyad par btus nas rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rus chag dang rma nad la phan/ chu ser 'dren/ ro stod dang rtsib logs gzer ba sogs la phan/mtshe ldum/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di skye gnas kyi dbang gis rnam pa mi 'dra ba yod kyang 'dir brag mtshe ni brag gi srub dang skam shas can gyi gad khreb sogs su skye ba/rtsa ba shing gi khe tshe la lo ma ljang sgyug tshigs can gyong rtsub rags pa mang po gshib nas skye ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/mtshe zhes bya ba bdud rtsi shing / /dbyar dgun med par gzhon nur gnas/ /rtsa ba shing gi khe mdud la/ /lo sdong sgyug ma gzhon nu 'dra//'bras bu dmar po dgra snying dbyibs /zhes so/ /babyu dus dang las snon/197

'di dag sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa lo me 'bras yongs rdzogs te/ zla ba bdun pa nas dgu par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcas dang bgos yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rtsa'i khrag shor gcod/ tshad pa gsar rnying dang / rims 'khrugs/ mkhris tshad la sogs tshad pa spyi dang khyad par mcher tshad sel/ rma gso/ skrangs pa 'dul/mdzo mo thing /skye yul dang jos 'dzin/'di nyin gyi brag nag dang gad khreb sogs su skye/ skye tshul phal cher sa ngos su bgrad pa/ sdong po cung ring yang sa ngos su 'phags tshad nyung ba/ shing shun mang zhing phyi ma skya bo dang nang ser skya yin pa/sdong po'i phyi ngos ser skya la nang snying dmar po sra zhing mkhregs pa/yal ga tshing tshang mang zhing lo ma ljang skya spu can sgro dbyibs ltar skye ba'i lo rkang rnams rtse rno ba tsher ma'i phung por 'gyur ba/ me tog phye leb ma ser po rtsa ris dmar smug can yal sla ba/ 'bras bu sran ma'i gang bu spu chung can 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/mdzo mo tsher shing ra khrag ma/ /tsan dan dmar dang nus pa mnyam/ /198

zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni shing gi sdong po yin pas zla ba bcu gcig pa nas phyi lo'i zla ba bzhi pa'i bar bcad nas nyar tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bar+shakha yul/thun re phye ma'am thang du bskol nas bsten pas khrag 'khyags 'ju zhing khrag tshad sel/ khrag gzer gcog mo nad khrag tshabs sel zhing zla mtshan snyoms par byed/zwa 'drum/gye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di yul gang du'ang yod la mang che ba grong tsho dang / lam zur/mtsher nag klung shod/ rtsa shing gi gseb sogs su skye zhing thon tshad 'bel/ rtsa ba shing ma ldum gyi khe tshe la ngar ba gru bzhi spu tsher dkar pos khyab pa/ lo ma ljang rtsub nyag ga mang la gting ring gas pa'i sgro dbyibs spu tsher can kha sprod du skye ba/ lo ma'i mchan khung nas me tog ljang skya zhib chung mang po spungs nas bzhad pa'i snye ma skye ba/ lo sdong gi spu tsher gyi zug phog rang bzhin gyi zags thon rdzas shig yod pas mi'i lus la reg na tsha reg mi bzod pa yod pas sho mang gi lo ma phur nas byugs na phan par bshad pa de'o/ /199

'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/zwa ni ri thang mtshams su skye/ /lo sdong se ba spyag shad 'dra/ /ngar ba gru bzhi smug la drang / /lo ma ljang nag tsha reg 'dzugs/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu par btus nas nyi skam bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha sul/phye ma'am nyung zad zas kyi spod la sbyar pas pho ba'i me drod skyed/zas 'ju/ khyad par sngo ma zhu ba la phan/ rlung nad 'joms shing lus zungs gso/ rlung dang ldan pa'i tshad pa sel/zin tigaspe yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di cung kha mtho'i sa 'bol dang gad khreb/ shing gseb sogs su skye zhing / ngar ba dmar smug dang smad char lo ma ljang gu 'jam la mnyen pa lce dbyibs res mos skye ba/ rim bzhin ngar ba'i stod char lo ma ljang ser dang / ser skya rtse rno ba spu 'jam can phyogs bzhi nas res mos brtsegs pa ltar skye bas dbyibs gru bzhi lta bu la/ de dag gi gseng nas me tog 'dra ba mang po bzhad pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/200

zin tig dkar mo zhes bya ba/ /gangs dang g.ya' shag bye mar skye /sdong po gru bzhi drang por skye/ /lo 'dab dkar po spu chung can/ /zur bzhi res brtsegs mchod rten dbyibs/ /sdong po mi mthong lo mas bsgribs/ /zin tig dkar mo mkhar thabs zer/ /'o ma'i gseng nas me tog mngon/ /'bras bu chung ngu gab nas sminasnye /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla bdun pa nas dgu par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha skul/phye ma thun re bsten pas gnyan skrangs dang lhog pa/ gza' nad/srin bcas la phan/gze ma/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di rgya shod dang gram thang / bye ma sogs su skye ba dang / rtsa ba phra zhing thung ba la gyen du skye ba'i ngar ba med cing / yal ga gsum bzhi tsam sa ngos su bgrad nas skye ba/ yal phran mang zhing phan tshun brkyangs pa/ lo ma zhib mo mda' sgro'i dbyibs ltar kha sprod du skye ba/ me tog ser po chung ngu 'dab ma lnga can/ 'bras bu zur lnga zur rer rno la rtsub pa'i tsher ma nyis sbyar can 'char ba de'o/ /201

'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/gze ma rgya shod bye mar skye/ /lo mas sa gzhi khyab par mnan/ /me tog chung ngu mthong ba dka'/ /'bras bu gze tsher ra mgo'i dbyibs/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla ba brgyad pa nas dgu par btus nas skam tshags bya/gatsho bcos dang babos yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas gcin sri ba dang / grum bu/ mkhal ma'i nad bcas la phan pa dang / mkhal ma'i nus pa gso ba/ mkhal rked la sogs smad kyi grang ba dang rlung nad spyi la phan/'u su/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/sa cha gang yang ldum rar 'debs 'dzugs chog pa'i lo gcig skye ba'i ldum rigs dang spod kyi bye brag yin/ rtsa ba yungs dkar 'dra ba phra la kha spu can/ ngar ba 'jam la spu med pa/ rtsa ba nas gyes pa'i lo ma sgro dbyibs nyag ga can sum 'brel dang bdun re kha sprod skye ba'i lo rkang res mos skye ba/ gdugs dbyibs gdengs kar me tog dkar zhib smug mdangs can 'dab ma lnga re yod pa/ 'bras bu kham ser ga'u 202

kha sbyor 'dra ba zlum ril sul ris can sum sbrel dang bzhi dz+rel yod pa dri zhim pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/'u su ldum ra bzang por skye/ /lo sdong me tog go snyod 'dra/ /'bras bu ga'u kha sbyor 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla bdun pa nas bcu par btus nyi skam bya/ lo sdong yang rung bas dbyar dus btus la sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re chu skol dang sbyar pas pho ba'i drod skyed/ dang ga 'byed/ bad kan tsha ba sel/ smuṭ+wāṃ po'i nad dang skom dad sel/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/ ma bu/'di yul gar yang yod pa dang mang che ba chu klung dang gtsang 'gram sogs kyi bye ma dang / gram thang / de bzhin rlan gsher che ba'i shing gseb sogs su skyes shing / sdong po khong stong nang du rkang skya sob kyis khengs pa/ shun pa smug po dang shing gzhon nu phyi la thal rtsi sngo skya chags pa/ gsar du skye ba'i yal phran ljang gu rim bzhin smug por 203

'gyur ba/ lo ma ljang skya shin tu zhib pa mang po spungs nas skye ba'i yal gsar mjor bu dpyangs pa/ me tog zing dmar chung ngu 'dab ma lnga ba mang po spungs nas 'char ba'i snye ma ring bo gug nas bzhad pa/ 'bras bu ljang gu nas 'bru tsam me tog gi grangs mnyam de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/chu shing 'om bu zhes bya ba/ /chu klung bye ma'i gram las skye/ /sdong bu smug la ring ba ste/ /me tog dmar smug phung bor 'khrigs/ /lo ma phra sig sngo ba yin/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo ma dang me tog ste zla lnga pa nas bdun par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/thun re phye ma'am thang du bsten pas chu ser skem/ khrag gi tshad pa sel/ 'khru ba gcod/ khyad pakā kā hā/ ṭā/nga sbyar dug sel/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di klung shod dang nags gseb sogs su skye zhing lo mang skye ba'i sngo rigs te ngar ba rer yal ga gnyis re gyes pa'i rtser lo ma che la 'jam pa lnga re can re re rgyas pa/ yal ga'i gyes mtshams nas me tog 204

zing dkar 'dab ma drug re can 'char ba/ yal rjes 'bras bu lu gu'i rlig khug 'dra ba/ smin nas dmar por 'gyur ba'i nang du nya sgong 'dra ba'i sa bon dang / mngar khu gar mos gang ba 'dogs pa/ rtsa ba gcig las rtsa phran rgyus pa 'dra ba mang po gyes pa bcas yongs grags go sla/'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/'ol mo se ni khrag gi rkyal pa 'dra/ /zhes so/ /bsku dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste/ zla ba brgyad pa nas dgu par btus te skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bgokha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rtsa'i nad dang zla mtshan mi snyoms pa/ bu dang sha ma/ khrag ngan 'gags pa sogs mngal skyon rnams sbyong zhing /mkhal ma'i nad sel/yu mo mde'u 'byin/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di la stod srib kyi brag gseb dang rdza gseng sogs su skye zhing /rtsa ba sra la cung ring ba/ stod char shun pa dang lo ltar phung gsog thebs pa'i lo rkang skam po skya bos g.yogs pa/ phra la mnyen pa'i lo rkang mang po phung bor skye ba/ re re'i rtser yal ga gsum re la sbal lag 205

'dra ba'i lo ma ljang skya gsum re skye bas sngo sib sib chags pa/ ngar ba smug po'i rtser me tog sngo dmar pad phor dbyibs/ 'dab ma srab la 'jam pa lnga re dang ze'u 'bru dmar ser can 'char ba/ gang bu gzhu shubs 'dra ba lnga tshom gyi nang du sa bon dang bcas yul kun tu skye bas ngos zin sla/'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/lo ma sngon po bran chung 'dra/ /gser thig ser pos kun tu gang nas gnas/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa lo me 'bras te zla drug pa nas bdun par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gatsho bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas bu dang sha ma ma thon pa dang / mde'u la sogs khong du lus pa'i zug rngu 'byinakyi/ rma tshad sel zhing chu ser skem/spe yul dang ngos 'dzin/g.ya' — ma/'di la mtho'i byang bltas kyi rdza dang rdo gseb tu skye zhing / rtsa ba phra la zhib pa rgyus phran can/ phra zhing mnyen la snyi ba'i ngar ba ljang dkar chun por skye ba'i ngos su lo ma ljang smug dang ljang ser ci rigs chung ngu 206

mthug cing 'jam la 'od dang ldan pa/ mthar nyag chung can phyogs gsum nas res mos skye bas ngar ba'i rtser me tog bzhad pa lta bu'i dbyibs grub pa/ me tog ser po shin tu chung ba/ 'dab ma thung la mthug pa bzhi re can ro shin tu kha ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/g.ya' kyi sngon po ri gnyan rdza las skye/ /lo ma ljang ser cung zad skya/sgor mo pad ma spungs ltar skye/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo ma ste zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab dang bsil skam legs tshags bya/gatsho brtsos dang bamakha skyal/phye ma thun re bsten pas mkhris tshad sel zhing mkhris pa rgyas pa zhi ba dang / thur du sbyong zhing yang na skyug par byed/ 'di mkhris pa'i sman mchog yin ces gsungs/g.yar mo thang /skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di kha mtho'i ne'u gsing dang / chu 'gram/ rlan gsher che ba'i spang ljongs sogs su skyes/ bongs tshad shin tu chung ba dang lo ma ljang 207

'jam mthug pa lce dbyibs gsum bzhi tsam rtsa ba nas gyes pa/ rtsa ba phra la thung ba rgyus phran thar thor yod pa/ me tog zing dmar dkyil du ser thig can dril dbyibs kha g.yel la sbubs nas ge sar chung ngu mngon pa/ 'dab ma lnga re yod pa bzhi re bzhad pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/g.yar mo thang zhes bya ba ni/ /spang ljongs ne'u gsing kun las skye/ /me tog pad ma rā ga'i mdangs/ /ze'u mdangs bya mig gyen lta 'dra/ /༵nga/ /bas sa gzhi dmar por bsgyur/ /lo ma phra sib nyag ga can/ /zhes brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste zla lnga pa nas drug par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gatsho brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rma droṭ+wāṃ trī /dang / skrangs pa 'dul/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di zhing 'brog kun tu yod pa dang / khyad par kha smad dang zhing khul du thon tshad mang / rtsa sdum gyi gseb dang shing phung gi 'og sogs bsil grib dang rlan tshad yod pa'i sa char skye ste/ rtsa ba dkar po sbom 208

zhing rgyas pa dbyibs nges med rdog mang gcig la gcig 'brel ba/ngar ba phra ldem ring la sra yal ga med pa/ lo ma sngo ljang phra ring sbrul lce 'dra ba rtse mo rgyab phyogs su 'dril ba/ me tog ser dkar ram dkar smug gi tshom bu 'phyangs nas bzhad pa/ 'bras bu sran ma'i rdog po tsam/smin dus chu bur gyi rang bzhin nang du rus pa yod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/yon tan brgyad ldan ding khri bar ma ni/ /nyams dga'i nags tshal dag las skye/ /rtsa ba dkar pos sa gzhi khyab/ /lo ma sngon po ral gri 'dra//me tog dkar pos lo steng khebs/ /'bras bu nang dkar ring bsrel 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu gcig par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus la skam gsed legs tshags bya/gtso brtsas dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas tshe bsring bcud len/ stobs 'phel ro tsa skyed/ mngal tshad sel/ pho ba'i me drod skyed cing yi ga 'byed/ yan lag tshigs kyi chu ser dang rnag skem/ram bu/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/209

kha mtho'i yul kun tu yod cing / spang dang rdza 'jam sogs gang sar skye ba/ rtsa ba dmar smug sbom la mkhregs pa/ phyi ngos kha dog rdza smug can la rtsa phran thar thor yod pa/ ngar ba dmar ljang khong stong sgyug tshigs can gnyis gsum skye ba/ rtsa ba las gyes pa'i lo ma dbyibs 'jong ring sne rgyab phyogs su 'dril zhing mdun ljang gu rgyab ljang skya/ lo rkang gi rtsa ba dmar smug mang po skye ba/ me tog dkar po'am ngang dmar zhib mo spungs nas bzhad pa/ rim bzhin 'bras bu dmar smug byur zhib 'dra ba mang po 'dogs pa'i snye ma can no/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/ram bu zhes bya rtsi skam ni/ /srib mo'i ri dang thang las skye/ /lo ma sngo nag ral gri 'dra/ /rkang sdong phug ron rkang ltar dmar/ /me tog dkar po khyi mjug 'dra/ /'bras bu dmar zhib byu ru 'dra/ /rtsa ba dmar po thag bslas dbyibs/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkru ba dang / spu dang dreg pa rnams med par byas nas so sor nyi skam bya/gatsho bcos dang bkol rtsal/phye ma thun re bsten pas grang 'khru gcod/ rgyu ma'i grang gzer 210

'joms/ rgyu tshad dang dmar bshal la'ang phan/ru rta/skye skyal dang ngos 'dzin/'di kha mtho'i nyin gyi spang rir skyes shing / lo ma ljang ser rgyab ljang dkar spu chung can sog le'i kha 'dra ba mang po sa ngos su bgrad nas skye ba dang / ngar ba med pa/ dbus su me tog sngo dmar gnyis gsum nas brgyad dgu tsam pa tshom bur skye ba/ tsher ma med pa ma gtogs spyang tsher nag po sa 'byar can dang dbyibs mtshungs pa/ rtsa ba ser skya sra mkhregs phyi'i shun pa lo re bzhin brje ba/ rtsa lo 'brel ba'i mtshams su 'byar bag can gyi tshi ba shing gi thang chu 'dra ba dri zhim pa 'di la ru rta dkar por ngos 'dzin byed do/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus nas gshag gtub ci rigs bya/gartso bcos dang babos yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rlung khrag 'thab pa dang / pho long 'khrog pa/ glo ba'i nad sogs la phan/ srog rlung 'joms pa dang nus pa rno bas skran dang bad kan bshig sha ro la sogs gcod par nus pa'o/ /211

re skon/gye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di kha mtho'i sa cha gar yang thar thor yod pa dang / phal che ba g.ya' shag bye 'jam chu rgyud gram thang bcas su skyes/ rtsa rnying phra zhing rgyus phran thar thor yod pa/ dbyibs byi'u la phug gi rtsa ba 'dra ba/ phyi shun dmar po dang sdong po sa ngos las gyen du mi 'phags shing / lo ma'i ngar ba yan lag can kha dog dmar skya/ lo ma ljang dkar sngo sib mang po srung nas skye ba/ me tog ser po mchu dpyangs shing mjug ma can/ gang bu 'jong dbyibs kha gnyis su gas pa'i nang du sa bon can 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/rtsi dmar rkang gcig g.ya' spang skye/ /lo ma sngo sib sa la bgrad/ /me tog dkar ser chung la mdzes/ /rtsa ba rkang gcig rab tu dmar/ /bdud rtsi chu yi zil ba chags/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gtso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas khrag ngan skem zhing khrag tshad 'joms/212

smug po'i nad dang rtsa'i tshad pa sel/lug ru sprug po/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di yul gar yang yod pa dang / mang che ba spang dang sa khreb/zhing skam/ rdo gseb bcas gang sar skyes shing / lo mang skye ba'i sngo rigs te/ rtsa ba nag po yan lag dang rgyus phran can la yal ga med pa'i ngar ba can gsum bzhi tsam gshib nas gyen du skye ba/ ngar ba'i smad char sgro dbyibs kyi lo ma nyag chen sog le kha/ smad nas rim bzhin res mos dang / kha sprod 'khor skyes byas pa dang / me tog dmar smug ya mchu lug gi rwa 'khyil 'dra ba mang po 'char ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/lug smug rdo rog gseb nas skye/ /lo ma ring la nya ga can/ /me tog lug gi rwa 'khyil 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas rma phab dang skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas dug tshad byer ba sdud pa dang / sha dug sel/ pho long smug po'i nad la phan/213

thing mngar/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di skam tshad che ba'i rtswa thang / chu rgyud kyi bye thang / zhing mu bcas su skye zhing srad rigs kyi skye dngos yin/ rtsa ba ser la shun pa rdza mdog dang kham smug can sa 'og nas ring por brkyangs pa/ ngar ba shing ma ldum gyen du drang por skye zhing / yal phran rer lo chung sgro dbyibs ltar kha sprod kyis skye ba/ lo sdong yongs la spu chung thung rtsub kyis khyab pa/ me tog gi snye mar me tog phye leb ma kha dog zing dmar ram smug skya srad dmar gyi me tog 'dra ba 'char ba/ gang bu phra la ring ba zor ba ltar gug pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am jebyibs rnam/shing mngar lo ma sngo la chung / /rtsa ba ser la ro ni mngar/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba dgu pa nas bcu pa dang / yang na phyi lo'i zla ba gnyis pa nas gsum par brkos te sa dreg gtsang mar byas la shun pa dor te legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas glo ba'i nad dang khyad par glo tshad 'joms/ lu ba gcod cing lud pa 'dren/ skad 'gags pa dang gre 214

bar thor ba byung bar phan/ skom dad dang rtsa nad sel/sum cu tigaskye yul dang ngos 'dzin/kha smad srib kyi nags gseb dang / khyad par brag khreb tu langs shing / rtsa ba thung la spu can/ lo ma ljang gu mthug la reg bya cung rtsub pa/dbyibs khem bu spub pa 'dra ba phra zhib mang po sa 'byar pad ma spungs pa ltar skye ba'i dbus nas/ ngar ba dmar smug spu chung can/ stod char yal phran kha dbrag gyes pa re re'i rtser me tog ser po rgya gling la 'dab ma lnga ba mdog shin tu gsal ba re 'char ba de'o/ / 'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/sum cu tig ces bya ba ni/ /g.ya' spang nags dang brag las skye/ /lo ma leb chung ko ma mchu/ /pad ma spungs bzhin gdan du skye/ /ngar ba dmar po ba spu can/ /tshi can me tog dmar la ser/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang bkolu yul/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te/ zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas mchin tshad dang / mkhris tshad/ rma tshad 215

sogs la phan zhing / rnag khrag skem/ rgyu long gi nad la phan/ mkhris rims dang rgyu gzer sogs la'ang phan par bshad/se ba'i me togasgye rtsal dang ngos 'jin/'di nags klung yod sa dang / zhing khul du mang zhing / nags 'dabs dang zhing mu/ lam 'gram sogs gang sar skye/ ngar ba cung zad drang la shun pa gzhon dus dmar smug dang / rgas nas skya bor 'gyur ba/ yal sdong rnams la tsher ma leb mo zur gsum g.yu'i sen mo'am mda' sgro 'dra ba du mas khyab pa/ me tog dkar po 'dab ma bzhi ba ze'u 'bru ser po can 'char zhing / 'bras bu dmar po sgong dbyibs smin dus yu ba sbom por 'gyur ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/se me sdong phung che ba la/ /tsher ma dag gis thams cad khyab/ /lo ma sgor mo cung zad rtsub/ /me tog dkar la 'bras bu dmar/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste zla ba lnga pa nas drug par btus nas ma rul bar bsil skam legs tshags bya/gartso brtsos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas mkhris tshad sel zhing rlung kha gnon/ bad 216

mkhris ldan pa 'joms/ rtsa sbu~Xs kyi nadu rnams sdud/ glo nad sel/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/ ma ra —/'di kha smad lung ba dang / lam zur/ rtsa gseb bcas su skye ba dang 'debs 'dzugs byed kyi yod pa dang / ngar ba dang yal phran yongs la spu rtsub mos khyab pa/ lo ma rtse mo lnga ba nya ga shin tu che ba/ phyi nang gnyis kar spu chung rtsub mos khyab pa res mos skye ba/ me tog ser la 'dab lnga che la mdzes pa dbus smug po yin pa/ gang bu 'jong dbyibs til gang ma son khang lnga yod pa spu gyong cub kyis khyab pa'i nang du 'bras bu mkhal dbyibs can mang po yod pa dri zhim pa zhig go /'dra dbe'am dbyibs rnam/so ma ra dza byi'u mkhal ma 'dra/ /zhes so/ /brtusnyedus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni 'bras bu ste zla bdun pa nas brgyad par btus te skam gsed legs tshags bya/gtso bcos dang bamakha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas za 'phrug dang / glang shu/ rngo mdze sogs pags pa'i nad dang / yan lag lhu tshigs skrangs pa sogs chu ser 'a/sa byung ba'i nad rigs kun la mchog217

sran ma'i me togaskye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di zhing khul phal mo cher 'debs pa dang sa bon btab nas lo der smin pa'i gang bu can gyi 'bru sde'i sran rigs te/ ngar ba ljang dkar 'jam la mnyen pa yal ga can/ gzhan dang phan tshun 'khyud nas skye ba/ yal phran gyi rtse mo kha dbrag phra mo a long 'khyil ba yal ga'i stod char lo chung kha sprod skye ba'i srad lo sgro dbyibs ma skye ba dang / ngar ba'i tshigs mtshams nas lo ma sngo ljang nyis 'brel phye ma leb kyi dbyibs 'dra ba gyes shing / de'i mchan khung nas me tog phye leb ma/ phyi 'dab zing dkar dang / nang 'dab zing smug can 'char zhing / gang bu zlum nar 'grangs pa'i nang du 'bras bu kha dog ljang nag zlum ril gsum nas bcu bar 'dogs pa ngos 'dzin gcig gyur yin pas rtogs sla'o/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste zla lnga pa nas drug par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gartso bcos dang bamakha yul/mkhal ma'i nad la phan/ khrag shor gcod/sro lo dkar po/skye rtsal dang ngos 'dzin/218

'di kha mtho'i rdza 'jam dang / rdza las babs pa'i chu shul bye ma sogs su skye zhing / rtsa ba dkar po phra la gnyer ma can yal ga dang / spu sogs med pa/ nyung dri bro ba/ rtsa ba nas gyes pa'i lo ma ljang dkar 'jam la nar mo dbyibs gru rkyal 'dra ba/ 'ga' zhig rtse stod na nyag ga kha sprod re yod pa/ me tog dkar po 'dab ma bzhi can 'char ba/yal rjes gang bu leb mo nas 'bru'i dbyibs can gyi nang du sa bon dkar zhib can/ ldum bu'i bongs tshad ha cang chung ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/sro lo dkar po zhes bya ba/ /g.ya' ri gangs ri rdza las skye /rtsa ba phra dkar rting ba ring / /lo ma me tog gnyis ka dkar/ /me tog dkar dmar mdangs dri che/ /tsan dan dkar po'i dri bas zhim/ /gang bu leb mo 'bras bu zhib/ /ces so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par brkos nas sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus te bsil skam bya/gartso brtsos dang babokha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas tsha ba'i nad spyi dang khyad par du stod du tsha ba rgyas pa/ glo ba'i tshad pa dang rnyogs tshad/ de min rma yi rtsa kha sdom pa/ rims tshad glo la babs pa sogs la phan/219

sro lo dmar po/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di kha mtho'i srib kyi rdza khreb dang shing gseb sogs su skyes shing /rtsa ba sbom zhing che la dbyibs ma nges pa yal ga dang bcas pa rting ba ring por brkyangs pa/ nang dmar skya sob la phyir dreg pa nag po rim pa mang pos g.yogs pa/ dri zhim pa yal ga med pa'i ngar ba mang po skyes pa/ lo ma ljang dkar mthug la 'jam pa lce dbyibs 'dra ba mang po res mos skyes pa rgas dus dmar por 'gyur ba/ rtser me tog dmar po sra la rtsub pa dom dom gyen slog 'dra ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/sro lo dmar po tshan dmar te/ /rdza brag g.ya' spang chu la sogs/ /gar yang skye la sprul ba mang / /sdong po dmar gyong rab tu mang / /lo ma mthug spun dngul zil can/ /sdong po yongs la lo mas khyab/ /ston dus dmar bas ban btsun 'dra/ /me tog gang 'bras dmar la rtsub/ /rtse mo rbad kyis bcad pa 'dra/ /rtsa ba mi yi glo ba 'dra/ /pags pa nag thig dri ngad che/ /zhes so/ /brtu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste/ zla ba brgyad pa nas bcu par brkosanas dreg pa gtsang mar bkrus thog gshag gtub gang bder byas la nyi 220

skam bya/gartso brtsas dang phan nus/phye ma thun re bsten pas glo ba'i tshad pa sel/ dbugs mi bde la phan/ kha'i nad sel/ kha dri sbyong / cham tshad glo la bab par mchogahong len/skye yul dang ngos 'jin/'di kha mtho'i 'brog khul gyi sa cha gar yang yod pa dang / gtso bo rdza dang spang / na khul sogs gang du'ang skyes pa/ rtsa ba kham ser sbom la mkhregs shing lci ba/ gnyer ris dang rgyus phran mang ba la ngar ba hril 'jam yal ga med pa/ lo ma ljang 'jam mthug gyong spu med 'od dang ldan pa dbyibs 'jong nar can rtsa ba las gyes shing phal cher sa ngos su bgrad pa/ ngar ba'i stod char me tog gi snye ma sngo nag gam smug por me tog dkar zhib smug mdangs can spungs nas 'char ba 'bras bu nag po de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/hong len g.ya' shag rdza las skye/ /lo ma smug mthug snum pa la/ /me tog smug po 'brong lo 'dra/ /rtsa ba spu can go brun 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni rtsa ba ste zla brgyad pa nas dgu par brkos nas 221

sa dreg gtsang mar bkrus la bsil skam legs tshags bya/gartso bachos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas ngan khrag skem zhing khrag mkhris rgyas pa 'joms shing khyad par 'khrugs tshad dang don lnga'i tshad pa sel/ glang thabs dang lhog pa/ gzer thung sogs la'ang phan/a krong /skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/'di g.ya' shag dang rdza 'jam kho nar skyes pa/ lo mang skye ba'i sngo rigs te/ ngar pa smyag po phra zhing mkhregs la gyong ba'i yal ga can/ lo ma sngo ljang nyag chen phra sib spungs pa'i lo rkang phal cher kha sprod du skye ba dang / lo ma'i gseb tu chu'i zegs ma chags pa/ me tog smug ser ge sar ser skya can zhib mo mig gis sod tsam 'dogs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/glo sman rgyal po a krong ni/ /byang gi ri la skye ba yin/ /lo ma sngo ljang nyag ga can/ /sdong bu klu shing nag po 'dra/ /bdud rtsi zil pa snum gyis brgyan/ /zhes so/ /bangu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni lo sdong me 'bras yongs rdzogs te zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags 222

bya/gatsho bcos dang bkolu yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas glo ba'i tshad pa dang / glo mang 'gog dka' ba/ gre ba'i tshad pa sogs sel ba dang / byang khog stod du bsags pa'i rnag rnams skem/a byagaskye 8la dang ngos 'jin/'di la stod spang las skyes shing rtsa ba nag po thung la spu'i rang bzhin/ lo ma ljang gu sgro dbyibs kha dbrag can reg bya rno la rtsub pa/snar bcug nas phur na sna khrag thebs pas yul gyi ldum bu khrag gtar zer ba/ me tog dmar ser ze'u 'bru lug mig lta bu la/ 'dab ma sbrul lce'i dbyibs can nyi shu yas yod pa/ mdangs gsal bas gur gum me tog dang mtshungs pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/me tog a byag ces bya ba/ /srib mo'i na spang dag las skye/ /lo ma spun rtsub rno la gyong / /sdong bu gdugs kyi yu ba 'dra/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste zla ba bdun pa nas brgyad par btus nas sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/223

gartso bcos dang bapokha yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas rus pa chag pa sbyor zhing chu ser skem/tshak+ṇi rigs kun la phan/ stong 'khrugs sogs gzer gyi rigs rnams 'a —mas/ ug chos/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/ 'di kha stod nyin ri'i g.ya' khreb dang / rdza/ spang / sa nag sogs gang du'ang skyes/ rtsa ba skya sob sbom la dreg pa dang rgyus phran nag po rting ba phra ba/ lo ma ljang nag mthug 'jam res mos skye ba/ me tog zing dmar che ba dbyibs rgya gling kha 'dab ma lnga can/ gang bu gzhu shubs 'dra ba'i nang du 'bras bu sran chung 'dra ba de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/me tog byu ru'i phung bo 'dra/ /ze'u 'bru rdo rje ra 'dra ser/ /gong bu dgo ba'i rwa 'dra'i nang / /'bras bu rgya yi sran chung ngam/ /dug mo nyung 'dra nag la snum/ /zhes so/ /babyu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste zla ba lnga pa nas drug par btus nas rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gtso bcos dang bamakha yul/224

phye ma thun re bsten pas rlung 'khyil ba 'byin/ sbos pa sbyong / glang thabs sel/skye yul dang ngos 'dzin/ ut+pal/'di kha mtho'i srib kyi byang lta'i rdza spang 'dres pa'i sa char skyes shing / rtsa ba rkang gcig dbyibs la phug 'dra ba smad cha nas yan lag gnyis re gyes pa/ sdong po khong stong sbom la ring ba spu chung ser pos yongs su khyab pa/ lo ma ljang ser 'jong nar mtha' snyoms pa phyi nang yongs rdzogs spu chung ser pos khyab pa/ yal ga'i mchan khung nas lo chung res mos skye ba/ me tog sngon po 'dab ma lnga ba ze'u 'bru dang ge sar ser po can dbyibs tsher sngon gyi me tog 'dra ba 'char ba me tog yal rjes gang bu rdo rje'i dbyibs can son khang lnga can gyi nang du 'bras bu nag zhib yod pa de'o/ /'dra dpe'am dbyibs rnam/ut+pal zhes bya'i me tog dri bsung ldan/ /rtsa ba rkang gcig lca ba 'dra ba la/ /sdong bu me tog ldum ra'i rgya men 'dra/ /gang bu rdo rje phyed pa'i khong ba ru/ /'bras bu nag la zhib mang ldan pa yin/ /zhes so/ /btu dus dang las snon/sman du sbyar bya ni me tog ste zla drug pa nas brgyad par btus te 22bya

sngo 'chol rma phab skam gsed legs tshags bya/gatsho bcos dang bkol yul/phye ma thun re bsten pas glo ba dang mchin pa'i tshad pa 'joms/ṭī sdo/ tsha 'gag sel la tshad pa spyi la phan/ khyad par du khrag gi nad la

zur bkod/gcig sman gyi tshab bstan pa/sngo la yang rtsi sman gyi nus pa dang yon tan ldan zhing tshab tu btang bar chog pa yod do zhes pa ni/thog mar rtsi sman bzang drug gi tshab la/cu gang tshab la kha'i sro lo dkar po'i me tog gis 'ong bar grags ste/ de yang bshad rgyud kyi nus pa rkyang sel las/ cu gang glo tshad kun sel rma tshad gcog /sro lo sug 'dras glo ba'i tshad pa sel/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nus pa mtshungs par nges so/ /gur gum tshab pri yang ku kha 'bus bya rjes ma sleb gong btus pa'i klu mo gur gum mam/ mchin sman rtsi'u chung zhes pa de nyid dang spang gi gur gum mam gzer 'jom dmar ser dang ldum rar btsugs pa'i gur gum sogs kyis 'ong bar bshad/li thi tshab la/ bal bu'i me tog dmar dkar de nyid do/ /dza ti'i tshab la sdum dzā ti zhes pa dbyibs go snyod 'dra ba de las cung zad phra zhing me tog dkar po 'char zhing dri zhim can gram khrod sogs su 'khrungs pa de nyid dang / yang na tang kun pa yis snying gi 227

ṭ+wāṃṭā/ pa sel/ rgyud las gsungs pa ltar snying tshad skabs su btang bar sug spel tshab la/ klung shod skye ba'i bre ga rnga 'dra ba'am dge slong chab dril zhes pa 'bras bu dmar zhib can de'o/ /ka rkola'i tshab la/ go snyod kyi 'bras bu 'ong ste/ 'khrungs dpe las/klung shod skye ba'i go snyod de/ /ko la dag dang nus pa mtshungs zhes so/ /ghi wang gi tshab la/ sa sti zhes pa na khrod las byung ba'i ser po gtub pas lcags 'od 'tsher ba de dang / brag zhun gyi khaṇ+ḍa/ lug ru ser po sogs gang bde bya'am/ yang na tshad ldan man ngag zur mkhar bas bzhed pa ghi wang bzo thabs ni/ gong bshad sa ghi ser po srang lnga la lug ru ser po srang gsum/ brag zhun gyi khaṇ+ḍa srang gang gur gum dang skyer khaṇ+ḍa zho re bcas zhib par btags la/ glang bre dmar mig dmar gyi mkhris pa'am yang na dom mkhris sogs mkhris sna tshogs par bsags pas sbrus la bsil skam bgyis pas/ rims tshad mchin dug dang rtsa kha bsdams pa sogs sti wang dngos dang yon tan mtshungs par som nyi bral ba'o/ /ga bur tshab la/ sngo rgyal stong ri zil ba ste/ khyad par can gyi nus pa bsil bas de ni/ 'khrungs dpe las/ bdud rtsi stong ri zil pa ni/ /tshad nad 'joms pa'i dpa' bo ste/ /shing bcud ga bur zil gyis 228

gnon/ /zhes dang / phu la stong ri zil ba skye ba yi/ /chu rlung de dag 'bab pa'i chu rgyud du/ /gces phrug tshad pas 'chi ba mi srid do/ /zhes pa ltar nges so/ /yang na rje blon gyi tshul yin pas cu gang yang btang na 'os so/ /tsan dan dkar po'i tshab shing dril dkar po ste/ de yang 'khrungs dpe las/ shing dril dkar smug ri la skye/ /dmar ser gnyis ni chu la skye/ /kun kyang nus pa bsil ba ste/ /chu 'thung tshad pa sel bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa dang gzhan yang shing dril chu skyes dkar po yu ba ring la dri ngad can me tog dril bu 'dra ba de nyid chu bsil gtsang mar dug phral bgyis pa dang / yang na/ hong len rtsa ba dang spang rgyan dkar po gnyis gang rung gis 'ong bar bshad do/ /tsan dan dmar po'i tshab la/ shing dril dmar po chu skyes dang /yang na shing kho tho 'am/ mdzo mo nu shing zer ba'i rtsa ba der/ 'khrungs dpe las/ mdzo mo seng ldeng ra khrag ma/ /tsan dan dmar dang nus pa mtshungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ khyad par bud med khrag tshabs nad la tsan dan las kyang lhag par gsungs/a ga ru nag po'i tshab la/ shing brngas nag rtsa ba dang / shog shing rtsa ba dug phral byas pa dang / srin shing snar ma dang phur sngon sogs gang dgas byas pa snang /229
