gle tres tshab la/ klu shing gra ma'i rtsa bas 'ong bar nges shing / khyad par 'brum bu'i nad la sle tres las bsngags pa dang / yang na rgyud las/ sle tres kaṇ+ḍa ka ris rlung tshad sel/ /zhes dang / rje rang byung bas sle tres 'du ba snyoms pa ste/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri de dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa ltar ma nu bzhi thang sogs kaṇ+ḍa ka ri sle tres gnyis 'gro ba'i skabs kaṇ+ḍa ka ri cha bskyed pas 'thus so/ /'bras bu gsum las a ru'i tshab la/ gtsang po'i rgyud du skye ba'i 'om bu'i me tog dmar po de nyid kyis nges ste/ 'khrungs dpe las/ rgya gar yul du ngo mtshar a ru skye/ /bod kyi yul du khri shing 'om bu skye/ /ro nus a ru ra dang mtshungs/ /'du ba spyi snyoms chen po yin/ /zhes so/ /yang na ldum bu rdo rje mchu zhes pa/ de'i rtsa ba'i tshab 'ong ba la/ sman chen gyi bzi yang chog par 'dug ste/ 'khrungs dpe las/ 'du ba spyi snyoms rdo rje mchu/ /sdong po phra la phung po skye/ /lo ma g.yu yi pa tra 'dra/ /me tog zangs kyi mdog 'dra zhing / /ze'u 'bru rma bya'i ldem 'phru 'dra/ /rtsa ba ro drug ldan pa ste/ /tsha grang ldan 'dus nad kun 'joms/ /ba ru'i tshab la/ 'tsho byed gong ma rnams kyis kyang / glu shing se ba'i 'bras bur mdzad de/ de yang 'khrungs dpe las/ klu shing se ba dkar po ni/ /me tog dung gi tshom bu 'dra/ /glo nad sel ba'i sman gcig ste/ /'bras bu gser gyi rkyal pa 'dra/ /chu ser 'joms pa'i dar 230

ya kan/ /zhes dang / ba ru ra yis bad mkhris chu ser sel/ /zhes pa ltar nges so/ /mi ru'i tshab la ba sha ka btang srol 'dug yang na skyer dkar gyi me tog la byed pa ste/ 'khrungs dpe las/ sman mchog skyer ba zhes bya ste/ /sdong po dngul la shun pa gser/ /me tog bsil la 'bras bu drod//ro nus skyur kha bsil rtsub ldan/ /'di yis mi sel gang yang med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ me tog bsil snyoms bgyis pas skyu ru'i tshab zhes so/ /'bras bu dmar po de nyid drod snyoms byas pas se 'bru'i tshab 'ong bar nges so/ /snying zho sha'i tshab la/ pa yag gi 'bras bu lug snying 'dra ba de nyid do/ /yang bya rog nor bus snying gi tshad pa sel/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshab 'ong bar nges so/ /shing spom nag gi 'bras bu yang 'ong bar bshad/ snying rlung skabs/ bsam gtan zag bcas ldan pa'i snying zhes gsang sman mdzad bzhin ri bong snying gis kyang 'ong bar yod/nā ga ge sar tshab ni/ nus sel las/ nā ga puji na ga ge sar dang //pad ma ge sar glo mchin snying tshad sel/ /zhes dang / ut+pal glo mchin tshad pa ma lus sel/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ut+pal gyis 'ong bar nges/yang rtag ngu yis 'ong ba gsungs pa yod/po1

'dren byed po so cha'i tshab/ sngo po so cha zhes pa nyin srib gang rung gi chu shul gram khrod sogs la skye ba sngo leb ri sha nag po'i lo ma 'dra ba zos na skyug nyams byed pa de dang / yang na spyang shog gi lo ma spu chung can de kha 'bus gang btus pa sngo 'chol byas pa'i nang du tshon spang ma ljang khu tsha 'deb tsam byas nas skam pa de nyid kun 'dren rtsi byed pa mchog tu bsngags pa ste/ 'khrungs dpe las kyang ut+pal ser po zhes kyang bya/ /ga'u rgyang shog ces kyang bya/ /ri sha ser po zhes kyang bya/ /'dren byed gtso bo zhes kyang bya/ /lo ma shing chung rna cog 'dra/ /sdong po sha pho'i bog rwa 'dra/ /me tog gser gyi sgrom bu 'dra/ /ze'u 'bru rdo rje rtse lnga 'dra/ /rtsa ba dung gi phur ba 'dra/ /nus pas nad kun gyen du 'dren//me tog dud pa btang ba yis/ /bi ṣa nag po'i nus pa bcom /yon tan kun ldan sman mchog legs/ /rang byung rgyal bas/ zangs rdo mthing spang nad kun gyen du 'dren/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i tshab la/ ga bra zhes pa kaṇ+ḍa ka ri smug po stag tsher bri ha te zer ba de yin/zhing mngar tshab la/ 'dam bu ka ra/ yul skad du/ a mngar rtsa mngar zhes sa chu 'dam du skyes pa de nges te/ nus bshad las shing mngar glo tshad sel/ 'dam bu ka ras glo mchin rtsa tshad sel/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /kra2

pya zhel rtse tshab la hong len gyi kha spu byed pa dang / yang na bshad rgyud las/ pu shel skyug gcod bad kan tsha ba sel /sog ka pa yis skyug pa gcod par byed/ /ces pa ltar/gu gul nag po'i tshab la gza' bdud margo dgu ste/ 'khrungs dpe las kyang / bsnam na glang chen dri ma bro/ /bdug na gza' rgod 'byung po rgyal/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /dmar po gsum gyi tshab bstan par/ stod nad kyi skabs/ mtshal btsod 'bri mog gsum/ smad nad kyi skabs btsod rgya skyegs zhu mkhan gsum ste/ de'ang mtshal la/ rdo cog la'am rdo mtshal zhes pa btsag rdo dmar po bcag 'phro la 'od 'tsher ba zhib par btul bas mtshal dīspyag/ dang tha mi dad pa de'o/ /yang na smug po mdung rtse zhes pas kyang brtsod tshab la ri stod kyi sa la 'khrungs pa'i khrag nad 'joms pa'i dar ya kan nam/ srad dmar dar dmar rgyal na 'dra/ /zhes pa de'o/ /'bri mog tshab la/ srib kyi sur nag sogs la skye ba'am ldum 'bri mog ces pa'i me tog dmar smug spu chung can ngar ba ring la 'o ma sog le kha de nyid do/ /rgya skyegs tshab la/ ldum rgya skyegs zhes pa me tog dmar zhing spu chung can lo ma skag skyur dang 'dra ba/ ro skyur la khu ba dmar po skag mdog 233

'byin pa de'o/ /yang na rang byung bas la k+ṣas glo mkhal 'gram tshad sel/ /zhes pa ltar la k+ṣa tshig khar cher ma song bar tshab rung ngo / /zhu mkhan nam seng khrom tshab zhes pa rgya lcang gi lo ma dang skyer dkar gyi lo ma sogs gang bde byed chogab gnyis tshab ces pa/ ba le ka dang / ba sha ka ste de yang ba me ka'i tshab la btsod mdud dang ga dur gang rung ngam/ yang na gur tig gis 'ong bar nges so/ /ba sha ka'i tshab la lug ngal lam/ sdum ba sha ka zer ba'i nyin srib gang rung khams rdza khreb phal cher skye ba yod/ lo ma ljang khu me tog ser po ngar ba gru re tsam dang / 'bras bu rkyal pa can rgas nas nang du 'bru dmar po yod pa khyi dug gi gsang sman yin tshul de nyid yongs grags dang / yang na rang byung rdo rjes g.yu sdong gser mgos gdon tshad sel/zhes pa/ lo ma me tog gi dbyibs stong ri zil ba 'dra rung / me tog ser po sdong po gru bzhi ring la ro kha ba lo sdong bcad 'phro khrag dron nang du bcug pas 'thung la rtser 'dren nus pa skye yul tsher shing za ldum gram gsob phyugs lhas 'gram sogs nges med du skye ba de'o/ /gang ga chung tshab la/ bsil ljongs ri stod du skye ba'i spang rgyan dkar po'i me tog btang ngo / /zi ra dkar nag ngo bo ni bod skyed sngo zi ra dkar nag gis nges so /234

chusnyesrin sder mo'i tshab la/ sngo be'u zhes pa'am sngo chu srin sder mo zhes pa sa rang brag gi ser ga dang khrod du skye ba de'o/ /pa to la'i tshab la/ la skyes kyi khur mang me tog ser po can de'o/ /gser gyi phud bu'i tshab ni/ skyi ba'i 'bras bu ngang pa gser sgong zhes pa de'o/ /g.yer shing pa'i tshab spang rgyan sngon po de'o/ /rgya spos tshab la spang spos kyis nges te/ rgyud las nus pa mtshungs par bshad/mthasdo/ser skud pa'i tshab la thang bal dmar po de nyid btang ba kun stoshu mo za yi tshab ni lug ru dmar po'o/ /bya pho tsi cu'i tshab ni/ zhing skyes sran ma'i me tog go /mda' rgyus kyi tshab ni 'ol mo se'i 'bras bu'o/ /mon lugs su gla rgang ba zhes pa'i tshab ni/ sngo ldum gla sgang bon gyi khri la 'dra zhes pa me tog dmar po bzhad pa de'o/ /rtsa ba gro ma 'dra ba yu la skad du khyi gro phag gro zhes pa de'o/ /gser me'i tshab la se ba'i me tog dgos/khyung sprer dkar spyag gnyis tshab la/ bod kyi sngo ldum khyung sder dkar smug gnyis btang bas ro nus gcig par gsungs/235

yung ba'i tshab la/ kyi lce dkar po ste nus pas dug tshad gag lhog sel/ zhes pa'o/ /gangs jigs tshab la/ srib mtho kha byang du bltas pa'i brag phug mtho la bsil ba dbyar gzhung kha ba mi zhu ba'i phug par dbyar nyi ma mi phog sar brag gi thigs chu gong bur chags pas rdo gzhan dag 'byar ba'i tshi dkar po chags pa de gangs thigs dngos dang nus pa mtshungs pa dang / de yang ma rnyed na sa yi gting nas dam dum byung ba'i rdo dkar po mo cong 'dra ba zos na so mi brtse bar/ chur 'dul na chu dang mi 'dres par bsregs nas chur sbyangs na zho ltar 'gro ba ming lha zho dang dkar po rdo mchog zer ba de'o/ /bse ru'i tshab ni/ kha sha dang sha ba'i bog rwa ste/ bshad rgyud nus rkyang las/ bse rus byang khrog rnag khrag skem/ /zhes so/ /gla rtsi'i tshab ni/ bya rgod spos te/ de yang 'khrungs dbe+e las/ bya rgod spos zhes bya ba ni/ /rdza mtho sa gtsang nyams dgar skye/ /lo ma lcags kyi pa tra 'dra/ /me tog sngon po dbang dang ldan/ /dbyibs ni rgya bya babs pa 'dra/ /bsnam na gla rtsi dri ma bro/ /sngo rgyal rtsi mchog ma gi ta//sman 'di skye sar dug mi skye/ /zhes pa ltar dang 'ga' zhig gis phur nag gi lo ma yang byed ces thos/dom mkhris tshab la/ ldum nag dom mkhres zhes pa de nyid dang /236

dred mong mkhris pa byed pa ste/ de yang sman nus rgyas ston dri med shel gong las/ ldum nag dom mkhris rma gso rtsa kha 'dzin/ /zhes dang / dom mkhris mkhris pa'i mchog yin rtsa kha bsdoms/ /rma gso mkhris sel dug gi nad la phan/ /dred mong mkhris pa de dang nus pa mtshungs/ /zhes dang / 'phyi ba'i mkhris pa yang btang srol 'dug lar ni ri bong mkhris pa ma gtogs/ mi dom gnyis kyi gtsor gyur te g.yung chu gnas sogs mkhris bsdus khaṇ+ḍa grub na mkhris pa'i rang las nad sel zhing dug dang rma gso rtsa kha 'dzin pa sogs nus pa shin tu che zhing gces par bshad/mu tig tshab la nya phyis te bshad rgyud las mu tig klad pa 'dzag gcod dug nad sel/ /nya phyis nus pa mu tig khyad par med/ /ces so/ rtse gsum zhes pa/ ma ru rtse dang / byi tang ka lang thang rtse dang gsum ste/ de yang byi tang ka la/ srin shing snar ma'i 'bras bu gso hrug po de dang / phur smug gi lo 'bras me tog sogs btang / yang na byes ma'i 'bras bu rung ste/ de yang dres ma rigs gsum srin dug sel/'erme pa ltar ro/ /ma ru rtse'i tshab la/ srin bu dmar leb ces grags pa zhig dang /ṭ+wāṃzhakā yang gangs thang khrom gyi 'bras bu dang phur sngon me tog gis rung —sa / / 237

lang thang rtse tshab la rgya thang khrom 'bras bu btang / de ma rnyed na rlung shod skye ba'i thang khrom 'bras bu mar dkar byugs nas mer ser tsam brngos pa rung ngo / /bzang po'i tsha ba gsum zhes pa/ bca' sga'am sga rgod dong gra dang pho ril pi pi ling dang gsum ste/ sga skya'i tshab la(sman sga zhes sga gsum yin)brag skyes dbyi mong dkar po'i me tog dang lo ma/sga srug tshab dbyi mong nag po'i lo ma/bra bra ling tshab me tog lce tsha'am ming gzhan bong bu'i lan tsha dang sbrang bu kha tsha zhes pa de'i 'bras bu'o/ /na le sham mam pho ba ril tshab la rgya shod du skyes pa'i nya srub pa'am/slub ka zhes pa de'i 'bras bu'am rtsa bas byed/ de yang tsha ba gsum po phyogs 'gros kyis skran dang ma zhu me nyams bad kan grang can sman gyi skabs su tsha ba gsum la sngo tsha ba gsum btang ba ma gtogs gzhan ma nu bzhi thang skabs kyi sga skya'i tshab dbyi mong btang ba sogs ni mi 'thad do/ /bse yab tshab la 'ol mo se'i 'bras bu'am/ yang na lcum sdong gi kābra/ sa/ bus 'ong bar bzhed/ lcum ni ro skyur bad kan 'joms/ /zhes 'bras sna gsum zhes pa/ a 'bras sra 'bras/ 'jam 'bras gsum 238

ste/ de yang 'jam 'bras tshab klung skyes kyi nye shing ngam rtsa ba brgya ba zhes pa'i 'bras bu de'o/ /sra 'bras tshab la ra mnye 'bras bu'o/ /a 'bras tshab la/ rgya shod kyi gze ma'i 'bras bu dang ba spru'i 'bras bur sbyar/chu ser sman gsum las/ dang po spos dkar tshab la shug rgan gyi thang chu dang / seng ldang khaṇ+ḍa yang na klung shod du skye ba'i shel ta dang /kyi lce nag po zhes pa'i me tog dang lo ma mnyam por sngo 'chol byas pa de'o/ /so ma ra dza tshab la/ zhing btab so ra thag skud byed pa'i 'bras bu dang / yang na shing tshar ba'i 'bras bu byed/thal ka rdo rje tshab la/ zhing mu la skyes pa'i thal rdor ram/ ldum bu rtsa mig skyes pa de'o/ /shu dag tshab la zhim tig nag po'i rtsa ba'o/ /nim pa'i tshab la/ skyer dkar rtsa ba'i sa lag bshan la phra ba des rung ba yin/go yu'i tshab la klung shod kyi bre ga yin/'u su'i tshab la skyer nag gi 'bras bu dang / srib skyes tshar bong gi 'bras bu rung ba yin/ skru9

so phag gam lha khang jo mo'i tshab la/ rdza gsar nang du longs spyod ma g.yos pa'o/ /ko byi la'i tshab la ldum khrog chung ba'am rgyab skya rkang dmar sog le kha zer ba dang / sha dug wa mo chig thub ces pa brag skya ha bo dang ru rta sogs 'dra byed srol 'dugadangul chu'i tshab la/ skabs 'gar rgya shod kyi rlung 'gram du skye ba'i lo btsan things po dang / klu bdud rdo rje sogs byed srol 'dug kyang bcud len dang gnam lcags zil sbyong skabs su dngul chu dngos las tshab btang ba mi 'thad do/ /mon sman dpa' bo'i tshab la ngar chen gyi bi ṣa nag po bam rul ma song ba'o/ /dug sman su mi'i tshab ni/ re ral gyi khaṇ+ḍa'o/ /dpa' bo dkar ser dang dpa' rgoja tshab la/ la sngo gang rung khyung sder dkar smug ste/ bshad rgyud las/ khyung sder dkar smug dug tshad sel bar byed/ /dpa' bo dkar ser dpa' rgod de bzhin no/ /dgu thub tshab la/ char nyung lo dgu lon pa'i khaṇ+ḍa chog pa gsungs/zhing tsha'i tshab la/ lca rgod kyi rtsa ba lan tshwa'i ro dang ldan pas pho mkhal grang rlung gis nad sel bar byed/stab seng tshab ri shing sbyar ba dkar po dang / sngo spyi zhur gang yang 240

rung ba de'o/ /seng ldeng tshab ni/ skyer dkar bar shun btang /mkhal zho'i tshab ni/ mkhal sran pa'am gla ba sran chung dang / yul skad du a mkhan zla mkhan zhes pa byis pa rnams kyis brgyan phreng bya ba'i mkhal zho 'dra ba de'o/ /gla gor zho sha'i tshab ni/ mtshe ldum gyi 'bras bu dmar po de la'o/ /yang na srad dkar gyis rung ste/ nus bshad las/ gla gor zho shas mcher tshad sel/ /zhes dang / phyi rgyud las srad dkar chig thang mcher tshad dmu chu sel zhes pa ltar/gser bye'i tshab ni sa rong du skye ba'i re ral rgyab kyi ser thig yod pa de mang du bsags pa gser bye'i tshab 'ong bar thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen ngo si tus gsungs/ yang na rgya mcho'i gser ram rgya mtsho nas byung ba'i mgyogs chu bye ma dkar 'od 'tsher ba de'o/ /sdig srin tshab ni/ chu nang gi sbur mgyogs nag po de nyid de/ nus bshad las/ sdig srin chu sbur gnyis kyis chu 'gag sel/ /zhes dang /yang na mi klu dar ya kan nam/ 'bu skyog dung 'dra zhes pa bsil ljongs ri mtho rdo 'bas dang / chu shul sogs las byung ba'i dkar po de nyid dri chur bam pas 'ong bar nges so/ /gzhan 'bu skyog phub 'dra 'khyil pos tshab 'ong bar bayang do/ /24’

ha shig rtsa sbyongs mo rde'u del nad sel/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i ha zhig tshab/ rdo gnyan snag kong bu sogs 'chol lo ba mdog sna tshogs ji byung gis rdo tshugs sogs rung bar nges so/ /mo gel tshab ni/ mo rdel zhes pa ni bud med la rdel nad byung ba blangs pa yin te/ mo del de nyid pho yi rdel nad la bsngags shing / pho rdel blangs pa mo la rdel nad byung ba la shin tu bsngags te/ tshab ni chu klung kha'i rdel 'jam gyis kyang rdel nad sel zhing / chu rdo des dug khrag 'khyag dang mkhal pags grang nad sel zhing de'ang dri chur 'tsho ba'am mer sros nas smad kyi grang gsang du bdug pa yin te/ bdud rtsi snying po las/ gtsang kha'i de'u chu 'gags sel/ /zhes so/ /yang na chu mtshan ring bsrel sman du btang yang rung / zhes so/ /rtsa khu byug pa'am/ ku sha 'du zhes pa'i tshab ni nyi dga'am lcam pa dang dbyi mong dkar po/ khu byug rdzi thog gsum gang rung ngam/ yang na rtsa dres ma'i 'bras bu yang 'ong bar bzhed/bdud rtsi mar khu sgrub pa'i skabs/ sha chenasnyelnga'i tshab tu/ bzang bo drug las/ cu gang dor ba'i lnga yis 'ong bar gsungs/tsan dan mar khu'i skabs/ lhan dan tshab/ shug pa'i kha dog dmar po de mar khur btso ba dang / yang na shog bu'i thog mang du bsags pas babs sla zhing bongs che bar gsungs so/ /242

gsal byed sman mar skabs lcags sbrul dang sngo a wa dngos ma rnyed na/ lcags sprul tshab ni dri med shel gong las/ bya rgod mig gis rgyang gsal grib la phan/ /'es pa ltar ro/ /a wa'i tshab la a 'dra zhes pa sngo ljang gu dar skud 'dra ba brag skyes de nges par yin/ rang byung bas a wa dang ni a 'dra sanyis/ chikyig gi zha rengs sel ba yin/ /zhes sasu ngas pa ltar/phag khrag gi tshab/ ra rog gi gson khrag rul ma so nga bar bsil skam bgyis pa ste/ rje g.yu thog pa'i shog dril du/ ra khrag thang sbyor nad kun byer ba 'dus/ /zhis gsungs pa ltar 'khrul skyon med snyam mo/ /snying rlung skabs/ mi snying tshab la/ bya rgod snying gis dran pa nyams pa gso/ /zhes pa ltar/ bya rgod snying gis 'ong ba yin/gri sha'i tshab la yang rgod sha btang bar snang /lhan thabs lde'u mig las/ rlung gi skabs gsang sman yugs sa'i mngal khrag gces pa dang / rgyu gzer skabs gsang sman bu mo gtsang ma skyes pa dang ma 'phrad pa'i nad med kyi pad mar rak+ta sogs la/ gong bshad ldan pa rang gis sgab rtsa dang long rtsa gang rung gtar khrag gi tshab la btang zhes so/ /rgod g.yag ces pa 'brong gi sha snying dang khrag mkhris tshab la g.yag dar ma sna gling dang rmo bkol sogs ma byas pa'i khyung g.yag lta bus sha 243

snying mkhris khrag bzhis 'ong bar bzhed do/ /rma bya'i sgro yi tshab la/ bya wang gi mjug sgros 'ong ste de nyid li sder du shel rtas bsregs pa ra gsungs/ gzhan yang rma bya'i sha mkhris tshab kyang bya wang gis 'ong bar bshad/ de min mon yul du bya tshe bya zhes pa de bas ldan par gsungs so/ /yang byis pa kha long skabs rma bya'i sgro tshab skya ka'i sgros kyang byed srol 'dugaso bya'i sha sgro'i tshab ni chu bya skyar mo'am ngur khra zhes pa gtsug sgro yod med gnyis po de dag gis byed par gsungs/la phug tshab la khang thog skyes sam/ ming gzhan dar ya kan dang khang phug pa zhes pa gnyis nus mtshungs pas rung /ma nu dang ru rta gnyis po mtshungs te/ rang byung bas/ ma nu ru rta 'du ba snyoms/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'u su dang shu ti dkar po gnyis nus pa mtshungs/gser me dang gur tig kyang tha mi dad pa yin gsungs/ za rgod dang za g.yung gnyis kyang mthun/gar nag tshab byang bltas phur nag nus ldan bsregs pas nges/yang na sgro dkar kyi lce de ba shing sngon bzhi nus ldan bsregs thal tshab byed pa yang 'dugamon cha ra'i tshab ni/ li ga dur dang tsher nag gi 'bras bu gang 2slo

bde byed srol 'dugad trog tshab ni na ram pa yin/smag gi tshab ni ston steng bskos pa'i gro skam lo 'don dang / gla sgang ba'i rtsa ba dang 'brug rus bzang po rnams byed srol 'dugatil gyi tshab la/ zhim thig le'am mig sman sangs rgyas skyabs zhes pa'i 'bras bus 'ong bar gsungs/rgya tshwa bzo ba dang tshab gnyis las/ tshab ni ze tshwa dkar po lhad ṭ+wāṃkā tram̐/sa 'ong ste/ rgyud las ze tshwas rdo 'ju rde'u rdo skran bshigs zhes rgyam tshu'i tshab byang tshwa dkar pos rung ste/ de yang rang byung bas/byang tshwa lhad med rgyam tshwar mtshungs/ zhes dang de yang ma rnyed na/ lan tshwa sho khrig ma yun du brngos pa chang du phab pas 'ong bar bshad do/ /kha ru tshwa bzo ba ni byang tshwa srang gsum dang byang bul srang bzhi bsre la gna' ru gsog hrag tsam bsregs pa srang drug gi phye ma bcas zhib par btags la/ tsha la zho gang gi chus sbrus la lug ril tsam du bsgril la skam nas kong bur sol mer bzhus pa snod gzhan du byos la grub bo/ /rtsabs ru tshwa'i tshab bzo ba ni byang tshwa slad med sngo la dwangs pa cha lnga dang / tsha la chu ma bcad pa cha gsum dang / rgya tshwa dang / ze tshwa/ mtshur dkar slad med gsum cha phyed re bcas zhib par btags la chang gis 245

sbrus nas mtheb kyu 'dra bar byas te skam nas kong bur sol mes bzhus la dkrugs 'dres byas pas grub bo/ /ra tshu tshab bzo ba'i thabs ni g.yag rgod ces pa byang 'brong gi rwa dang / de yang ma 'dzom na g.yag thug rmo bkol ma byas pa'i rwa dang /gna' ba ra lug glang sogs thug po'i rwa me la dud tshig gis ser por btang ba'i phye ma cha mnyam phyogs bsdoms dang / byang tshwa dang rwa nang gi tshwa bcas zhib tu btags la/ ba chu brgyad 'gyur gyi chur bskol la rgya tshwa dang bul tog tshwa la gsum kha tshar cung zad btab la bskol tshad lag bcang chang rjes dod tsam red dus gna' ru srab mo'i nang du dam par brdzangs la du ba thub pa 'dams kyi kha bcad la bong me cher 'bar zhing nang du zhag gcig bcug la phyi ru thal bar gyur nas nang gi rwa snying 'dra ba rwa bro can/ grang nas bton pas grub bo/ /ba tshwa tshab ni kha byang gtad char mi phog pa'i phug pa dang / yang na khang thog rtseg can gyi 'og nyi char mi phog pa'i sar rang bzhin gyi ka ra gong bur 'dril ba lta byung na rab/ ma byung sa la 'od 'tsher rnams bsdus nas dwangs sel byas nas bskol pa'i dwangs ma der grub bo/ /thal tshu tshab bzo ba ni shing be dang seng ldeng sbyar ba'i shun pa sogs tsher ma can gyi shing rnams bsregs thal dkar po des gla ba'i sle'u nang brdzangs la rkang stegs khar bzhag pa'i kha nas chu grang gis ma 246

'khrug par bran cing / zhabs su 'dzag snod bzed pa'i rgya tshwa ro mngar dang ldan pa mar nag khu ba ltar 'bab pa khaṇ+ḍa la bsdus nas skam pas grub bo/ /yang na thang shing sdong rul bsreg thal gong bzhin byas pas 'bab pa che ba dang ro tshur 'gyur/mtshal tshwa'am bdud rtsi da chu zhes pa'i tshwa bzo thabs ni/ ze tshwa lhad med shel 'dra srang gsum dang / tsha la bzang po chu bcad srang gang /rgya mtshal 'dul ma zho gang dang / dngul chu ba chu'i bshig pa zho gang bcas dkrug cing bskol la gar sla zho tsam gyur nas grang bcug pa'i zhun chags ni bdud rtsi chu zhes mig sman la sogs skabs thob ste/ de yang rin chen da chu mtshal dang ma nor ba bcas so/ /ni gu tsā zhes pa'i bzo thabs la/ mtsho tshwa lhad med gru bzhi srang do/ze tshwa srang gang de gnyis bsres te rang nub kyi ba chur gdus pa'i khaṇ+ḍa la na gu tshwa zhes pa 'grub/brag ban nam ni la thod ṭha 'am sag ram rtsi zhes tsha la ming gsum zhes pa/ da tshur dang / dar sman mtsho las byung ba shel ta mchog bzo thabs ni/ rgya tsha srang gang dang / shel tshur zho lnga tsha la zho gang dang /zangs 'jam rug ma zhib brdar phye ma srang gang bsres pa rnams chang bzang po dang dar ba mnyam pa rang nub tsam bran cing bsres la dkar yol nang du zhag gsum ring sri yang ku'i sngo brlon kha khebs bya la 247

bsil skam bgyis nas bltas pas rgyug la ma zhu na slar yang brlan phab dkrug bsnyal bas yang skam bskyar bas mthing sngon tsha chur g.ya' bro ldan par 'grub pa de'o/ /zhing kyan bzo thabs dang tshab gnyis las/ bzo thabs ni sgog rigs gdus pa'i khaṇ+ḍa dang / gna' klad bcas gar sla zho tsam gyi nang du shing kun dngos spod btab nas dkrug rdza'am rwa'i snod du spug la kha gdags dri mi bro bar byas pa'i me nyir bsro la rim pas skam phye blangs pas shing kun bzang por 'grub pa'i lag len yin/sbyong byed rnams kyis skabs su thi khaṇ+ḍa tshab ni/ thar nu'i khaṇ+ḍa 'ong ba gsung / de la dug 'don rjes la/ khu ba ma 'tshig par khaṇ+ḍa gdus pas 'jam zhing rno la bshal byed kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /dur byid tshab ni/ thar chung zhes pa ri smad spang ljongs su skye ba'i rtsa ba rkang ring bshan pa de nyid phyi shun nang rkang gi dug dor la ba 'or khu ba rang thim bya ba'am/ yang na yos su brngos nas dug thon bya bas 'ong /dan da'i tshab ni sngon byon sman pa rnams kyis sngon bu khron bu sogs ngos 'dzin lugs zhal 'tsho min mdzad pa'i rtsa la phug ces pa dang / yung ma bsrel ba lta bu de nyid kyi 'bras bu zur gsum smin nas nang du dan da'i dbyibs ji lta ba zhib mor 'byung ba de nyid do/ /yang 248

de'i rtsa ba yung rdog 'dra ba brko ba'i brlon pa dag btsos tsam gyis dug phral byas la mkhris pa sogs sbyong byed rtso la 'jam par mthong ba brgyud pa yod skad do/ /zhog thing gi tshab re lcags kyis rtsa ba phyi lpags nang snying dor ba'i bar gyi sha shog bu 'chol lo ba de nyid mar dkar byugs nas yos brngos pa btang ngo / /yang na khu ba bton la bsig ma dor nas khaṇ+ḍa gdus pas nges so/ /byang ba'i tshab la/ byi'u khug rta zhes pa glo dkar mjug ma rtse gnyis can 'phur rtsal mgyogs pa'i 'dzum dang ldan pa de'i brun gyis tshab 'ong ste/ de'ang rang byung zhabs kyis/ 'bu sdig can byang ba bsad pa las/ /byi'u khug rta'i brun nyid btang ba legs/ /zhes dang /de'u dmar shel phreng las/ khug rta'i brun gyis rtsa sbyong dmar bshal 'joms/ /zhis gsungs/rgas gso bcud len ro tsa sogs kyi skabs byang sems dkar ci dmar gyi tshab ni/ cong zhi rigs lnga las/ 'dus pa sel ba'i ma ning tshil bu ste/ bcud len rnams kyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /nge bzhin dkar dmar ser la sna ring mnyen/ /pho mo gnyis kas bsten byas na/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i nus pa yod/ /ces de yang cong zhi khram khrum brdung la/ chu khol la btso la sa dreg bshal ba'i khu ba dor nas/ slar 'o ma nyis 249

'gyur la btso zhing khu ba rang thags byas la bcud len gyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /zag zhun tshab ni/ brag zhun la rigs lnga las de yang snying po bsdus pa ra/ sos ka'i tsha bas gdung brag la/ /gser sogs 'byung khungs drug gi bcud/ /rgya skyegs khu ba ltar 'dzag gang / /de ni brag zhun zhes byar bshad ces dang / mi rnams brag las ma rnyed kyang / a ra dang bya ma byi'u sogs rtsal gyis zos pa'i brun der sman pas khaṇ+ḍa byas pa de tshab tu 'byung ba yin/go dzha'am da byid ces pa'i tshab la/ ra mo shag dgun stod sha ba ma zhugs gong bkog pa khengs sad bam rul ma song ba skam legs la/ rgya nag skad du/ ran sān zer te/ de nyid rigs bzang gzhon nu ma bu thog gcig pas nu zhor bskol lan gsum byas pas bcud len gyi mchog yin la/ seng ge'i rtsal dang nus pa mnyam par bshad do/ /gtar ga'i sad mda' tshab la/ chu rdo bsil rmos lcags sogs kyi dugs kyis gtar bas nyes chung 'phral zug gcog pa yin no/ /me btsa'i sad mda' tshab la/ 'ba' cha'am yang na snum ldan phying ba mer bsros dugs kyi rlung gzer dang mkhal sgang 'joms/ de min srin can mer bsregs pa tsha chu brlan pa'i phying pa nang bstem pa sogs kyi dugs kyis rlung gzer dang mkhal grang 'joms shing 'phrod na me 250

yis bsregs pa brtan par byed do/ /chu lums bya thabs tshab ni/ nyin phyogs sa gtsang gi chu mig /ba shar du lta ba dgun mi khengs pa'i chu blang / de yang chu tshan 'byung ba'i rgyu ni rdo sol yin pa'i phyir/ rdo sol ci mang btab pa spyi'i chu tshan yin zhing /de la cong zhi phye ma mang po bsregs nas bsres pas tsha ba nad rnams sel ba'i mchog dang / mu zi ser po btab nas bskol bas grang ba'i chu ser mtha' dag sel la/ de la'ang cung zad rtsub pas rlung la gnod/brag zhun gyi phye ma btab pas bsil drod snyoms shing 'dus pa'i nad la phan cing / cong zhi mu zi gnyis btab tsha bar sos pas/ grang ba kha rkyang gi nad rnams gting nas bsro ba dang / mu zi brag zhun ldong ros gsum po btab nas bskol bas/ chu ser gyi nad rigs ma lus pa drungs nas 'byin par byed pa'i mchog go /251

skabs gsum pa/ sman smyor gyi nus pa dang sgos kyi lag len/kobyi bdun pa/ngan khrag stod du rgyas pa'i nad rigs dang / /dbugs 'thum dbugs 'khril nad chen stod brgyangs dang / /'gram 'khrugs rlung gis bus pa'i nad la bsngags/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉kol bcu gcigako la bcu gcig mcher nad thams cad sel/ /(zin )ga mdzes rgyan bdud ji'i sman mdzod las/kyiklu bdud bco brgyad/klu bdud bco brgyad chu skom tsha bos dbul/ /mdze nad g.yan pa glang shu dreg nad dang / /za rkong phol 'bras gnyan srin ya ma sogs/ /chu ser tsha ba'i nad rigs yin no cog /khyad par thig nag 'bam dang grum bu 'joms/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉dkar po drug spyor/ma zhu ba dang mig la skya rib byung / /me drod nyams dang bad kan smug po la/ /thengs pas chog pa'i sman mchog rgyal po'o/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)252

ji ru nyer lnga/ka ra sbyar ba'i skyu ru nyer lnga 'di/ /khrag shed ma lus gcog pa'i spyi sman yin/ /gtar dgos gtar mi rung la sman 'di bsten/ /phan yon brjod 'das bye brag kha bsgyur mtshungs/ /spyi yi phan yon mdo tsam brjod pa ni/ /stod gzer khrag 'khrugs tsha ba stod rgyas dang / /smug po khrag rgyas mchin dri ro stod rgyas/ /brang tsha chu skyur mkhris pa rgya bshal dang / /khrag rul dud khu skyugs dang pho mchin na/ /ro rgyab rtsib gzer khrag mkhris pho bar lhung / /smug po rgyas gab 'khrugs dang gnas zhen dang / /byer 'thab rnying sogs 'dus nad smug po'i rigs/ /'joms pa'i mchog yin khyad par kha bsgyur bcas/ /skyu ru'i 'phrul 'khor rig pas bskor shes na/ /mi sel 'chi ba'i dus la babs las med/ /skyer rāṭ+wāṃ naṭ+wāṃ sdu rno ༵/ rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)chu btsag rjes la chu kha tsha tshag byed/ /sa bon khrag bsdongs 'dzag pa'i gnyen po ste/ /khrag mkhris las gyur tsha 'dzag kun sel gsungs/ /sdushā ṭ+wāṃg/ mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉chu ser mdze nad bco brgyad 'joms pa'i mchog /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)

khyung sngon dgu ba/'khrugs rims gnyan tshad spyi dang khyad par du/ /glo cham gre bar babs pa'i bdud rtsi yin/ /gnyan la sro lo 'phri zhing cu gang bsdebs/ /'di yang sngon rabs mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes lags/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉khrag gachod gur gum brgyad pa/smug po gyen du rdol lam thur du ral/ /rtsa chen mtshon gyis bcad dam sna khrag rdol/ /khrag shor ma lus gcod pa'i man ngag yin/ /(sman sbyor gyi nus pa phyogs bsdus phan bde'i legs bshad las/)mkhris ze bdun pa/rgyu long bsnad 'grams khrag mkhris tsha 'khru gcod/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/〉gar nag bcu ba/rlung dang ma zhu bad skran la sogs pa/ /gzhan dbang ldan pa'i mkhris kun 'di yis sel/ /gzhan las khyad 'phags man ngag lag len zab/ /khyad par grang mkhris 'joms pa'i sman mchog yin/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud ji'i sman 'dzod las/)gi wang dgu ba/mchin pa bsnad 'grams mchin khrag rgyas pa dang / /mchin tshad bad kan smug po rgyas pa sel/ / (gso rig rgyud bzhi las/)254

gur gum bcu gsum/gur gum bcu gsu ma mchin rgud sbyar dug dang / /mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri tsha sbos dang / /ya ma nag po'i srin nad sel bar byed/ /gur gum mchog bdun/ (gso ris sto da ba'i la sa kyigur gum mchog bdun mchin nad gsar rnying dang / /mchin pa bsnad 'grams khrag rgyas mig ser sel /grang sbyor/ (gso rig rgyud bzhi las /)nam mkha'i thog gis kun 'joms ltar/ /dug so gas nad rnams ma lus sel/ /rlung dang grang ba ma gtogs pa'i/ /rims 'khrugs tshad pa rnying pa sogs/ /nad rnams ma lus kun la phan/ /rims sogs rgyu gzer rnams la shis/ /nad med mi la btang bas ni/ /rgas dang rgud pa sel bar byed/ /skra dkar gnyer ma med pa dang / /skra dang sma ra snum zhing mnyen/ /rus pa rdo rje lta bur 'gyur/ /'go ba'i nad rnams 'byung mi 'gyur/ /dug dang kha zas ma 'phrod pa/ /btsan dug dang ni sbyar dug rnams/ /gnod par byed pa zhi bar 'gyur/ /bgegs dang gdon ni ma lus 'joms/ /gtso 'khor sman sna brgya phrag dang / /phab rgyun thabs shes dang sbyar pa'i/ /zab khyad rin chen ril nag 'di/ /yungs 255

'bru tsam zhig sems can rnams/ /sus myong mkha' spyod 'grub par 'gyur/ /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi 'grel chen gyi cha lag sman spyor lag len nyer mkho phyoṭa bsgriṭa las/〉sprub thob ril dkar/phyi nang phal che'i nad la bsngags pa ste/ /khyad par bad khrag nad la mchog tu bshad/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉blo sman skyan dan brtso brgyad/glo tshad gsar rnying kun sel dang ga 'byed/ /glo 'khrugs rims dug tshad pa gsar rnying dang / /glo mang sor zhing glo 'gog dka' ba dang / /lud pa dmar ser dkar nag rnag khrag 'gags/ /byang khog thigs zag gzer nad ma lus sel/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/kyirgyan 'drum bdun pa/glo ba'i nad dang dbugs mi bde ba sel/rgya shā ṭīṭ+wāṃ pa ṅgijo/sa rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉phye ma bu ram rta la bskyon/ /ya ma mo nad tshad gsar rnying / /'grams 'khrugs rims dug tshad rnying sogs/ /stod gzer dbugs sna thung ba dang / /khrag tshabs rked pa rgyu zhabs gzer/ /mngal skyon ma 256

lus sel bar byed/ /(yang tig sman gyi sbyor sde 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len la sa/〉rgyam tshwa drug pa/rgyam tshwa drug pas pho ba'i me drod bskyed/ /kha zas ma zhu 'ju zhing be snabs sbyang / /rgyam shā ṭīṭ+wāṃ kā sdudzi/sa rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)rgyam tshwa bzhi'am cha snyoms bzhi thang grags/ /grang ba kun sel sman ma zhu ba 'joms /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud ji'i sman mdzod las/〉dbyal chu brtso brgyad/ril bu seng ldeng khu bas 'phul la btang / /gza' dang klu sman chu ser dreg grum mdze/ /rtsa nad tshigs babs ma lus sel ba'i mchog /(yang tipy-i /na/ /shā trī 'a/chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len las/〉glo nad glo gzer khrag tu lu ba dang / /gyen la mi pher glo brgyal che ba dang / /ro stod tsha khag cham rgan rus zhen dang / /glo bar tshad pa zhugs pa'i nad rigs sogs/ /mdor na/ byang khog stod kyi tshad pa sel/ /(zin tirga mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/ 25rka

rtsang sna drug pa/bad kan brang tsha chu tshan skyug pa 'joms/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/kyicong zhi nyer gcigabrang tsha chu skyur mkhris pa rgya bshal skyugs/ /pho mchin ro rgyab sbrags shing tshigs pa na/ /khrag mkhris pho bar lhung ngam stod du gzer/ /smug po rgyas dang gab cing 'khrugs pa dang / /rang gzhan gnas su zhen cing rnying pa sogs/ /'dus nad smug po'i rigs kyi sman gcig yin/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud ji'i sman mdzod las/)gcin snyi a ru bco brgyad/mngal khrag thig le zags pa la sogs pa/ /rlung mkhris bad kan za khu nad kyi rigs/ /gcin snyi'i nad la thengs chog myong bas grub/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉'chi med srin sel/mgo srin so srin khong srin dang / /gzhang srin lpags srin la sogs la/ /tsha srin grang srin brtag mi dbos/ /srin gyi grong khyer kun 'joms shing / /mchog tu gnyan srin glang thabs sel/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/)258

mkhris tshad mig ser shati py-idakā~X shātā dī/ 'joms/ /tig ta nyer lnga/ (gso rig rgyud bzhi las/)sel/na/da gzhi snod mkhris las skyes pa'i/ /mkhris nad tsha grang ma lus rta zi dmar shā'/bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/)rims dang tshad pa thams cad dang / /khyad par glo tshad gzer thung sogs/ /cham pa stobs chen ma lus 'joms /thang ༵/ ṭ+wāṃpri maṭ+wāṃ/sa rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉dug dang smug po tshad rnying byer ṅge sdud/ /tsha grang cha snyoms dang ga 'gag pa 'byed/ /rlung mi skye la bad kan mkhris pa sel/ /de phyir thang sbyor kun gyi rgyal por bshad/ /da li bcu dru/'bri gung saso rig gces bsdus las/)ma zhu glang thabs pho ba sbos/ /tsha grang 'thab pa'i nad rnams dang / stod 'tshang bad rlung mgo 'khor dang / /glo yu skad 'gags lus po skrangs/ /skya rbab sa chu ma thub la/ /slebs pas chog pa kho bos ma/thong / /('bri gung laso rig gces bsdus las/)259

da li bco brgyad/spyir na rtsa dkar nad du gyur pa dang / /sgos su yan lag zha sbrid skam pa sogs/ /kun kyang sel byed da li bco brgyad do/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/)dwags po sman nagaphan yon bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /khyad par pho gcong can la shis/ bad kan smug po khrag skyug dang / /rgyu nad rtag tu 'khru ba dang / /sgreg pa mang zhing zas mi 'ju/ /pho ba stong sdeb byed pa dang / /pho log pho ba spu byi dang / /pho sul lcags kyi dreg chags dang / /pho ba dug thabs mchin nad dang / /mchin pa rgyas dang 'phyong ba dang / /mchin chu blugs dang sgreg pa bcas/ /rgyu gzer grol ma dug thabs rigs/ /'gril bcas gru gu bsgong ba dang / /mdor na pho gcong rgyu gcong la/ /sman sbyor 'di las lhag pa med/ /rno ba spu gris gcod dang mtshungs/ /sman nag thugs kyi dkyil du chongs/ /mnyam med dwags po'i dgongs pa yin/ /'gro drug sems can spyi nor lags/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud ji'i sman mdzod las/)bdud rtsi lnga smyor/ro rgyab pho mchin rtsibs khrod gzer ba dang / /dang ga 'asags dang tsā mngal sgyid pa skyur/ /chu skyur chu tshan skyug sogs 'phral du 260

'joms/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/kyibadud rtsi sum smyor/zhib btags gar chang rta la bskyon/ /stod du bad khrag rgyas pa dang / /smad du mchin khrag lhung ba dang / /brang tsha chu skyur skyug pa dang //mgo dang yan lag la sogs kyi/ /rus chag lugs su 'dzud pa dang / /bad mkhris za khu gcod pa'i mchog /('bri gungasaso/ rig gces bsdus las/)bde byed snyoms ldan/bange byed snyoms ldan zhes bya'i sman mchog ni/ /bad kan skya smug la sogs bad kan rigs/ /k+ṣa ya mig ser la sogs mkhris pa'i rigs//nyen dang lcags dreg ma zhu ba rnams dang / /dug ro la sogs pho ba mchin pa'i nad/ /smug po gab 'gying chu ser lpags nad rigs/ /za 'phrug skyigs bu la sogs gong bshad nad/ /phyi yi nang rnams sbrul lpags bshus pa ltar/ /nang gi nad rnams ba mor nyi shar 'dra/ /kun la phan pa'i sman mchog dam pa yin/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod la sa/〉nor zu bdumacithangasnye bsdus grang thang gis khrag rlung 'khrugs gsum la/ / chu dwangs nor 26ga

byā ༵ra ste/nga/ bzhag pa bzhin/ /nad rnams ma lus rang sar dwangs par byutsu (zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)spang rgyan bco lnga/glo nad gre bar gab dang mig mi gsal/ /bad kan stod rgyas mid 'chus sel bar byed/ /shin tu phan par dka' na cong zhi ni/ /khram khrum brdung ba chang du sbangs pas dbul/ 'di ni khyung po'i shog dril nag po'i lugs /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/)spang rtsi bcu gnyis/gnyan tshad ma lus gsod par byed pa'i mchog /rims nad stobs chen 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉smyos dkar bcu ba/dres grum chu ser ko ler tsha 'khyug 'joms/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/kyiphag mo grub pakyibur dalar rta la bskyon/ pa'i phye mas/ /lten dang lcags dregs skran dang ma zhu/ /duka ro 'a sosas pho mchin nad gzhi/ /ma lus ba mor nyi ma phog bzhin/ /sel byed man ngag kun gyi yang snying / /khyad par stobs 26 2

'phel lus mdangs rgyas shing / /dbang brtan rgas sra bcud len mchog yin/ /bdud rtsi chang gi gnyen po 'di nyid/ /bag med 'thung yang 'di nyid thun res/ /mod la 'ju zhing myos par mi 'gyur/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/)phan pa kun ldan/mchin mcher las byung don glang dang / /gnyan glang dang ni srin glang dang / /phyi nang rtsa yi glang thabs sogs/ /kun la lto ru dros tsam gyis/ /zug gzer 'joms pa the tshom med/ /za zi chal chol skyon langs na/ /mar gsar sdor ldan thug pa btang / /pho nad tsha grang ma lus 'joms/ /bhi ma la/('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/)khyad par snying rlung bcos thabs ni/ /rtags ni snying mi dga' ba dang / /shes pa 'phyo dang blo 'tshub dang / /ro stod rgyab mdun gzer zhing 'thams/ /dran pa mi gsal brjed ngas che/ /yid mug ga chad sdod mi tshugs/ /zhe sdang bying rgod dbugs sna thung / /tshabs chen brgyal dang sna tshogs nad/ /'byung phyir sman gyi gso thabs bstan/ /dgong dang tho rangs nan tan bya/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉263

bong khrag nyer lnga/gung gnyis seng ldeng khu bas phul ba btang / /se 'bru lnga dang nang nub ltag pa sprad/ /dwangs ma gnas 'jog chu ser rtsa ba skem/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/kyibya khyung bcu gsum/bya khyung bcu gsum pa ni rtsa dkar nad/ /gza' dang mdze nad bcos rdugs gnyen po mchog /(gso rig gces bsdus snying nor/〉byi tang bdun pa/bur dkar sbyar pa'i byi tang bdun pa ste/ /pho long srin nad gzhang 'brum ma lus sel/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/〉byur dmar nyer lnga/byur dmar nyer lngas mgo yi nang rtsa'i nad/ /rtsa dkar klad gzer mgo 'khor gnya' rengs dang / /ltag pa dgye gug brgyal 'thibs ma lus sel/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi 'grel chen gyi cha laṭ+wāṃ /nakhyu /dro la/ga len nyer mkho phyoṭa bsgriṭa las/〉brag khyung zhes grags snod kyi khrag mkhris dang / /pho log gnyan sriṭ+wāṃsdu zer rigs gang yin yang / /pho bar babs pa'i bdud rtsir gyur

pa yin/ /(zim tig mdzes rgyaca 4(dartsi'i sman mdzod las/〉zas zhun be+egu ba pho ba'i khrag mkhris tshad pa sal bar bya—she /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/〉blonari—ོ sum sbor/blon po sum sbyor byis pa'i tshad nadasel/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/〉dbang ril nyer lnga/phan yon dus nad gsar rnying dang / /tshad pa rnying ba rnams la ni//sdud dang gsod dang 'joms par byed/ /'di las zab pa gzhan na med/ /dug rigs spyi dang khyad par du/ /smug po dug 'thab gso dka' la/ /rgyun ring bsten na phan pa cher/ /mkhas dbang rnams kyis myong grub gsungs/ /(zin tig mdzes tren bdud rtsi'i sman sna dzid las/〉'bras bu sum zang /'bras gsum thang gis rims 'khrugs tsha ba'i nad/ /spre sar rnying ma lus sel zhing smin par byed/ /(gso rig gces bsdus snying nor las/〉265

ma nu bzhi thang rims tsha/ ṭ+wāṃrno ṭ+wāṃtrī ༵/da/ /bad kan skya smug stong tshad khrag gzer sel / /go byi rdog gcig bsnan na stod 'tshangs sel/ /mang smyo ra/(gso rig gces bsdus snying nor las/〉sbyar dug gyur dug rang bzhin dngos kyi dug /mthong reg nyi zer kha rlangs la sogs pa'i/ /sa steng dug gi nad rigs yod do cog /ma lus drung 'byin sman gyi rgyal po ste/ /gab tshad tshad rnying gting 'don man ngag mchog /shin tu bcos brdugs nad kyi rtsa ba 'byin/ /rin chen mang sbyor zhes bya bla na med/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi'i 'grekā ༷na tram̐ shā pakā ṭ+wāṃn /shā /lag len nyer mkho phyoṭa bsgriṭa/〉man ngag bsi la sbyor zhes bya'i sman mchog 'dis/ /dug smug mkhris pa mchin par zhen pa dang / /gab tshad tshad rnying rtsi ltar zhen pa dang / /'khrugs dang khrag rlung stod du 'tshang ba dang / /mdor na mchin myostocher yan gyi bad khrag sogs/ /'di ni stod nad kun la thengs mchog yim/ /gnad kyi gdams pa bla ma'i 6/la lasnrisdu/ / r+ṣamu tig bdun cu/ (rat+na ༵kābye ༵ ṭ+wāṃdī /bye ga sa bsdus las/)rin chen sman gyi sbyor ba khyad par can/ /'di yi phan yon brjod 266

kyis mi lang yang / /mdor bsdus tsha grang 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i nad/ /yun ring gso dka' sman pas bor ba dang / /khyad par rtsa dkar rengs 'khums 'khrugs pa 'joms/ /byer ba bsdu zhing rnying ba gting nas 'don/ /mkhal tshad rtsa 'gram khrag rlung gzer mda' gcog /steng gdon gza' dang bar gdon rgyal po btsan/ /'og gdon klu yi rigs rnams thams cad sel/ /rma rnying sur+ya rkang 'bam zha 'khums sogs/ /phyi nang phal cher nad la bsngags pa ste/ /mgul du 'chang na srung ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /dri tshor tsam gyis gdon bgegs 'byung po 'bros/ /de phyir bsam 'phel yid bzhin rin po che/ /sman gyi nor bu rgyun shes sman pa'i lugs/ /gso rig rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ste/ /drang srong 'tsho thabs shes pa'i snying nor yin/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi'i 'grel chen cha ༷/ // //rngo ༵ le/na nyer mkho phyoṭa bsgriṭa las/)mu tig nyer lnga snyoms patrī rtsa nad kyis/ /khrag gi rgyu ba nyams gso zungs khrag 'dren/ /kha mig skyog cing mgo 'khor dran pa nyams/ /kha lkugs sems 'chol gnyid chung skyugs pa shor/ /gzhogs gcig tshor ba med la skrangs sam skam/ /btsog gcin shor ram yang na gnyis ka bkag /chu rgyus rengs 'khums rtsa dkar nad la phan/ /(sman sbyor phyogs bsdus las/) 267

tsan dan brgyad pa/ka ra sbyar bas glo tshad rnag khrag sel/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las )gtso po brgyad pa/ka ra dkar po bzhi 'gyur rta la bskyon/ /don snod glo mchin khrag mkhris 'khrugs rims dang / /tshad pa gsar rnying ma lus sel bar byed/ /༵py-i ṭ+wāṃg/ mdzes rgyan bdud ji'i sman mdzod las/〉rin chen btso bkru zla shel chen mo 'dis/ /'dus nad smug po yun ring lon pa'i nad/ /brang tsha pho mchin ro rgyab tshigs pa na/ /smug po rgyas dang gab cing 'khrugs pa dang / /kha zas zos rjes ma zhu na zug che/ /'ju stobs chung la sgreg skyug yang na bshal/ /pho mchin tsha la mkhris pa rgya bshal dang / /khrag rul dud khu skyugs sam bshal ba dang //glang thabs srin nad chu ser khong skran dang / /zas dug la sogs khong nad rnying pa'i rigs/ /gab tshad tshad rnying 'grams 'khrugs 'thab pa dang / /skya rbab 'or dang ldan 'dus nad la bsngags/ /(man ngag bye ba ring bsrel las/〉rtsa thag bcu drugarlig pa skrangs pa rang zhir dag la 'gro/ /smad nad mkhal rtsa 268

'grams dang mkhal rlung sogs/ /ma lus sel byed gdams ngag snying nor ro/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)dzārti bcu bzhi/rus bcud gsum mam(sog yu/ tshang gzhug sre long)bcu bzhi'i(sha mar/ bu ram/ sgog skya/)khu bas 'phul/ /stod smad phyi nang rlung kun 'di yis 'joms/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/kyizhi byed bcu gcigazhi byed bcu gcig skye zug gceg pa dang / /mo nad khrag skran 'dril ba bshig par byed/ /khyad par btsas rjes srin glang 'dril ro la//'di las lhag pa'i gdams pa gzhan na med/ /(sman gyi sbyor dpe bdud rtsi'i bum bzang las)zhi byed drug pa/phan yon ma zhu gsar rnying dang / /dug dang pho ba'i me drod nyams//gyen log bu dang sha ma thogs/ /long srin rigs lnga smad rlung 'joms/ /dri ma skam pa brlan par byed/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉zhi byed nyer dgu/mkhal nad grang nad rgyu nad dug nad dang / /ma zhu'i rigs dang 269

pho long mchin gzer dang / /mngal nad chu ser rtsa mig 'grams pa dang / /zas skran grang skran mkhris skran rlung skran sel/ /(mtsho sngon bod sman tshad gzhi las/kyizangs thal nyer lnga/chu bskol gyis 'phul srod kyi dus su bsten/ /'di yi phan yon glo rnag gsar rnying dang / /dreg grum chu ser nag po mdze la sogs/ /khyad par dmu 'or skya rbab nad la bsngags/ /gdams pa 'di ni dwags po sman pa'i lugs/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉bla zhel chen mo/zur lugs zla shel chen mo'i sbyor ba 'di/ /nad gzhi bstun te rang rang sman rtas 'phul/ /dug dang smug po khrag tu 'khru skyug dang / /gab tshad tshad rnying 'grams 'khrugs 'thab pa dang / /ma zhu glang thabs srid dang chu ser skran/ /ldan 'dus nad rnams 'joms pa'i rdo rje yin/ /(sman sbyor gyi nus pa phyogs bsdus phan bde'i legs bshad las/〉bla zhel bdud rtsi ma/lcags phye bdun pa bzi med cung zad bsil/ /mchin nad dug thabs mig dmar mchin steng gzer/ /pho mchin gang snyam 'ju dka' zos che na/ /brang tsha khrag skyug btsog pa skam pa dang / /rkang bol gdong 270

skrangs pho mchin sprags nas na/ /yang na sha skam pags mdog ser nag chags/ /mig mi gsal dang lus zungs gso bar byed/ /(sman sbyor phyogs bsdus las/〉'ol se nyer lnga/mo nad khrag tshabs rlung tshabs srin tshabs dang / /sked pa rkang dang rus tshigs khol zhing na/ /rgyu zhabs mchin mkhris ro stod 'khor zhing na/ /lhag par ro stod khrag mig khol ba dang / /snying srog ro stod gzer 'khyim rna ba 'on/ /'dom skrangs tshang ra rgyu zhabs mtshan ma gzer/ /rkang bol yan chad rus pa khol zhing na/ /kun sel 'dzam gling man ngag nor phyed grags/ /(zin teg mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)g.yu rnying nyer lnga/tshad ldan ril bu bskol grang phul ba yis/ /leb rgan rgyas dang ldem bu dug thabs dang / /chu shor rkun bu 'or lhung kha lud dang / /gzhung rengs mchin grum nag po hal skems dang / /mchin dri dkar nag gnad mchin rtsa byer 'joms/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi'i 'grel chen gyi cha lag sman sbyor lag len nyer mkho phyoṭa bsgriṭa las/〉g.yu dril bcu gsum/g.yu dril bcu gsum smug po'i spyi sman yin/ /khyad par tsha grang 271

'thab pa'i gnyen po ste/ /'di ni bar sman rgyal po'i sbyor ba yin/('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉ru rta drug pa/ru rta drug pa smug po 'thab pa'i nad/ /glang thabs sgreg skyug pho khar zug pa sel/ /lizhi drug pa/ (gso rig rgyud bani las/〉li shi drug pa lo brgyad dri chus 'phul/ /glo nad gre ba tsha skam skad 'gags sel/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉lug mur bdun pa/so/ /cham pa'i gzhug gi glo brgyal la/ /sman thun gsum las mi dgos (zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud ji'i sman mdzod las/〉zhing kun nyer lnga/shing kun gtsor byas nyer lngas phyi rlung sel/ /sha chen('byong snying)gtsor byas nyer lngas nang rlung sel/ /li shi gtsor byas nyer lngas gsang rlung sel/ /'don bzhi'i(dkar 'don/ dmar 'don/ skyur 'don/ sgog 'don/)rta la bskyon nas tho rangs btang / /sha pags rtsa rus zhugs pa phyi yi rlung / /don lnga snod drug la zhugs nang gi rlung / /272

srog tu 'dzin pa la sogs(rlung srog 'dzin/ rlung thur sel/ rlung me mnyam/ rlung gyen rgyu/ rlung khyab byed/)gsang ba'i rlung / /stod smad bar gsum zhugs pa'i rlung la sogs/ /rlung rigs sman sbyor gcig gis 'joms par byed/ /sman rgyal gnyis pa g.yu thog mgon po'i lugs/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)zhing mngar drug pa/shing mngar drug pa skyug pa gcod pa'i mchog /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/〉sug smrel bcu ba/mkhal ma'i grang ba rde'u nad chu 'gags sel/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉se 'bya brgyad pa/tshad ldan sbyar ba'i se 'bru brgyad pa 'dis/ /pho mchin stod kyi bad rlung snying skran 'joms/ /se 'dru lnga ba/ (gso rig rgyud bzhi las/〉se 'bru lnga ba bad kan zas mi 'ju/ /pho ba'i grang skran skyug dang yi ga 'chus/ /snying rlung mkhal rked nad la mchog tu phan/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/)273

se 'dru nyer lnga/ma zhu ba dang pho ba'i me drod nyams/ /dwangs ma mkhregs sogs pho nad gcong dang ni/ /grang ba'i nad kun 'joms pa'i me dpung yin/('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉se 'drusnyedwangs gnas/tsha grang 'thab pa'i kha 'dzin me drod gso/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/〉se 'dru pad ma 'dab brgyad/skya smug bad mkhris pho rims ldan 'dus nad/ /khyad par bad kan se~X ṭ+wāṃ'i nad la bsngags/ /mgul 'gags la ni cong zhi nus bsregs ba / / (gso rig gces bsdus snying nor las/)se 'dru bzhi ba/bur dkar sbyar ba'i se 'bru bzhi ba ste/ /pho ba'i gzhi 'dzin me drod gso bar byed/ /nad gzhi ci las gyur kyang dang ga 'byed/ /seng ldeng nyer lnga/ (gso rig rgyud bzhi las/〉zha rengs gza' phog rtsa 'gram rtsa dkar dang / /grum bu chu ser thig nag 'bam gyi gshed/ /drang song rnyarma su mi'i khyad nor lags/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉274

sro lo bzhi thang /glo yi khrag tshad gzer dang lud pa sel/ /(gso rig gces bsdus snying nor/kyisrog 'dzin bcu gcigasmyo lkugs snying srog nu mchin gzer ba 'joms/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)sle tres bdun thang /gdus thang dron mo btang zhing rngul ba dbyung / /de yis ba spu sgo 'byed 'brum pa 'dren/ /(yang tig sman gyi sbyor sde 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len las/〉gle tres sum thang /sel/sle/ tres brag zhun a ru'i thang / /zhag 'ga' bsten pas dreg nad (yang tig sman gyi sbyor sde 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len las/)gser mdog lnga ba/ka ra sbyar ba chu bskol phul/ /ma zhu mig ser mkhris nad dang / //sbyisdo/ pa/ snod lhung sha mdangs ser/ /tsha grang mkhris pa'i nad yul (zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)275

gser mdog bcu gcigagaser mdog bcu gcig ces bya'i sbyor ba 'dis/ /chu bskol phul ba mkhris skran dug thabs dang / /bad mkhris mgo nad pho ba rgyu mar rgyu//khrag mkhris lhung dang snod kyi mkhris skran dang / /ma zhu mig ser khyab par ya ma dang / /tshad pa 'joms shing sha ser mig ser dang / /k+ṣa ya nag po sogs kyi nad rnams la/ /dri bro tsam gyis the tshom mi dgos so/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉gso byed nyi dkyil/gso byed nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya 'dis/ /'phul byed chu bskol tsha mo skabs 'gar chang / /ma zhu skran dang skya rbab 'or dmu chu/ /mkhal ma'i drod shor sa bon nyams 'dzag dang / /chu sri mkhal sked lgang ba chu sor zug /tsha 'khru grang 'khru grang rnyogs grang srin dang / /grang nad kun la dus mtha'i me lta bu/ /khyad par pho ba'i me drod bskyed pa'i mchog /dwangs ma gnas 'jog chu ser tsha ba skem/ /lus zungs brtas byed tshe ring bcud len 'gyur/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉bsam 'phel nor bu/rengs 'khums rtsa la byer rnying dang / /mkhal tshad rtsa tshad rtsa 'grams dang / /sman pas bcos rdugs nad la bsngags/ /drang srong 276

gza' yi nad rnams 'joms/ /mchog tu rtsa nad can la shis/ /sur+ya'i nad rnams ma lus 'byin/ /rgyun shes bu yi bkod pa yin/ /ming yang nor bu bsam 'phel zer /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉bse ru nyer lnga/glo rnag chu ser sel zhing ma lus skem/ /glo ba'i rnag khrag 'dren gyis ma drongs gong / /zad sman 'di nyid mi btang man ngag yin/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/kyiya gar brgyad pa/a gar brgyad pas snying la mtshon phog dang / /'grams 'khrugs smyo lhags nu mchin gzer ba 'joms/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/〉ya gar bco lnga/khrag rlung stod 'tshangs nad la thengs mchog yin/('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉a gar nyi shu/rlung khrag 'thab dang gza' nad rtsa dkar dang / /srog rtsar rlung zhugs smyo lkugs yan lag sbrid/ /rlung bus tsha ba byer sogs nad rigs la/ /man ngag 'di ni bdud rtsi lta bu yin/ /(zin tig mdzes rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/)277

ya gar so lnga/glo skam theng bsun grum bu bar rta dang / /stod tshad smad grang stod smad go log dang / /bla gnyan thor nad gnyen po bcos mi len/ /ma smin stongs tshad mgo 'brel rkun bu'i nad/ /gang la gang 'tshams rta yis bsgyur byas na/ /dman lhag log pa'i nad kun 'byung mi srid/ /gong bshad nad la thengs pa'i chog pa yin/ /(zin tig mdzos rgyan bdud rtsi'i sman mdzod las/〉ya ru bcu ba/mkhal ma bsnad 'grams chu sri rked pa 'khor/ /bshal 'phyes mkhal tshad ma lus sel bar byed/ /('bri gung gso rig gces bsdus las/〉a ru bco brgyad/mkhal rtsa 'grams byer tsha babs smad byer dang / /khrag tshabs rked pa 'khor dang chu ser grum/ /smug po mkhal mar babs rnams sel bar byed/ /(gso rig gces bsdus snying nor las/〉a ru bdun pa/mcher ba bsnad 'grams tsha rgyas sbos gzer 'joms/ /(gso rig rgyud bzhi las/)278

zur bkod/gcig sman smyor las ṭ+wāṃsna ṭ+wāṃ //na rdzas 'dul smyong gi 1 dkar po drug smyor/cong zhi/ co zhi'i ngos la 'byar ba'i rdo rnams bkog nas che chung nas 'bru tsam legs par brdungs rjes chu gtsang gis lan 'gar bkrus te sla nga'i nang brngo zhing der chang nyung tsam blugs te rlangs pa ma shor pa rlangs bsub byed dgos/ yang rgan tshe rnam rin po che'i zhal nas cong zhi nas 'bru tsam brdungs rjes ze tshwa dang rgya gar bong dmar byung na rab dang / ma rnyed na sngo bong dkar gyi phye ma thur mgo gang re'i nang lan gsum la btso zhing / lan rer mtshe ldum du bkru bshal gtsang ma re byas rjes bkol chog gsungs/ gzhan yang dam pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag len gtso bo ni cong zhi nas 'bru tsam zhig brdungs nas chu gtsang gi nang lan gsum btso zhing lan re'i mtshams nas bkru bshal thengs gsum re byas te mthar nas 'bru dgu re snga gzhug ltar brngos te bkad thub pa'i bar du brngo/ de'i steng chang nyung tsam blugs te rlangs pa ma shor bar byas te grang nas bkol chog pa yin/279

bya rgod kyi brun/ thog mar chu'i nang sbangs nas sa rdo sogs mi gtsang ba'i rdzas rnams dor nas nyi mar bskams thag chod rjes sla nga'i nang gla rtsi'i chu'i kha chu btab ste brngos nas bkol chog tsha la/ sla nga'i nang brngos nas chu bcad byed dgos/2 masal bcu gsum/ka ko la dang gser me gnyis kyi skog shun dor dgos pa dang / a ru ra'i rus pa dor dgos/ a ru ra dang ba ru gnyis rus pa gtong dgos pa dmigs bsal rigs ma gtogs spyi la rus pa med pa'i sha kho na btang ba legs/ dug sman la khyad par rus pa btang mi rung /3 skyer kun brgyad pa/skyu ru ra'i rus pa dang shing mngar gyi phyi shun dor dgos/ khyad par dug sman la rus pa 'gro mi rung / chu bzhi'i sman la rus pa gtan nas mi ku'adu ba gal che/4 spya ru nyer lnga/'bras bu gsum gyi rus pa gzhung bzhin dor dgos pa dang / spang rtsi do bo dang sle tres gnyis kyi phyi'i dreg pa rnams dor/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i phyi sdor+sha tram̐/ tsher ma de dor dgos/ brag zhun dang star bu gnyis khaṇ+ḍa byed 5 klu bdud bco brgyad/280

a bar skyur gsum gyi rus pa gzhung bzhin dor la/ sle tres dang seng ldeng gi phyi'i dreg pa dor dargos/ seng ldeng gi khaṇ+ḍa yin zer ba dpyad par 'tshal/6 khrag gcong sga wang bcu gsum/skyu ru'i rus pa dang shing mngar gyi phyi shun dor ba dang / gal te bse ru med na gtsod rwa dkar po dang sha rwa har bsregs kyis tshab byas chog brag zhun khaṇ+ḍa byung na rab yin/7 mkhris las rnam rgyal/gser me ma byung na saser la phud bu dang g.ya' kyi ma gtong ba yin/ gser phud kyi lkog shun dang a ru'i rus pa dor dgos/8 khrag bathig brgyad pa/lce tsha dang dbyi mong srub ka gsum so so du ba ma shor bar nus bsregs byed dgos pa dang / go'u brun la gla rtsi'i chus/ kha phri btab rjes brngo dgos/ rdo thal ni bya rdo sol me'i dkyil du har bsregs byas pa de chang ngam chu bskol drod 'jam gyis bshig nas btang la ma tshos bar til 'bru tsam yang gtong mi rung / ze tshwa sla nga'i nang brngos nasatshag sgra thon na chu bcad pa'i tshad yin/ sbrul sha ni gla rtse'i chang ngam chu'i nang la zhag gcig sbang dgos/9 mkhris ze nyer lnga/281

dom mkhris dngos ma 'dzoms na mkhris pa sna tshogs las bzos pa'i khaṇ+ḍa btang chog pa dang / gser me ma byung na gser phud dang g.ya' kyi mas tshab byas chog re ral gyi spu bzhar nas gtong dgos/ga bur nag po ni phag phrug nu ma ma bsnun pa'i gong gi brun de yin la/de ma 'byor na phag rgod des rdza lung du me tog dang sman rtsa zos pa'i brun de tshab rung ba las za mas gsos pa'i phag gi brun mi rung / brun de nus bsregs byed dgos/ gzhung las mkhris phye nyer lnga ga bur nag po lhag sprod dgos zhes gsungs yod kyang / rang re'i lag len ltar gcig tu bsdebs pa la dpyod 'tshal/1༷ 'khrugs glo kun sel/'bras bu gsum gyi nang rus dor ba dang / spang rtsi do bo sogs rtsa ba rnams kyi phyi'i dreg pa dor dgos/11 mkhris ze bdun pa/dom mkhris kyi tshab la mkhris pa sna tshogs las bzos pa'i khaṇ+ḍa yang rung ngo / /12 go yu brgyad pa/'bras sna gsum dang mkhal ma zho sha rnams ma 'tshig par brngo ṭā//sa/ go yu yang brngos nas drod ma yal bar chang du bsnyal dgos pa 282

13 gur gum bcu gsum/bse ru byung na chu brdar byed dgos pa dang / sha bo'i rwa rgan ni sol me'i dkyil du har bsregs byas nas sbyar chog 'on kyang tshos thag chod pa ste nag po song ba rnams sbyar mi rung / mtshal ni rlangs thon pa tsam brngo dgos pa dang / 'jam 'bras yang phye tshan nang ma 'tshig par brngo dgos pa yin/14 margo thang gsum pa/'brug rus ni chu gtsang gis sa rdul sogs legs par bkrus te gtong dgos/15 gur gum mchog bdun/rgya tig rkyang ba btang na ro shin tu kha ba'i phyir rgya tig dang bod tig bsres te btang na ha cang legs so/ /16 rgyan 'drum bdun pa/shing mngar gyi phyi shun dor dgos pa las gzhan 'dul sbyong byed dgos pa med/17 gar nag bcu ba/dom mkhris kyi tshab tu mkhris pa sna tshogs las bzos pa'i khaṇ+ḍa chog la tshad ni phyed tsam dang / phag brun nus ldan bsregs pa'i thal ba dgos so/ /283

18 ga bur nyer lnga/sa bur ni rang nyid kyi tshad gzhi dngos dang bstun na nus pa rtsub tu 'gro bas cu gang rgya ma gang tsam gyi phye ma'i nang ga bur srang gsum tsam bsdebs nas bsres 'phur legs po byas te cu gang dang ga bur gnyis 'dres ma'i srang gsum gtong dgos/ rdo dreg ni bkru bshal gtsang mar byas rjes gla rtsi'i chu'i kha phru btab nas brngo dgos/19 gi wang dgu ba/tig ta ni rgya tig bod tig 'dres par gtong ba dang / brag zhun khaṇ+ḍa byung na rab yin/2༷ mu tig nyer lnga/mu tig ni g.yu byur ltar tsha la dang ze tshwa/ star bu'i khaṇ+ḍa/ be ljang re ral/ sdum bu re ral/ a ru/ gla rtsi/ mgron bu/ lo brgyad dri chu gang ga chung bcas kyi khu ba'i nang 'dul dgos pa dang / ar nag g.yag khrag dron mo'i nang 'dul dgos/ bse ru chu brdar byas nas bshig pa dang sha bo'i rwa rgan pa dang mnyam du bsres nas bsdeb chog sdig srin dkar nag gang rung gla rtsi'i chu la zhag gcig sbangs nas dug 'don byed pa dang / 'bri ta sa 'dzin ni cis kyang khaṇ+ḍa byung na rab yin/21 thang chen nyer lnga/gser me'i tshab tu gser la phud bu rung la tshad ni gser me'i 2tshi

phyed ma gtogs sdeb mi rung / phag khrag gi 'dul sbyong las snon gzhung gang nas kyang ma mthong bas khrag skam nas sbyar chog22 ya gar brgyad pa/ar nag ni g.yag khrag gi nang du 'dul dgos pa dang / gal te khrag dron ma 'byor na sha khu yi nang du gdus nas gtong dgos/ a ru'i rus pa 'don dgos/23 bde byed snyoms ldan/cong zhi nas 'bru tsam brdungs nas bong dmar gyi nang btsos rjes skam brngos byas te chang gis ngar gsod byed dgos la gangs thigs kyang bong dmar gyi nang btsos thengs lan gsum byas rjes mjug tu sug pa dag byed dang bul dog gang rung gis nang du lan gcig btso dgos/ tsha la ni skam brngo byas de chu gcod dgos/ la phug ni gtubagazhog byas te skam rjes sbubs bsreg byas pa'i thal ba sbyor dgos/24 sga lo sman mar/cong zhi nas 'bru tsam brdungs te chu gtsang gis khu ba ma/ sings par bkru bshal byas te bong dmar thur mgro gang tsam btab nas btsobakru lan gsum byed dgos la/ gal te bong dmar ma 'dzoms na sngobong dmar mang tsam dang ze tshwa btab mas 'dul chol nge rjes sla nga'inang brngos nas chang gis ngar bsad nas rlangs bsub byas te bkol 285

chog pa dang / skyu ru'i rus pa nges par du dor dgos/25 a gar so lnga/ar nag g.yag khrag dron mo'i nang 'dul ba dang / nang rus dang phyi shun dor dgos pa rnams gzhung ltar/ ko byi la thal tshan gyi nang brngos nas spu bzhar de sbyar chog kaṇ+ḍa ka ri khrag rlung stod 'tshangs kyi skabs su spu tsher ma bzhar bar bkol chog 'dir tsher ma bzhar dgos/ sha chen ni dpa' bo g.yul du shi ba'i gri sha dgos la ma byung na 'brong snying sbyar chog26 gser mdog lnga ba/a ru'i nang rus dang gser me phyi shun dor dgos/ brag zhun khaṇ+ḍa byung na rab yin/ phag brun du rlangs mi 'chor bar sbrubs bsregs byed dgos/27 gcig zhes kyan grol/sbyor sde 'di byis pa'i sman yin phyir sa gi wang dang sa cu gang sogs sbyor mi rung bar dngos kyi sman bzang po gang 'dzoms shig sbyor dgos/28 lha ma la/ar nag g.yag gi khrag dron nang 'dul dgos/ sgog skya spubs bsreg byed dgos/ seng ldeng rang yod na de sdeb dgos la/ gal te 286

seng ldeng rang ma 'dzoms na stod ja la seng ldeng khaṇ+ḍa ru bzhed kyin yod de sbyor rung ba yin/29 rnam shes sor 'jugasman chen dang btsan dug gnyis gang rung zhig sbyar chog la/ sman chen gyi nus pa btsan dug las che phyir sman chen gtong na sbyor tshad de las cung nyung bar bya dgos/ de la thog mar btsan dug khrob brdung byas te lan gnyis nas gsum gyi bar la khu ba thon nges su gdu dgos la/ de nas 'bri mang po'i 'o sna rgya srang sum cu'i nang bsres nas sman nus 'o mar thims pa dang 'o ma de yang khaṇ+ḍa tsam du ma so nga bar gdu dgos/ de'i bar la btsan dug gi sman dug phog na kha ngo skrangs nyes yod phyir sman las pa rnams kyis kha btum rgyag pa'am la nang la a ru ra mur nas khaṇ+ḍa de ma 'tshig ma 'dregs pa bya dgos/ de rjes sman gzhan rnams zhib brdung tshegs la drangs nas khaṇ+ḍa dang bsres te ril bu bzos nas bsil skam bya'o/ /3༷ thing kun nyer lnga/sgog skya dang phag brun gnyis nus bsregs byas te thal ba gtong dgos pa dang / ar nag g.yag gi khrag dron gyi nang du 'dul dgos/bya rgod kyi sha la gla rtsi'i chu yis phyi nang khyab par byugs te tshag sha'i dkyil du bcug nas kha btsem me mur nang bsregs nas phyi'i tshag sha 287

nag por gyur na blangs nas bkol chog31 a gar bcu dgu/phyi shun 'dor dgos pa rnams gzhung ltar yin pa/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dang ko byi la gnyis phye spum bzhar na chog32 'azong rtse yar brgyad/gzhung du sha chen gsungs yod kyang sha chen gyi tshab tu 'brong snying sbyar chog ar nag g.yag gi khrag dron gyi nang du 'dul dgos/33 chong zhi nyer lnga/shing mngar gyi phyi shun dor ba dang / 'bras bu gsum gyi nang rus dor ba las khyad par can gyi 'dul sbyong byed dgos pa med/34 ya gar nyi shu/ar nag g.yag gi khrag dron nang du zhag gcig spangs nas phyi nyin chu gtsang gis bkrus te bkol chog pa dang / bse ru tshab tu shwa ra skam po har bsregs byas te sbyar chog nya phyi ni g.yu dang byu ru yi 'dul lugs ltar tsha la dang ze tsha star bu/ re ral/ a ru gang ga chung / 'o brgyad dri chu dang gla rtsi dri thon tsam gyi khu ba'i nang du 'dul dgos/ ko byi la yi spu bzhar nas gtong dgos so/ /35 bla 'od nor khrang /sdig srin dkar po chu gtsang gis gtsang ma zhig bkru bshal byas te 288

gla rtsi yi chu la zhag gcig sbang rgyu dang / mu zi des dngul chu 'dul ma chog de thog mar sring bal sogs kyis dngul chu'i saya' dag pa phyi ba/de nas me ran tsam gyis gong gi mu zi de bzhus nas de'i g.ya' phyi byas zin pa'i dngul chu de blugs la lcags thur gyis ngo bo dbyer med du dkrugs/ tshad gzhi slebs nas rdo 'khyags sam snum byugs brgyab pa'i snod du blugs te 'khyags thag chod rjes bcag nas dngul chu dang mu zi ngo bo dbyer med du 'dres yod med la zhib rtog byed dgos/ mdog sngo nag dngul 'brum med pa zhig yin na tshad du thon pa yin pas sbyar chog de nas sman gzhan rnams mnyam du zhib brdungs tshags la drangs nas lo brgyad dri chus 'dam 'thag byas te ril bu brgyab chog26 phag mo grub pa/cong zhi rigs gang yin nas 'bru tsam brdungs nas gtsang bar bkrus rjes chu gtsang gi nang bong dmar gyi phye ma btab ste btso bkru lan gsum byas nas slar sla nga'i nang la brngos te chang gi kha phru btab nas rlangs bsub bya'o/ /37 rkebyi la bdun pa/skabs 'dir ko byi la 'dul mi dgos la/ a ra nag g.yag gi khrag dron gyi nang 'dul dgos/38 gnu dril bcu gsum/289

go brun ni chu sbyangs byas te sman du mi 'gro ba'i rigs rnams dor nas skam thag chod pa na gla rtsi chu yis kha phru btab nas brngo dgos pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams tshad bzhin sbyar chog39 zhi byed drug pa/cong zhi nas 'bru tsam zhig brdungs te chu gtsang mar bkrus rjes ze tshwa dang bong dmar thur mgo gang btab nas btso bkru gsum byas rjes sla nga'i nang brngos te chang gi ngar bsad nas rlangs bsub bya dgos/4༷ gle tres lnga thang /sle tres kyi phyi shun dor ba dang / 'bras bu gsum gyi nang rus dor rgya tig dngos tshad gzhi ltar sbyar na kha drags phyir sum cu tig gang rung bsres nas sdeb chog41 sug spel bca ba/'bras sna gsum phye tshan gyi nang du ma 'tshig par brngo dgos pa dang sdig srin gla rtsi chu la zhag gcig sbang dgos/42 wa blo nyer lnga/wa glo gla rtsi'i chu la zhag gcig sbangs nas bsil skam byed dgos pa dang kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i tsher ma bzhar dgos / 'bras gsum gyi nang rus sle tres dang shing mngar gnyis kyi phyi shun dor dgos/43 spang rtsi bcu gnyis/290

brag zhun la khaṇ+ḍa byas na gzhung dang mthun no/ /44 rtsong zhi drug pa/cong zhi nas 'bru tsam zhig brdungs nas gtsang mar bkrus rjes ze tshwa dang bong dmar(bong dkar gyis tshab rung)btab nas lan gsum btso bkru byas rjes sla nga'i nang brngos te chang blugs nang rlangs bsub byed dgos/45 spyobyi bcu gsum/ko byi la ni me mur gyi nang du bsregs nas spu bzhar dgos/ de nas mdzo 'o nang btsos nas chu gtsang gis bshal dgos pa ni spyir btang gi 'dul lugs yin la/ 'on kyang sman sbyor 'di khrag rlung gi sman yin pas 'dul mi dgos/ ar nag g.yag gi khrag dron gyi nang 'dul na rab yin ma byung na sha khu dron mo'i nang 'dul na'ang chog sle tres kyi phyi shun dor dgos pa dang kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i tsher ma 'dir ma bzhar kyang chog46 blon po sum rgyur/sgyug cu gang dang chu cu gang las sa cu gang bsdeb mi rung gur gum yang kha gur dang bal gur 'dres ma yin dgos/ gi wang bzang po mi 'dang na lug ru ser po cung tsam bsdebs na chog47 da li bcu drug291

ar nag g.yag gi khrag dron gyi nang du 'dul dgos/ sdig srin dkar po gla rtsi'i chu la zhag gcig sbang dgos/48 bsam 'phel nor bu/shing mngar dang 'bri ta sa 'dzin la khaṇ+ḍa byung na rab yin/ mu tig dang nya phyis 'dul thabs g.yu byur dang mtshungs phyir/ rin chen rang mnyam gyi tsha la dang ze tshwa star bu'i khaṇ+ḍa/ be ljang re ral/ ldum bu re ral/ a ru/ gla rtsi dri thon tsam/ mgron bu spo can/ lo brgyad dri chu bcas kyi khu ba'i nang lan gsum la btso bkru byed pa dang / btso thengs re'i mtshams nas chu gtsang gis bkru bshal lan re byas te chang skyur gyi khu ba'i nang byu ru'i mdog 'gyur bar btso ba dang tshad gzhi slebs nas sug pa dag byed dang yang na bul tog gang rung gi nang btso bkru dag par byas te bkol chog rgyud las nya phyi'i nus pa mu tig khyad par med gsungs yod pas 'di'i nang mu tig gi tshab tu nya phyis sbyar chog bse ru dkar po chu 'dul byed dgos/ bse ru'i tshab tu gtsod rwa dkar po rtsi hrags bsregs pa dang shwa bo'i rwa rgan har bsregs byas nas sbyar chog sdig srin dkar po bkrus rjes gla rtsir sbangs nas gtong rgyu/49 dwags po span nagacong zhi slad med phul do dang / /lan tshwa slad med phul gang gnyis//292

sla nga'i nang du legs par brngos/ /tshos tshad 'bru gsum nas dang sbyar//chang rgan nying khu'i kha phru 'debs/ /rlangs pa mi 'chor gab par bya/ /srad dkar gzhon nu chag pa do/ /brag skyes dbyi mong spar ba do/ /de gnyis du ba ma shor bsreg /ces gsungs pa bzhin lag len byed dgos/ ze tshwa ni sla nga'i nang du tsag sgra thon tsam brngo dgos/5༷ ru rta bcu ba/thang phrom dkar po'i rtsa ba de sla nga'i nang ser tsam brngos nas dug sel bya dgos pa yin/51 bye ringasnyesems bde/go yu chang dang sbyar nas sla nga'i nang brngos te rlangs bsub byas te bcud sgrub byed pa dang / shing kun ni sman spyi'i nang dri thon tsam sbyar chog sbyor ba 'dir 'brong snying las gzhan ri bong gi snying dang ne tso yi /nga bya rgod kyi snying sogs snying sna gang 'dzom zhig sbyar rgyu byung na r+sha/ ṭ+wāṃkā/ byed brgyad pa/yungs dkar ni li sder gyi nang ma 'tshig tsam zhig brngo dgos/53 sprug po g.yul rgyal/cong zhi nas 'bru tsam zhig khrob brdungs byas rjes gcang mar bkrus la rgya gar bong dmar btab pa'i chu'i nang lan gsum btso ba 293

dang / de'i rjes skam brngo byas te tshos tshad nas 'bru gsum gang thub pa'i bar du brngo la chang gis ngar bsad nas rlangs bsub bya'o/ /gser me sbyor rgyu la byung na de'i tshab tu phyed dang g.ya' kyi de'i phyed ka byas nas sbyar na legs/54 gso byed nyi ma/rtsa ba lnga las gze ma phud de gzhan rnams thog mar chu gtsang gis dag par bkrus te dug 'don pa dang / de nas chu la tshos par btsos nas drod du 'gugs pa dang / de'i rjes 'o ma'i nang btsos te khu ba rang thim byas nas bcud sgrub byed pa dang / gze ma'i tsher ma 'tshig pa tsam zhig brngo dgos/ nye shing phyed ka'i tshad du rin hrin sbyar na ༵/sa /stobs gso ba la phan phyir rin hrin sbyor ba ni rang cag gi lugs 55 ji ru nyer lnga/brag zhun dang star bu gzhung gi lag len gyi tshad bzhin khaṇ+ḍa byed dgos/ gser me tshab tu gser phud gtong na gser phud de gser me yi sbyor tshad de'i phyed dang / phyed kyi tshab tu g.ya' kyi ma sbyar chog sle tres kyi phyi shun dor dgos/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i tsher ma ma bzhar pa btang chog56 man ngag bsil smyor/ar nag g.yag gi khrag dron gyi nang du 'dul ba dang / cong zhi 294

bsil 'dul byed dgos/ de yang cong zhi rigs gang rung zhig sol me'i dkyil du tshos par bsregs nas chu blugs/ de grang du bcug rjes mdzo mo'i 'o ma'i nang khu bar byas te tshags la 'dren dgos/ de nas cong zhi'i nang nyi ma phog tu mi 'jug par khang ba'i nang ngos bsil 'og tu bzhag ste gur gum dang gi wang zhad tsam bsres nas mdzo mo'i 'o ma gtong bzhin 'dam 'thag byas te bsil skem byed dgos/57 klo tshad kun sel/mtshal ni rlangs pa thon tsam zhig brngo dgos pa dang shing mngar gyi phyi shun dor dgos so/ /58 byuge sman bya khyung sngon po/sle tres kyi phye shun dor dgos pa ma gtogs khyad par can gyi ri 'dul sbyang byed dgos pa'i sman med/59 ya lha drug thang /shing mngar gyi phyi shun dor dgos pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams tshad bzhin sbyar chog6༷ li zhi drug pa/shing mngar gyi phyi shun dor dgos pa las khyad par can gyi 'dul sbyang byed dgos pa'i sman med/61 bde byed chu bskur/295

sdig srin gla rtsi'i chu la zhag gcig sbang dgos pa las gzhan rnams tshad bzhin sbyar chog62 zhi byed nyer dgu/cong zhi sol me'i dkyil du bsreg de 'tshig thag chod nas chang gis khur bcug ste chu gzhan dang mi phrad par bya dgos/ la phug ni gzhog gtub byas te skam rjes nus bsregs byed dgos/ mgron bu sol me'i dkyil du har bsregs byed pa dang / rdo zho ni cong zhi tsha 'dul ltar bsregs nas chu skol gyis khur bcug ste skam nas bkol ba/go'u thal ni thog mar chu la khur bcug rjes tshags la drangs nas rdo dang rul pa sogs dor dgos la chu'i zhabs kyi sman de skem du bcug rjes gla rtsi'i chu'i kha phru btab nas brngos te bkol chog brag zhun khaṇ+ḍa byung na rab yin/63 sha spyor brgyad pa/sha sbyor brgyad pa'i sbyor ba 'di la sna tshogs su yod mod gang ltar wa rtsa zhes pa'i sman rdzas de nges par du dgos pa yin/ de med na grangs kyang nges dka' la sman nus kyang legs po thon mi thub/ bstan bcos kha shas las wa rtswa zhes pa'i sman zhig med na'ang / drang srong mkhas grub lung rtogs rgya mtsho phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes mdzad pa'i〈san sbyor bdud rtsi gru char〉phros/ gtso bo skya ka'i sha dang 296

da li dang / tsha ba gsum dang wa tshwa(ma rnyed na bod tshwa dmar pos tshab rung / dung bsregs thal/ ci rtsa rgya nas nas 'a byur ba'i rtswa sngon tshwa dro ba zhig yong)zhes bya gsang ba'i sman ma chog lda ma zhes pa'i wa rtswa chad mi rung / skya ka'i sha sha rigs 'asdi 6'a/ lu galo ngang mtshungs/64 spru nag nyer dgu/phag brun nus bsregs byed dasos rī dang / phur mong la gzhung gi khaṇ+ḍa'i lag len ltar byed dgos/ mu zi yang slad med pa khram khrum brdungs rjes shu dag dkar po dang ram pa'i rtsa ba bskol ba'i khu ba'i nang lhog tsam skol nas zhag gcig la bsnyal dargos pa dang / phyi nyin yang cung zad bskol te khu ba dor nas chu grang gis ya nga yang bshal bas dri ma med na dug thon pa yin/65 phan pa kun ldan/thang phrom rlangs pa thon tsam zhig brngo dgos pa las gzhan rnams tshad bzhin bya'o/ /66 spang rgyan bco lnga/ar nag g.yag gi khrag dron gyi nang 'dul dgos la slo tre+es dang shing mngar gnyis kyi phyi shun dor dgos/67 ya ru nyer bzhi/go yu chang la brngos nas rlangs bsub byed pa dang mkhal zho yang 297

brngo dgos/68 'ol se nyer lnga/rgya mtshal rlangs pa thon pa tsam zhig brngo dgos pa dang sbrul sha gla rtsi khad tsam btab pa'i chang gi nang la zhag gcig sbang dgos/ ze tsha rlangs pa thon tsam zhig brngos nas chu gcod pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams tshad bzhin sbyar chog69 ze ga bcu gsum/sman 'bras gsum dang mkhal zho dkar po rnams rab byung na li yi sla nga dang de ma byung na yang sla nga'i nang ma 'tshig tsam zhig brngo dgos la gzhan rnams tshad bzhin du sbyar chog7༷ zhi byed bcu gcigacong zhi nas 'bru tsam zhig brdungs nas gtsang ma zhig bkru bshal thengs 'ga' byas rjes bong dmar nang btsos nas dug 'don byed dgos/ sbrul sha gla rtsi chu la zhag gcig sbang dgos/ sdig srin yang gtsang mar bkrus rjes gla rtsi'i chu la zhag gcig sbang dgos/71 a gar bacho lnga/kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i tsher ma bzhar dgos/72 gle tres lnga thang /sle tres kyi phyi shun dor dgos pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams tshad 298

bzhin sbyar chog73 rta zi dmar po/thar nu brkos ma thag gtsang ma zhig bkru bshal byas te phyi shun dor nas dum bur gtub/ de nas dge slong ngam lo brgyad dri chu'i nang ra sha cung tsam btab ste de'i nang btso ba dang khu ba sum gnyis 'thag rjes ra sha bton nas khu ba rang thim du skem nas btang chog74 star bu bcu gcigaskabs 'di'i tsha la ze tshwa gnyis kyang chu bcad byed dgos/75 star bu bañtsa/star bu thog mar khu ba btsag la snyigs ma dor/ de nas khu ba yang yang bskol la tshos tshad lug sha'i tsho rtsib cig gis khog ma nang dkrugs pa'i sha de tshos na tshad la slebs yod/ shing mngar gyi phyi shun dor/76 dzāti bcu bzhi/nang rus dang phyi shun dor dgos pa las gzhan rnams gzhung ltar yin la sgog skya nus bsregs byas te thal ba bzo dgos/77 yung ba bzhi thang /gze ma'i tsher ma 'tshig tsam zhig brngo dgos pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams tshad bzhin/78 'khyu gartsod bzhi ba/299

za 'ad+dhig rus gtsang ma zhig bkru dgos pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams byetā dīwa nazhu/na dgu ba/brag zhun chu nang la khu ba thon rag bar sbangs nas snyigs ma dor khu ṭ+wāṃ yang yang bskol nas khaṇ+ḍa bzo dgos/ gzhan rnams tshad bzhin ༵bye/spa/na mar/gong gi rtsa ba'i sman rnams phyogs gcig tu sbyar te khram khrum brdungs nas chu gtsang gi nang du lan gsum btsos nas sman khu thon nges pa zhig legs pa dang / de nas sman khu khaṇ+ḍa tsam du gdus te de'i nang 'o ma blugs nas sman khu 'o mar bstem/ de nas yang mar bzhus te snyigs ma dor la dwangs ma de'i nang blugs te 'o ma dang sman khu mar la bstem/ mar de la dwangs snyigs 'byed pa dang de yang me steng du blugs nas tshag sgru med skabs kha tshar gyi sman rnams bsres te ma 'khyags bar du sman dang mar gyi ngo bo dbyer med du byugs dgos/ bu ram dang sbrang rtsi la shad brgyab nas phye ma bzo dgos/ de nas sbrang rtsi chu nyung tsam gyi steng du sbrang rtsi blugs nas me drag po'i steng du khaṇ+ḍa tsam du gdus te rdo 'khyags steng blugs nas 'khyags dus lag pas len thub zhig yin tshad la slebs pa yin phyir ma 'khyags par 'then na 300

'grub thub/ bu ram gyi shad rgyag stangs kyang de bzhin yin/81 zangs thal nyer lnga/zangs ma sbrang gshog tsam zhig brdungs te mtshur ser nag cha gcig chang skyur cha gcig star khu cha gcig bcas kyi khu ba'i nang chu gcig ring btsos nas dug 'don byed pa dang / de'i rjes star khu dang chang skyur gyi khu ba'i nang lan gsum btso bkru byas te g.ya' phyi ba de nas sings ras kyis zangs kyi sbrang gshog dag par phyi ba/ bsregs rdzas ni zangs dang ljid mnyam gyi mu zi'i phye ma dang / nyis 'gyur gyi tsha la chu yis sbyongs byas te sbrang gshog gi phyi nang kun la byugs nas ras la btums te bsregs thal nang snga dro gcig la bsregs na 'grub thub/de nas chu gtsang gis dag par bkru dgos/ bse ru dang skyu ru gnyis rtsi sngogs tsam bsregs rjes chu brdar byas nas 'dul dgos la/ṭār+shardo/ ni rlangs pa thon tsam zhig brngo dgos/ gzhan rnams tshad 82 rgya ru bcu bzhi/rgya ru dang bse ru gnyis rtsi sdogs tsam zhig bsregs rjes chu brdar byas nas 'dul dgos/ sha ru sol me'i dkyil du har bsregs byed dgos pa dang cog la rlangs thon tsam zhig brngo dgos/83 gatsho po nyer lnga/301

sle tres dang shing mngar gnyis kyi phyi shun dor dgos pa dang /kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i phyi'i tsher ma bzhar dgos pa ma gtogs gzhan rnams tshad bzhin sbyar chog84 gnam lcags thog mda'/lcags skyogs me thog btsugs nas mu zi kha phru/ de nas dngul chu spugs la shing bus dkrugs nas skyogs ngos 'byar ba rnams bkog nas phye mar bya/ gzhan rnams tshad bzhin bya/85 bya sha bco lnga/a bar skyur gsum gyi nang rus 'don dgos/ cong zhi khram khrum brdungs nas sla ngar brngos te tshag sgra thon skabs chang gis ngar bsad nas rlangs bsub byed dgos/ gtsang sbal ni tshags sha'i nang btums te me mur nang btsos nas dug 'don dgos/86 sman ser chen mo/brag zhun khaṇ+ḍa byas na rab/ thar nu ni spyir ba gcin nang 'dul bar gsungs kyang / skabs 'dir dge slong ngam/ sngags pa nus ldan dang lo brgyad dri chu'i nang 'dul ba mchog tu gsungs pa ltar byed pa gal/87 nga sngon dgu ba/a ru nang rus dor ba las gzhan rnams tshad bzhin sbyar chog302

88 teg ta nyer lnga/ka ko la gser me yi lkog shun dor dgos pa dang shing mngar gyi skog shun dor/ brag zhun khaṇ+ḍa byed dgos/89 g.ya' kyi nyer lnga/a bar skyur gsum gyi nang nus 'don dgos pa dang / gser me tsādī kaser phud kyi skog shun dor dgos/ re ral yang phyi'i dreg pa kāX ༷/da rag mdog ldan/brag zhun dang shug tsher gnyis khaṇ+ḍa'i lag len tshul bzhin byed dgos pa dang mkhal zho sran ma'i rigs yin phyir 'tshig tsam brngo dgos la/ gze ma'i tsher ma yang 'tshig tsam brngo dgos pa las gzhan rnamasaze tshad bzhin sbyar chogardo1 bye k+ta py-i sdoshā kātrī/ mong nag po gnyis nus bsregs byas te thal ba dā~X/rtsa thag bcu gsum/sdig srin dkar po gtsang ma zhig bkrus rjes gla rtsi chu la zhag gcig sbang dgos pa dang / thang phrom rlangs thon tsam zhig brngo dgos/mkhal ma zho sha dang 'bras sna gsum yang brngo dgos pa las gzhan 303

rnams tshad bzhin sbyar chog93 'dzag sdom bla ba rgyan snogalca ba dang ra mnye nye shing ba spru dbang lag lnga ni chu gtsang gis gtsang ma zhig bkru bshal byas rjes chu gtsang nang btsos nas khu ba rang thim byas te drod 'thug byed pa dang gze ma'i tsher ma 'tshag tsam zhig brngo dgos/ dom mkhris kyi tshab tu mkhris pa'i khaṇ+ḍa sbyor na/ las gtong mi rung / gzhan rnams tshad bzhin/94 khrag tshad bcu thang /a bar skyur gsum gyi nang rus 'don pa dang sle tres kyi phyi shun dor ba las gzhan rnams tshad ltar sbyar chog la kaṇ+ḍa ka ri'i phyi'i tsher ma'ang ma bton par sbyar chog95 stab seng brgyad pa/cong zhi ngos la 'byar ba'i rdo rnams bkog nas gtsang ma zhig bkrus rjes sla nga'i nang brngo/ de'i nang 'bru re re byas nas gsum tshig rjes chang blugs nas rlangs bsub bya dgos pa dang / cog la rlangs thon tsam zhig brngo dgos/ mdung rtse smug po bong dmar gyi chu la btso dgos pa dang gzhan rnams tshad bzhin sbyar chog96 dngul chu bacho brgyad/dngul chu tsha 'dul la lcags skyogs me thog tu btsugs nas dngul 304

chu'i ljid mnyam gyi mu zis khu bar byas rjes de'i nang dngul chu blugs la shing bus yang yang dkrugs/ de rnams skyogs ngos su 'byar pa rnams bkog nas 'thag chog97 gu skya nyer brgyad/shug tsher khram tsam brdungs rjes bskol la snyigs ma rnams dor la dwangs ma rnams khaṇ+ḍa bya dgos/ gze ma'i tsher ma tshig tsam brngo dgos pa dang / brag zhun chur sbangs nas mi gtsang ba rnams blangs rjes bkol la snyigs ma dor/ de nas chu thag bar du gdus nas slar yang lu gsob can de rdo grang steng blugs nas ril bu bsgril thub dus khaṇ+ḍar gyur yod/ sdig srin gtsang mar bkrus rjes gla rtsi'i chu la zhag gcig sbang dgos/ gu yu chang dang bsres nas cung tsam brngos te bsnyal dgos/98 khrag tshad bdun pa/seng ldeng dang mdzo mo shing sogs shing sman thams cad kyi phyi shun dor dgos/99 ar nag drug pa/ar nag g.yag gi khrag dron nang 'dul dgos/ gal te khrag dron ma 'dzom na rang cag gi lag len ltar sha khu'i nang 'dul dgos/1༷༷ gastsan snyi a ru brtso brgyad/305

mkhal zho 'tshig tsam pa zhig brngo dgos pa dang / gze ma'i tsher ma 'asdig tsam pa zhig brngo dgos/ brag zhun dang shug tsher khaṇ+ḍa byung na ṭāsdu ṭāshā/ser mdog bcu gcigabrag zhun khaṇ+ḍa ni gzhung ltar lag len tshul bzhin byed dgos la ga bur nag po spubs bsregs byed dgos/ gla rtsi ni phye ma'i nang btul nas bsres dgos/1༷2 gur gum brgyad pa/sug smel dang ka ko la'i lkog shun dor dgos/ gal te da byid ma 'dzom na sram sha sbyar chog de yang sram sha dang da byid gang rung thog mar gla rtsi'i chu'i nang kha phru btab rjes tshags sha'i nang bcug nas kha btsems nas bsreg dgos/1༷3 'dab chags lnga spyor/bya ma byi'i sha gla rtsi'i chu la sbangs te bskams rjes bkol chog sbrul py-i / gla rtsi'i chu nang sbangs rjes sla ngar rtsi thogs tsam brngos te bkol 1༷4gser gye brgyad pa/sdig srin gla rtsi'i chu la zhag gcig sbang dgos pa dang / gze ma'i tsher ma 'tshig tsam brngo dgos/ sug smel gyi lkog shun dor dgos/306

'bu skyogs ni nus bsregs byas te thal ba bzo dgos/ ba spru ni dang po brkos ma thag chu grang gis bkrus/ de nas chu gtsang nang nub kyi nang du btsos nas khu ba rang thim bya/ de rjes slar yang 'o ma bzhi 'gyur nang btsos nas 'o ma rang thim bya dgos so/ /1༷5 'jam 'azas drug pa/'jam 'bras phye tshan nang ser tsam brngo dgos pa dang sug smel gyi lkog shun dor dgos pa las gzhan rnams tshad bzhin sbyar chog

zur bkod/gnyis/ rin chen ril bu'i rigs gtong tshul maspyogs bsdus/rgyud phyi mar/ rtsa kha 'byed la tsha sdor g.yer mas bya/ /ril bu'i sngon du zhun mar zhag 'ga' bsten/ /phyi srung tsha grang sbyor ba'i mar gyis byugs/ /nus pa bskyed pa ril bu chang gis dbul/ /sha chang stor bsten skabs su ba spur phyung / /zhes sogs gzhung don ltar/ rin chen ril bu ma btang ba'i zhag bdun gyi sngon nas sdud sman gyi thang dang /zhun mar cung zad re khong du btang zhing lto ba sogs su snum byug bya/ril bu gtong ba'i snga nyin nas rtsa kha 'byed pa'i ched du 'bras thug sla po zhig gi nang du g.yer ma 'bru bdun gyi sdor btab pa'i thang 'thung /de nub nas dkar yol gas chag med pa'i nang du chang bzang po'am ja khu/ chu khol gtsang ma gang rung blugs pa'i nang ril bu sbangs te dar dmar gyis kha bkab la zhag gcig bzhag phyir nangs tho rangs chu gtsang gis kha bkru bshal byas te ril bu srin lag gis bshig la 'thung / de nas mal gos shin tu dro ba gyon te rngul thon nges byas la nyal/ rngul thon rim bzhin ras kyis phyi/ lus ma rngul na chu tshod gcig 308
